chapters.title: Chapter 3230 Echelons! I
paragraphs: Away from the Megalos Beyond.
Within the Infinite Omniverse.

In front of Noah's humanoid figure near the multicolored throne, dazzling blue and gold prompts were flashing as he achieved a full quantification that covered the new knowledge gained from the Megalos Beyond.
|The levels of power of all Existences under the scope of the stretches of Omniverses have been quantified into an ever evolving scale.|
|Existential Authority is broken into the quantification under the umbrella of a System of Existence.|
|The quantification of the Weaver of Extremity is as follows.|
[Atlas of Existence Echelon 1 (8,385/10,000)]---[Laborer]
[Conceptual System of Existence Echelon 3 (650,234/1,000,000)]---[Dominium Organs]---[Omniversal Control]
[Outerversal Descent System of Existence Echelon 1 (43/5,000)]
His Atlas of Existence remained the firmest foundation, its values somewhat unique compared to others as the many systems of Existence he had incorporated fell under it.
It had its own Echelon.

But its strength and values rose in large part due to his Conceptual System of Existence- with his terrifying Extremes that were all rising towards the Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority stage or climbing up Phases of Ascendancy!
The ever expanding Infinite Omniverse and the Authorities it bound.
The ever radiant Quintessence and Infinity.
All of it had a part to play as when the values of the Conceptual System of Existence and the Outerversal Descent System of Existence increased, so would the status of his Atlas of Existence.

For Outerversal Descent, he had only established the initial connection as Noah could feel the Outerversal Authority of Ozymandias, but he didn't allow the full effects to course through the connection just yet!
Looking at the small Value under Outerversal Descent, the time seemed as ripe as any to see what power Delegatus were afforded after they agreed to be bound by Outerversal Morphons.
So Noah closed his eyes.

He felt the purple blue radiance of the unbreakable connection between him and Ozymandias. He felt the advancements Ozymandias had made, as well as the vast seas of Outerversal Authorities he held in his reserves.
And he then spoke calmly.
"Let it flow."
HUUM!
From the Weavings of Ozymandias who was in the depths of the Grave of the Great Beyonder.
Stellar obsidian authority was focused on a singular line and directed to flow across it with freedom and fervor.
It didn't take the passage of an instant before a change could be seen above Noah within the Infinite Omniverse- his body becoming shrouded with gorgeous stellar radiance.
|Your status as a Delegatus of Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias is increasing.]
|The Value of your Outerversal Descent System of Existence has increased by +140...|
|The Value of your Outerversal Descent System of Existence has increased by +200...|
Ever so steadily, the different parts that contributed to Noah's power rose higher.
The Outerversal Authority coiled in his Second Mundi of Power within his Atlas of Existence, the Authority of the Laborer becoming more potent in response.
Alongside it...
|The Synchronization of entirely different Weavings of Existence of Noah Osmont and Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias has begun.|
|Two parts of a single whole, your Records, Influence, and Achievements will slowly assimilate to ensure stability in a field unventured by others.|
|The Value of your Conceptual System of Existence has increased by +300...|
|The Value of your Atlas of Existence has increased by +85...|

As the weavings of Outerversal Authority came down, Noah felt many parts of himself affected- with this even including some Extremity Authorities within his Conceptual System of Existence that held some inclination towards the weavings and Physiology of Outerversal Morphons!
Something like...the simple weavings of a Terror from a distant past Universe.
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Cthulhu has attained the distinction of Ascendancy. |
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Reality has attained the distinction of Ascendancy. |
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Dimensions has attained the distinction of Ascendancy. |
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Relativity has stepped onto the Third Phase of Ascendancy!|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Entropy has stepped onto the Third Phase of Ascendancy!|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities of Manadynamics, The Protagonist, Tyranny, and....have stepped onto the Third Phase of Ascendancy!|
Multiple weavings of Authorities under him advanced as he fully accepted the Outerversal Authority from his other self.
"The Megalos Beyond...the vast Omniverses...the Wheel of Existence..."
His voice echoed out grandly as he opened his eyes.
His hands reached up to nothingness, and yet he felt like there was something he could grasp right there!
"Just how can I get my hands completely around you all...?"
WAA!
The Megalos Beyond! The Myriad of Omniverses! The Wheel of Existence!
The Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor dared to wonder how he could take all of this for himself!
His Invictus Dominium Wings spread out with colorless brilliance as the Halo spinning above him made him look ethereal.
Like he knew exactly where he was going, and yet lost at the same time.
"Would I be able to rest after that? Will there be nobody who could threaten my safety or the safety of my people?"
If he rose across the Echelons he just quantified.
If he took the identity of an Instrument he had nothing to do within the Megalos Beyond.
If he took the identity of a Protector of the Omniverses under the Commonwealth and dismantled this behemoth entirely.
Would he reach a point where he could sit back and not worry?
Not feeling like an ant in a small box as a huge foot hung above, and it could crush everything he worked for any time it wished, and he had no power to stop it?
He didn't know.
His hand came down as his figure continued to be bathed with waves of stellar obsidian radiance.

Beside him, the visage of the Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse came forward, her multicolored hands formed from threads of countless Authorities taking Noah's downcast hand as her intent weaved out.
|Whatever is to come, I will always be right beside you, Master.|
The unflinching and absolute loyalty of the connection established from a small blue planet.
Noah gazed down from whatever distant thing he couldn't see as he looked at the Manifestation of the Infinite Omniverse...and let out a content smile!

chapters.title: Chapter 3231 Echelons! II
paragraphs: From the brilliant Infinite Omniverse.
Within the Omniverse of the Protectors.
After crossing the rainy isolated domain where the Shield of the Commonwealth resided, Noah's traversal across the portal let him him into a far bigger domain.

A Domain with endless blue skies and verdant grasslands that extended all around for light years, with the concentration of Existence being extremely profound as a single thing stood in the midst of all this while surrounded by floating vessels filled with powerful auras.
A tower.
Stretching out towards the skies and shining with white and green brilliance, it seemed to be a few light years in stature!
"The Obelisk of the Protectors."
Beside him, the voice of one of the two Autarchical Existences rang out.
Turning to gaze at them, Noah's piercing eyes finally made a breakthrough in analysis after this whole time as...
[Protector Rigalis]
[Unknown System of Existence Echelon 3 (755,835/1,000,000)]---[@&%^#]---[@&#^#]

The Apogee Autarch that had spoken beside him had such an array of quantifications rise up above him only for Noah to see, the other Protector beside him showing similar values as Noah became more adept at analyzing and grasping the weavings of those around him.
If they weren't too far advanced that is!

The two Protectors beside him introduced the massive tower ahead of them as they walked on a white path constructed from crystals pulsing with existence, the serene reality of undulating verdant landscapes all around them passing by.
The focus was only on the pristine white and green tower rising up to the skies.

"This is the Obelisk of the Protectors. A living, breathing, construct with 1,000 Floors that are filled with Miniature Existential Domains. There are 1,000,000 Restaurants stretched throughout some lower and upper floors, entire Miniature Existential Domains dedicated to various professions of Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Formations, Runeworkings, and more. An Existential Library with Records of all known Omniverses and Odditties, an Arena where you can sign up for friendly matches with other Protectors, Lounges, and Amusement Areas to rest your Existence and partake on the various Nectars of Existence from the myriad Omniverses..."

Noah whistled at the number of things being introduced within this single massive tower, the Protector introducing it seeming to take great pride as they neared one of its many entrances in a few steps!

Powerful auras of Entities at the Teracosm, Paracosm, and Autarchical Stage moved in the surroundings busily, some going towards the vessels floating in the skies as others left the Vessels to enter the Obelisk of the Protectors.
A majority of the entities seen were Royal Existential Omniversal Simians, with others ranging in terms of races and forms as the next in line were those with pure human forms.
But undoubtedly, any weaker Entities or even weaker Autarchs all bowed their heads respectfully whenever an Apogee Autarch appeared or passed by- such a being bearing the distinction of a Protector!
As they neared the Obelisk, an entrance that was a massive pulsing white portal stretching out for over a thousand miles stood before them.
"In addition to all that, the Obelisk of the Protectors is also equipped with Suites for lodging clustered in the Miniature Existential Domains in the middle and top floors."

"You can use this card to lead you towards your own designated personal Miniature Existential Domain that nobody else has access to and other unrestricted areas inside the Obelisk, and this one will take you directly to the Miniature Existential Domain where your team is currently stationed."
One purple card and one gold card were given to him, Noah nodding with a smile as he went towards the massive tower shining with verdant and white brilliance.

"Thanks for the tour." He waved his hands towards the two Protectors behind him as his body buzzed and split into two, one taking the purple card and the other taking the gold card as they both disappeared into the blinding white portal.
The two Protectors looked at each other and shook their heads at this eccentric new addition to their forces as the one who had been speaking this whole time continued.
"I give him a week. Paired with those guys and the possible ability to sniff out Agents of Anti-Life...a lot of unknowns will be gunning for him."
A heavy prediction.
The other Simian only smiled and shook his head as he took a golden card of his own and disappeared into the Obelisk of the Protectors!
Inside the Obelisk of the Protectors.
There were many Miniature Existential Domains connected all around it, but one could only go where they were given access to!

Noah's body, holding a golden card, was wrapped up in a light of teleportation that took him to a specific Miniature Existential Domain that would hold the team of Protectors he was to work with- the Equestris Protectors.
His other body went to see what intricacies this Obelisk of the Protectors held- one of its first stops being the aforementioned Existential Library.

Holding the gold card that pulsed with a unique signature of Existence, Noah warped inside of a Miniature Existential Domain that seemed to be among many overlapping networks of Domains within the Obelisk, the new space unfolding before his eyes with wonder.
All around, sparkling white dwarf stars rotated in the skies above and below. At the center of this space, multiple auras honed in on Noah the moment he arrived.

All of these auras were anchored around thrones with gorgeous purple-gold galaxies rotating below them, and they were currently surrounding a massive illusory image of an Outerversal Morphon along with lines of words that talked about its weaknesses, strengths, and abilities!
They seemed to be in the middle of a meeting as the auras were five in number, four blazing with a similar brilliance while the fifth...seemed like an object everything gravitated against.
Hair dazzling red. Adorned in a multicolored robe that shone with the same brilliance of an Omniversal Armament like the Sword that Noah currently held in his hands.
Fair skin that pulsed with life and valor, it was an Entity at the Omniversal Stage who turned towards Noah's direction among many others, her voice echoing out at this moment.
"The newest member of this little group that Old Man Eudemus mentioned has arrived early. Osmont, is it? Come on over, and let's have an introduction."

chapters.title: Chapter 3232 Echelons! III
paragraphs: Her voice radiated undeniable waves of power as just from looking at her from a distance, her weavings barely made themselves clear!
[Protector @&$^%]
Someone multiple Echelons of power higher than most others.
Outside the scope of the Existential Dominium Realm, she resided in the Omniversal Realm!
Noah floated past the compressed background of stellar bodies and galaxies as he went towards the central area of this Miniature Existential Domain.

He came near the thrones where the five Protectors were as apart from the Omniversal Entity, there was one other woman who seemed extremely similar to her, and three Royal Existential Omniversal Simians with elegant or burly figures!

"Haha, this is the newbie involved in the recent accident of a Morphon being forced by him to actually appear in the presence of one of the bodies of the Viceroy? Records of him do not do his presence justice!"
Records?
Noah raised his brows at a burly Simian who sat lazily on a throne with an interested expression.
Seeing his gaze, this Simian smiled while waving his hands to show an illusory screen that played a grandiose video.

The video depicted the fantastical visage of the Viceroy pressing down an interminable wheel that ground down an Outerversal Morphon while saving the lives of his people in the Gladiators Arena of the newest discovered Omniverse!
"This is who we are fighting against."
The voice of the Viceroy Noah very distinctly remembered played out once more.

"We do what we do day in and day out to ensure that Existence is protected. That life is protected. The glory of the Commonwealth will continue to spread to all corners of known and unknown Omniverses as we ensure that none will fall to our enemies!"
WAA!
The scenes of what occurred not too long ago were displayed on the screen, along with the figures of rising audience members who raised their hands towards the Viceroy.
Ever so briefly, Noah's figure was shown for a fraction of a second as the one who uncovered the identity of this Agent of Anti-Life before the voice of the Viceroy thundered out again.
"Long live the Commonwealth!"
An explosion of magisterial brilliance finished off the video before its illusory screen flickered out of existence, the Simian who had conjured it speaking out.

"This Record has already been spread to all the stretches of the Commonwealth. You've made it in one of the disseminated videos of our dear great leader even before becoming a Protector- a rite of passage!"
A record of propaganda.
Noah didn't even get a chance to reply before the aura of the Omniversal Entity blazed.
"Enough of that. Osmont, this lazy thing that can't read the room is Protector Actaeon, and this is Protector Orpheus and Protector Ajax."
The three powerful Royal Simians who seemed to be on the cusp of breaking their shackles and entering the Omniversal Realm nodded towards Noah.

The Omniversal Entity then pointed to herself and the other woman who looked just like her on the nearby throne- a woman who was sitting on her throne while dangling her legs in the air freely as she had the same red hair on her head and was adorned in a simple white battle robe!
"To my left is Protector Lucretia, and I am the Command Protector of the Equestris Protectors- Protector Valeria."
Command Protector Valeria.
The woman emanated profound beauty and valor as she stared without blinking at Noah after she introduced everyone.
Noah smiled as he spoke out in turn.
"Protector Osmont. I'm here to learn and observe exactly what it is we fight against."
"Mmm, Osmont eh?" With her legs still dangling in the air freely, Protector Lucretia twisted her body slightly to look at Noah as she continued.

As he spoke, he looked at the massive illusory display of an Outerversal Morphon that looked like an octahedron that shot out endless tentacles towards a group of Protectors in a Domain where existence looked decimated and destroyed.
"Mmm, Osmont eh?" With her legs still dangling in the air freely, Protector Lucretia twisted her body slightly to look at Noah as she continued.
"I heard you are able to sniff out Agents of Anti-Life. How exactly do you do this? Do you just sniff them out or does there need to be a fight?"
She seemed to hold immeasurable curiosity as her red eyes and hair shone with a stellar brilliance.
Noah looked at her with sharp eyes as he smiled while walking towards an empty throne already put in place amidst these powerful entities.
"My authority has to come in contact with their Existence."
"Oh..." Hearing this, the curiosity and interest in the eyes of Protector Lucretia faded, her gaze going back to the image of the Outerversal Morphon portrayed above them.
Command Protector Valeria gave her a side eye as she gazed towards Noah and spoke out.

"Don't pay too much heed to her wither and simply focus on your assigned tasks. Having just come from a newly discovered Omniverse, you likely do not know much about what Protectors truly do across the Omniverses. Such information will be critical in understanding before we set off for our next Incursion."
As she spoke, she waved her hands to minimize the image of the Outerversal Morphon and added a terrifying Worm of Existence beside it.

"Outerversal Morphon and Worms of Existence. We designate the former as Anti-Life and the latter as Anti-Existence- with these two forces...having decimated or occupied more Omniverses than those that the Commonwealth has discovered and brought under their protection."
BOOM!
Heavy information echoed out that caused Noah's eyes to constrict.
He didn't know their reach was so extensive.
The other part of himself had just arrived in the Megalos Beyond as he didn't discover the structure and weavings of how these terrifying Morphons worked fully!
With a stern gaze, Command Protector Valeria continued by declassifying important information and sharing it with the new Protector freely.

"We are on the side of life. On the side of Existence. The Worms of Existence...I truly hate this name for them as their existence is Anti-Existence, with the Omniverses they have devoured becoming Nests filled with Weavings of Anti-Matter."
"Then, there are the Outerversal Morphons. The Omniverses they conquer and transform are made into domains of Dark Matter!"
Anti-Matter! Dark Matter!

The video depicted the fantastical visage of the Viceroy pressing down an interminable wheel that ground down an Outerversal Morphon while saving the lives of his people in the Gladiators Arena of the newest discovered Omniverse!
"This is who we are fighting against."
The voice of the Viceroy Noah very distinctly remembered played out once more.
"We do what we do day in and day out to ensure that Existence is protected.
That life is protected.
The glory of the Commonwealth will continue to spread to all corners of known and unknown Omniverses as we ensure that none will fall to our enemies!"
WAA!
The scenes of what occurred not too long ago were displayed on the screen, along with the figures of rising audience members who raised their hands towards the Viceroy.
Ever so briefly, Noah's figure was shown for a fraction of a second as the one who uncovered the identity of this Agent of Anti-Life before the voice of the Viceroy thundered out again.
"Long live the Commonwealth!"
An explosion of magisterial brilliance finished off the video before its illusory screen flickered out of existence, the Simian who had conjured it speaking out.
"This Record has already been spread to all the stretches of the Commonwealth.
You've made it in one of the disseminated videos of our dear great leader even before becoming a Protector- a rite of passage!"
A record of propaganda.
Noah didn't even get a chance to reply before the aura of the Omniversal Entity blazed.
"Enough of that.
Osmont, this lazy thing that can't read the room is Protector Actaeon, and this is Protector Orpheus and Protector Ajax."
The three powerful Royal Simians who seemed to be on the cusp of breaking their shackles and entering the Omniversal Realm nodded towards Noah.

The Omniversal Entity then pointed to herself and the other woman who looked just like her on the nearby throne- a woman who was sitting on her throne while dangling her legs in the air freely as she had the same red hair on her head and was adorned in a simple white battle robe!
"To my left is Protector Lucretia, and I am the Command Protector of the Equestris Protectors- Protector Valeria."
Command Protector Valeria.
The woman emanated profound beauty and valor as she stared without blinking at Noah after she introduced everyone.
Noah smiled as he spoke out in turn.
"Protector Osmont.
I'm here to learn and observe exactly what it is we fight against."
"Mmm, Osmont eh?" With her legs still dangling in the air freely, Protector Lucretia twisted her body slightly to look at Noah as she continued.

As he spoke, he looked at the massive illusory display of an Outerversal Morphon that looked like an octahedron that shot out endless tentacles towards a group of Protectors in a Domain where existence looked decimated and destroyed.
"Mmm, Osmont eh?" With her legs still dangling in the air freely, Protector Lucretia twisted her body slightly to look at Noah as she continued.
"I heard you are able to sniff out Agents of Anti-Life.
How exactly do you do this?
Do you just sniff them out or does there need to be a fight?"
She seemed to hold immeasurable curiosity as her red eyes and hair shone with a stellar brilliance.
Noah looked at her with sharp eyes as he smiled while walking towards an empty throne already put in place amidst these powerful entities.
"My authority has to come in contact with their Existence."
"Oh..." Hearing this, the curiosity and interest in the eyes of Protector Lucretia faded, her gaze going back to the image of the Outerversal Morphon portrayed above them.
Command Protector Valeria gave her a side eye as she gazed towards Noah and spoke out.
"Don't pay too much heed to her wither and simply focus on your assigned tasks.
Having just come from a newly discovered Omniverse, you likely do not know much about what Protectors truly do across the Omniverses.
Such information will be critical in understanding before we set off for our next Incursion."
As she spoke, she waved her hands to minimize the image of the Outerversal Morphon and added a terrifying Worm of Existence beside it.
"Outerversal Morphon and Worms of Existence.

We designate the former as Anti-Life and the latter as Anti-Existence- with these two forces...having decimated or occupied more Omniverses than those that the Commonwealth has discovered and brought under their protection."
BOOM!
Heavy information echoed out that caused Noah's eyes to constrict.
He didn't know their reach was so extensive.
The other part of himself had just arrived in the Megalos Beyond as he didn't discover the structure and weavings of how these terrifying Morphons worked fully!
With a stern gaze, Command Protector Valeria continued by declassifying important information and sharing it with the new Protector freely.
"We are on the side of life.
On the side of Existence.
The Worms of Existence...I truly hate this name for them as their existence is Anti-Existence, with the Omniverses they have devoured becoming Nests filled with Weavings of Anti-Matter."
"Then, there are the Outerversal Morphons.
The Omniverses they conquer and transform are made into domains of Dark Matter!"
Anti-Matter!
Dark Matter!

chapters.title: Chapter 3233 Matter! I
paragraphs: The Worms of Existence- or truly, Worms of Anti-Existence, decimate and devour Omniverses as eventually, they turn into Nests full onto Anti-Matter.
Meanwhile, Outerversal Morphons transform Omniverses into domains filled with Dark Matter!
Was this what the Megalos Beyond was made of?
Immense and endless weavings of Dark Matter? Noah's Existence churned as it felt like countless networks were connecting as many pieces came together!

In front of him, the stellar crimson hair of Command Protector Valeria radiated continued wonder as the illusory scene above them showed the Outerversal Morphon and Worm of Anti-Existence disappearing.
In their place, two singularities could be seen- one white, and one black.
"Let's take a step back and go towards the Origin of all things. What happens when Matter and Anti-Matter meet?"
The singularities of black and white gravitated around each other, a heavy pull sucking one towards the other as when they came in contact...
BOOM!
"Whenever Matter and Anti-Matter meet, there is a complete annihilation of both types- with their masses all being converted to energy- into photons"
A scatter of light was all that could be seen.

"Some theorists of the Commonwealth call this Rationality, Continuum, Pertinency, or Relativity. The idea is that all forms of early energy were equal to mass and the product of the speed of light on that set domain. Thus, whenever Matter and Anti-Matter meet, their mass annihilates each other, as all that is left are photons. Just...light and nothing else. Endless eons of light. Endless cycles of light."
In between their thrones, the two singularities of Matter and Anti-Matter exploded into incandescent brilliance of light.
At this moment, even the visage of Protector Lucretia who was dangling her legs seeking to portray her boredom couldn't help but focus with interest.
And Command Protector Valeria continued without batting an eye as above them, countless white and black singularities bloomed.

"Earliest theories state that there is no matter without anti-matter. That for countless eons, particles of Matter and Anti-Matter constantly clashed and annihilated each other. There was only the mixture of Matter and Anti-Matter destroying each other and birthing an endless existence of only photons. Only light. But then....something happened. Out of trillions of computations and clashes of Matter and Anti-Matter, a particle of Matter...did not find a counterpart Anti-Matter. It did not turn into pure energy."
HUUM!
Countless white and black singularities clashed and disappeared into light.
And yet...one white particle remained floating- no counterpart to smash into it!

"Matter that did not turn into pure energy like all the endless cycles of transformations before it. It...acted like a spark. It was a change. This single particle of Matter...is theorized to make all of this."
Command Protector Valeria waved her hands around her surroundings.
All of it.
Everything around them.
All the Omniverses.
All of them.
From a single particle of matter!
Her face was illustrious as if she had peered into the secrets of Existence and was revealing them freely.

"Of course, if there was a single particle of Matter that wasn't able to find a counterpart Anti-Matter, then it means there was a lone particle of Anti-Matter out there. Anti-Matter that could have given birth to who knows what. This...is who we refer to as Worms of Existence. Worms of Anti-Existence. Entities that nullify most of the weavings of Existence from us- from our Matter."

"Entities that make us work extra hard to manipulate our own weavings of Existence to ensure that when we and then meet, it is not just annihilation. Because from their end, they have managed to do something that makes it so a lot of our weavings of Existence are ineffective against them, and only when we start touching upon higher stages of Existence can we manipulate things to stand against them."
She waved her hands as everything faded.
Noah silently stared at her as his mind buzzed- especially the Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities that were used as the backbone of the Infinite Omniverse.
Especially Manadynamics, Entropy, but more so than all of them...
Relativity!
It was currently dancing with profound radiance as if it was saying.
My origins are grand. What I represent is unfathomable!
HUUM!
Within him, the weavings of the Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Relativity began to burn with heavy brilliance.
"Of course, all of this is just theory."
Command Protector Valeria continued in her multicolored Omniversal Armament.

Her beauty was something unheard of as her fair face glinted with immense power, charm, and intellect as she looked around the Protectors who would be moving under her and continued while her gaze locked back onto Noah.
"You may then ask, what about the Outerversal Morphons? Their association with Dark Matter? How do they fit into all of this?"
The Worms of Anti-Existence were related to Anti-Matter.
The Outerversal Morphons to Dark Matter.
But how did they fit into these aforementioned earlier theories?
The answer was...
"We don't know."
The face of Command Protector Valeria was calm as she uttered such a cold fact.
They truly didn't know.
"That is why even though their threat levels vary, we understand Dark Matter much less than Anti-Matter as Outerversal Morphons are a terrifying enigma."

"Dark Matter does not interact normally with Matter. An unknown force with unknown effects. It is invisible to us for the most part, and we only understand it by understanding its effects on us and Omniverses. We don't know how Outerversal Morphons latch onto and control our own people. How they share their power and taint things in such destructive ways. But...we are getting close to a breakthrough."
WAA!
What breakthrough?
Noah was thoroughly listening for more, but Command Protector Valeria seemed to have come to a wall as she didn't say any more about this.

The Protectors in the surrounding thrones looked at each other with smiles and interest as if they knew something, and Noah took the silence in stride as after getting here, Command Protector Valeria turned towards another direction entirely as she asked lightly.
"Putting all of this together, Protector Osmont, what do you know about the Three Body Problem?"
The Three Body Problem.
Noah heard this term for the first time inside the Obelisk of the Protectors!

chapters.title: Chapter 3234 Matter! II
paragraphs: "The Three Body Problem is a term that Old Man Eudemus has mentioned recently, and it talks about three objects- three bodies orbiting each other."
Around Command Protector Valeria, weavings of nearby Existence began to gather around her as she seemed like a teller of glorious truth.
Above them, three pulsing singularities appeared as they began to rotate and gravitate around each other.

"The very nature of their orbiting is full of chaos, and nothing can truly predict the three bodies rotating around each other. This unpredictable nature makes it so that small, minuscule changes to any initial conditions can lead to unfathomably drastic differences over time. This...is how Old Man Eudemus is looking at us, the Worms of Existence, and the Outerversal Morphons."
WAA!

"Three bodies with unpredictable trajectories, and not a single possible solution in sight. If we do seek a solution though, we could try it by brute force and simplify the Three Body Problem by eliminating one of the bodies or both the other two bodies. It is much simpler to solve a two body problem or a one body problem."
"The utter annihilation of any bodies would truly...make things so much simpler."

A heavy silence hung in the air. "Well, at least that is what I proposed to Old Man Eudemus when he mentioned this idea, but he then looked at me like a fool while shooing me away. But this is the crux of the issues plaguing us today."
Command Protector Valeria finished her introductory presentation as on the other throne; Protector Lucretia clapped while smiling.
"Alright Sis, you've scared the new guy entirely with how massive of a problem we all face. Why don't we now go back to the mission at hand? The new guy can catch up on what we plan to do next."
Protector Lucretia spoke freely as her sister, Command Protector Valeria, gazed at her with sharp eyes that seemed to radiate a silent warning.

Lucretia said nothing else as she harrumphed, but in the next moment, Command Protector Valeria waved her hands as the rotating scene of three stellar bodies faded, and the image of a terrifying Outerversal Morphon that was there before Noah had arrived returned.
Noah gazed at it with calm eyes as he thought of everything he had just attained.

A more comprehensive source of information regarding the wonders and oddities out there unfolded, with Noah having grasped everything wonderfully as in the corner of his eyes, he stared at the red-haired woman with her legs dangling in the air with a bored expression.
Yes.
This was a very interesting group of Protectors to find himself in.
An Omniversal Entity in the lead, and..
When he looked at Protector Lucretia...
[Protector Lucretia]
[Outerversal Descent System of Existence Echelon 5 (38,558,822/50,000,000)]
Yes.
The one that seemed similar to the Omniversal Realm Command Protector Valeria, the sister, had another Identity Noah had already seen through- this Entity being a Delegatus of terrifying stature!
She was already an Echelon higher than Noah in terms of her Unknown System of Existence, and her Echelon as a Delegatus of an Unknown Outerversal Morphon was actually as powerful as her Sister.
From the perspective of Matter- of these Omniverses, she was just below the Omniversal Realm in power.
But in the perspective of Dark Matter- of the Megalos Beyond, she could already be considered of the Omniversal Realm in power just like Command Protector Valeria!
Noah smiled at such a finding as he kept it entirely to himself and listened on.

"The target we are going to be coming across next is one sitting at the top of an Omniverse halfway turned into a Domain full of Dark Matter. A Half Tainted Omniverse. Transformed Agents of Anti-Life fill it to the brim as at the forefront is this Outerversal Morphon that has descended from a powerful Half-Omniversal Entity who had controlled this Omniverse since eons ago. The identity of our target...has been analyzed to be Outerversal Morphon Savitar."
WAA!
On the illusory screen.
A massive purple skull could be seen, thousands of equally titanic arms protruding from behind this skull as they grasped entire Existential Domains and threw them in its jaws.
On the sockets of this skull, purple flames burned brightly as around it, swathes of stellar obsidian brilliance already covered everything.
It was the taint of the Megalos Beyond as far as Noah could see!
Command Protector Valeria continued.

"This form of Outerversal Morphon Savitar has been seen in 19 other Tainted Omniverses. It is powerful, but a weak body like this one is susceptible and possible to eradicate. The issue for all of you to acclimate to is the speed of the Transformed Agents of Anti-Life within this Half Tainted Omniverse and the speed of Outerversal Morphon Savitar himself. In a blink, your entire Existence could have been eradicated before you even do a thing."

"The Main Objective of the mission will be achieved when this body of Outerversal Morphon Savitar is destroyed as by getting past it, we will get the chance to destroy the Dark Matter Core that has been eating away and transforming that Half Tainted Omniverse. A normal Omniverse has no such core as it is made up of rulings that govern its weavings, but Outerversal Morphons taint and pull everything within an Omniverse into a single Dark Matter Core. This needs to be destroyed."
On the illusory screen, a radiant obsidian stellar singularity that was pulsing with irregularities was shown above them.
Noah looked at it as he asked lightly.
"And what happens once a Dark Matter Core is destroyed?"
First, erase the Outerversal Morphon Savitar and his forces.
Then, the Dark Matter Core!
But what did this accomplish?
Command Protector Valeria looked at him calmly before she replied.

"The Half Tainted Omniverse will be destroyed soon after. We will have prevented the formation of a fully Tainted Omniverse that greatly enhances the power of Savitar and allows him and other Outerversal Morphons just like him to elevate themselves greatly in power."
The Destruction of an Omniverse.
Granted, it was a Half-Tainted Omniverse that an Outerversal Morphon had already conquered, but wondrously...this would be the objective of Noah's first mission within the Equestris Protectors!

chapters.title: Chapter 3235 Fabled! I
paragraphs: The next Target of the Equestris Protectors was a body of the Outerversal Morphon Savitar that reigned over a Half Tainted Omniverse, and after this target was defeated, they would be able to destroy the Dark Matter Core that began forming the moment the Omniverse was first Tainted.
Destroy the Dark Matter Core, and the Half Tainted Omniverse itself would follow!
Noah repeated these words to himself as he looked at the calm figures of the five Protectors around him and asked.
"Why just destroy this Dark Matter Core? Why not study it since we are looking for the solution for the Three Body Problem- for understanding Dark Matter, Anti-Matter, and Matter itself?"
He asked as he received raised eyebrows from Protector Lucretia who was a hidden Delegatus of an Unknown Outerversal Morphon, and Command Protector Valeria replied while shaking her head.

"We've tried many times to study the Dark Matter Cores we come across. An Omniversal Protector even tried absorbing into his own Fabled Omniverse, and the only thing that happened was everything within it becoming Tainted, his Fabled Omniverse acting as an Anchor that the Dark Matter Core resided in as from it came the Descent of an Outerversal Morphon that went on to decimate a dozen Omniverses before he was pushed back."
Terrifying words echoed out from Command Protector Valeria as Noah gained another burst of history and information.
She was about to continue, but he stopped her with an interjection.
"Fabled Omniverse?"
The Omniversal Realm.
He wanted to peer more information on the stage of power of these beings, and Command Protector Valeria humored him as she smiled wryly for the first time and replied.

"I guess you wouldn't readily know or have access to this information yet. To combat the weavings of Dark Matter and Anti-Matter over the eons, the Commonwealth looked at the best ways to purify existence to reach a terrifying pinnacle that could not be easily nullified or negated against them. The answer was the construction of one's existence into the smallest unit of Matter. A Quark."
HUUM!
A Quark!

"Something that could possibly be traced back to the theories of Matter and Anti-Matter colliding. That everything was composed of Quarks or clusters of quarks, and from them...everything came to be. So the Commonwealth devised of a way to purify one's existence into a Quark, and from this single Quark...birth an extremely pure form of Existence. Something containing everything about you- your records, your power, your personality, and all else, but purified to an unfathomable level as at the end, you can establish your Fabled Omniverse."
As she spoke.
Around her body, Command Protector Valeria began to emanate a heavy pressure as a crimson illusory circle of unfathomable weavings began to circle around her.
The moment she did so, all weavings of existence in the surroundings began to distort and twist into different directions!
The thrones they say on trembled and began to move as if pulled by an undeniable gravitational force.
Noah felt his Atlas of Existence erupt with colorless brilliance as it was barely able to resist being affected- his eyes looking towards Command Protector Valeria with blazing brilliance!
"Before this Realm of Power, nothing else matters."
Her eyes were currently aflame with crimson brilliance.
They didn't seem like the eyes of any normal Life Form- but akin to a being that had crossed over some unexpected and unfathomable stage!

"From a single Quark blooms countless others of immeasurable purity, everything about you being gathered to form a Fabled Omniverse. This Fabled Omniverse...transforms your existence in a way that makes it capable and extremely efficient in withstanding Dark Matter and Anti-Matter. Almost as if you have taken yourself back to a time before any omniverses, when only Quarks smashed into each other endlessly. This...is the level you should all be seeking to obtain as only when you arrive here can you truly enact any sort of significant change on the larger weavings of Existence. On the Wheel of Existence!"
WAA!
She finished her words as the circular brilliance she released was retracted into her body, everything around them calming down as everybody had their own unique expressions!
The three Royal Existential Omniversal Simians on their own thrones looked towards Command Protector Valeria with looks of hidden respect and adoration.
Protector Lucretia looked towards her sister with a gaze that briefly showed mixed emotions, while Noah looked at her as if he had found a piece of a treasure he wanted to dissect!
Her red hair danced wildly as she continued.

"A Fabled Omniverse is one of the purest and most stable forms of power, and yet when one took in a Dark Matter Core, it became Tainted. So as strong as we have become, Devouring or Assimilating Dark Matter or Anti-Matter into ourselves has never worked. Only destruction or Annihilation provides any leeway."
Destruction was the only path.
Noah smiled at this as Entropy continued to seethe among the many extremes within Noah that were currently surging.
He rubbed his chin thoughtfully as he turned towards Protector Lucretia while voicing out.
"Isn't an Agent of Anti-Life someone that has successfully assimilated Dark Matter into them? With the level of their Existence being raised much higher?"
He asked such a question while looking at Protector Lucretia whose identity as a Delegatus was unknown by those around her.
Her brows seemed to rise questioningly towards him as if asking him- why the hell are you directing such a question to me?
Her defiant beauty was a sight to see as Nkah smiled while turning to Command Protector Valeria who was always replying sternly.

"Tainted Existences is what they are, nothing more. As you saw yourself, a small flicker of your power unraveled their impure dominium and caused the Agent of Anti-Life to reveal the weak traces of its Outerversal Morphon. Dark Matter, Anti-Matter...these two will never mix or assimilate with Matter. This...is not the answer to our existence, nor the answer to the Three Body Problem."

chapters.title: Chapter 3236 Fabled! II
paragraphs: Her gaze was stern.
Noah nodded at this point as he stopped asking questions.
Command Protector Valeria looked at him carefully before she voiced out.

"As a Protector, you gain Weavings of Contribution whenever you do anything on behalf of the Commonwealth. If you perform well in the takedown of one of the bodies of Outerversal Morphon Savitar, you should be able to gain the method of compressing everything about you into a Quark before you can forge your own Fabled Omniverse. After your existence is nurtured and elevated to a high enough level, along with exemplary records and with a strong foundation, a powerful Fabled Omniverse may appear within the Commonwealth. And we need as many Omniversal Entities as we can since others are either too lazy or not talented enough."
Her last words were directed to her sister and the Simian Protectors who laughed dryly while looking at each other.
Noah merely nodded at Command Protector Valeria as he replied.
"Very well. When do we set off towards this Half Tainted Omniverse?"
The multicolored Omniversal Armament is his hands trembled with excitement.
The brows of all Protectors rose as Protector Lucretia scoffed and spoke out.
"This newbie actually has no fear of what Outerversal Morphons are capable of...if only you knew the number of Protectors just like you that die to them."
The nature of the job of the Protectors was a tough one.

Unlike what the masses of the Commonwealth believed, they were not invincible instruments and shields to protect them as when they did go against the truly terrifying enemies aligned with Dark Matter and Anti-Matter, their casualties were high!
Thus, more seeds were sought from artificial weavings like the Gladiators Arena.
To bring out any unsharpened Gems to light and have them be forged to become swords of the Commonwealth.
Command Protector Valeria looked at her sister with sharp eyes as she rebuked her words.
"For some people, it is not that they have no fear, but their Existence can already feel the urge against enemies that will not hesitate to decimate all of us."
"For our mission...all parameters have been cleared as within the next day, we will set off towards the Half Tainted Omniverse where one of the bodies of Outerversal Morphon Savitar resides."
Her last words were stated as she shifted her gaze from Protector Lucretia and towards Noah.
The parameters were set.
The pathway was clear!

The first true clash against an Outerversal Morphon within these vast Omniverses...its stage was set as who knew just what weavings would unfold? Within the same Obelisk of the Protectors where Noah was with the Equestris Protectors.
On another floor, another body of his appeared past a white portal into a fantastical expansion that shone with gold and white hues of light.

It was a Miniature Existential Domain within the Obelisk of the Protectors, and yet it seemed to stretch out endlessly as all around, one could see the radiant floating books, scrolls, and scriptures of different varieties floating serenely as if they were stellar bodies.
This was the Existential Library that contained the vast array of knowledge of the Commonwealth over the eons.
Knowledge of Systems of Existence among many others.
Of the variable Omniverses out there and different types of Existences that could be found.
Of course, Noah didn't think that any of this knowledge that a Protector like him could easily have access to was the core of what the Commonwealth knew, but its gains should still be significant!
He didn't expect to find any intricacies regarding the Wheel of Existence here, but at the very least, he could supplement eons worth of knowledge into his own Library in the Infinite Omniverse.
He floated towards the dazzling books and scrolls all around him as like a tide, his will went towards each of them to absorb whatever knowledge they held.

Around him, uniquely dressed Royal Existential Omniversal Simians and other forms of Existence only glanced towards his direction briefly after his entrance before each of them went back to whatever they were doing.

It was only a single pair of eyes within the far depths of the Existential Library that remained focused on him after he entered, and they belonged to a robed Royal Existential Omniversal Simian who crossed her legs while reading a thick crimson-covered book with the title- [Morphology of Outerversal Morphons].
Pure gold fur lined up her entire body, her gaze becoming locked onto Noah silently as around her, a faint illusion of a Fabled Omniverse shone!
She tapped her fingers silently on the book she was reading as her gaze never left a certain area for even a second.
Away from this vibrant Existential Library.
There was another vast Library that held Records of countless weavings of Existence, skills, and other oddities within.
Inside the Infinite Omniverse.
Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Entropy walked through grandiose golden bookshelves that held books radiating glory.
The floor he stepped on shone with golden brilliance as everything around him burned with majesty, and his voice emanated out calmly as his hands held a book with the title of [Relativity].
"Dedicate a major percentage of your weavings to the understanding and analysis of Matter, Dark Matter, Anti-Matter, and the Three Body Problem."
|Yes, Master.|
He spoke out to nobody, and yet a voice of affirmation rang out in his mind as he continued.

"Anything to do with the theories of the weavings of existence itself. Atoms, Quarks, String Theory...expand it all under the banner of the research into the Wheel of Existence. Let's see if our inclination towards Matter and Anti-Matter will lead towards any results that the Commonwealth has not come across..."
He had a part of himself on what could be considered the side of Matter.
His body here.
The Infinite Omniverse he soon wanted to change as he paused with caution some more before establishing a connection between the Infinite Omniverse and Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias.
It would be a connection between Matter and Dark Matter.
What would he be able to learn from it if he actually went through with it?
There were many unknowns as he proceeded with care!

chapters.title: Chapter 3237 Origins I
paragraphs: As his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Entropy crossed the golden halls of an endless Library.

In front of his eyes, numbers had continued to rise as inadvertently...his body pulsed with a wave of colorless radiance as from the surroundings weavings of space, threads of countless weavings of Existential Extremity Authorities made themselves prevalent to him.
[You have stepped into the Fourth Echelon of the Conceptual System of Existence.]
The Fourth Echelon.
The stage where most of the powerful Apogee Autarchs stayed.

For Noah, it was the elevation of his First Mundi of Power that currently released repetitive hums- his Source of Existence where all weavings of Existential Extremity Authorities and other similar assimilated Systems were being elevated by a large margin!
|The level of access into Omniversal Authorities has reached a critical level.|
|The Breadth of your Existence has resonated with multiple Autarchical Omniversal Authorities.|
|Your Existence is one that is loved by Extremes.|
All around him, his body felt the millions of threads of Existential Extremity Authorities that made multiple Autarchical Omniversal Authorities.
How within these Autarchical Omniversal Authorities, there were clusters of Greater Omniversal Authorities that made them, and smaller clusters that composed these very same Omniversal Authorities.
Aitia led to a grander form of an Autarchical Omniversal Authority.
Pompeii led to a grander form of another Autarchical Omniversal Authority.
But at the end of the day, they stood for the same thing- just more grandiose in quality at the Autarchical Omniversal Authority stage!
And now, after taking his Conceptual System of Existence based on these very same extremes, he became an Existence that was loved those very same weavings of concepts.
Was this not...the privilege of the Omniversal Ankyra?
The entity who held free reign over multiple Autarchical Omniversal Authorities? Noah felt like he had reached such a precipice, and that at the same time, he could do much more!
|Your existence has locked onto the weavings of Autarchical Omniversal Authorities that are inherently capable of augmenting your power.|
|Through Aitia, the Component of Efficiency has been selected and expanded upon- with the weavings of your Existence being taken towards Absolute Efficiency.|
Absolute Efficiency.
100% Efficiency!
Something he could only change by decimal points before, and yet now....he was capable of rushing towards its absolute extreme as his existence reached a whole new level.
But it wasn't just this.
|The weavings of the flow of the Spacetime Continuum can be further augmented and modified within the Infinite Omniverse.|
|Your distinction as the Weaver of Existence and Extremity begin to exceed established parameters.|
|The weavings of Invictus Maximus get ever closer.|
He...felt the influx of far too many things at this moment actually.
But he slowed it all down as he breathed.
His colorless wings across all of his Clones vibrated.
The Clone in this Library.
The Clone near the multicolored throne of Authorities.
The Clone near the production lines of Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction.
The Clone overseeing the possible glimpse of the carving of the Infinite Omniverse to make Omniversal Weapons.
The Clones that were Dual Cultivating with Adelaide, Barbatos, Sona, and others as the resonance of existence was tested.
The clones stretched out across the Infinite Omniverse carrying out a myriad of tasks, as well as the Clones in a distant Omniverse of the Protectors.
He felt all of them as they were him, and at this moment, his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Entropy raised his hand and asked lightly.
"What am I?"
A question filled with simplicity.
But Noah's intent while asking it was very methodical.
As if he wanted to understand, truly, what he was.
And to understand what he was in his entirety, he had to begin by...
"Break it all down."
WAA!
He had to break down exactly what made him as at this moment, multiple of his Clones began to be broken down.
The Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Entropy that had its hands raised observed his skin, muscles, and bones begin to break down into stellar particles.

Were he to break himself down completely, what would be the smallest thing he could observe regarding his own composition? Would he gain a better understanding of the [Matter] that made him, and how drastically different it was compared to [Dark Matter] that made his identity as an Outerversal Morphon?
He didn't yet know, but he had to see.
He had to see if he could track down his Origins!

And coincidentally, as multiple parts of himself in the Infinite Omniverse did this, his identity as an Outerversal Morphon in the Megalos Beyond was undergoing its own experience where it was connected to a unique Outerversal Morphon who was deeply inclined to the Great Beyonder that spoke of Signs and Instruments.
Away from the Infinite Omniverse.
Within the Megalos Beyond.
In the very heart of the Grave of the Great Beyonder- an Entity known as Aspasia was currently connected with Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias!
Her job was to confirm whether he was the Instrument spoken of from long-lost fables, so this being sought to deeply entrench herself and see whether this had any merit.

As she did this, Ozymandias was gaining a better grasp of Outerversal Morphons as a whole as while connected, he saw the millions of threads of obsidian brilliance stretching out from Outerversal Morphon Aspasia and towards the vast stretches of the Megalos Beyond below!
Millions of connections.
As he observed them, he wondered about the unique capability of Morphons to cast out minuscule parts of themselves across the Megalos Beyond and towards Entities of other states of Matter.
Why did their power work in such a way? Why did-?
'Oh?'
His thoughts stopped as they came to a realization.
The obsidian threads that only Aspasia should be able to see did not just extend down across the Megalos Beyond, with his will following some stretching out horizontally all around them.

And when he traversed across these threads, his gaze went past the organ they were in and quickly came to observe an endpoint within the Grave of the Great Beyonder where this thread connected to...a fairly weak Outerversal Morphon!

In the very heart of the Grave of the Great Beyonder- an Entity known as Aspasia was currently connected with Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias!
Her job was to confirm whether he was the Instrument spoken of from long-lost fables, so this being sought to deeply entrench herself and see whether this had any merit.

As she did this, Ozymandias was gaining a better grasp of Outerversal Morphons as a whole as while connected, he saw the millions of threads of obsidian brilliance stretching out from Outerversal Morphon Aspasia and towards the vast stretches of the Megalos Beyond below!
Millions of connections.
As he observed them, he wondered about the unique capability of Morphons to cast out minuscule parts of themselves across the Megalos Beyond and towards Entities of other states of Matter.
Why did their power work in such a way?
Why did-?
'Oh?'
His thoughts stopped as they came to a realization.
The obsidian threads that only Aspasia should be able to see did not just extend down across the Megalos Beyond, with his will following some stretching out horizontally all around them.

And when he traversed across these threads, his gaze went past the organ they were in and quickly came to observe an endpoint within the Grave of the Great Beyonder where this thread connected to...a fairly weak Outerversal Morphon!

chapters.title: Chapter 3238 Origins II
paragraphs: A thread connecting to another Outerversal Morphon!

Their body was smaller than most as they had the form of a rotund creature with stellar fur and limbs, and it wasn't the only one connected to Aspasia as when Noah observed other lines extending from her, they stretched out towards the vast stretches of the Megalos Beyond itself.
Of course. An Outerversal Morphon could also bind those within the Megalos Beyond.
Just like they could reach out to weavings of Matter, they could also connect to the weavings of Dark Matter similar to them!
But the former seemed to be much easier.
Noah had a pondering expression as he wanted to know more.
So he sensed the resonance of the Existence he was connected to and delved even deeper.

It was an action that caused a strong reaction, the visage of Aspasia below him radiating a blinding brilliance of obsidian light that caused half of his consciousness to be taken somewhere else entirely.
And when this consciousness opened its eyes, it found itself waking up above a calm obsidian body of water that stretched out with no end.
His reflection could be seen on it as he rose, his bare body shining with obsidian radiance reflecting back along with his powerful wings and nine Halos spinning behind him.

Even though it shone with stellar radiance, the muscular humanoid form could still be seen on its curves as his eyes, which were vibrant singularities, looked ahead of him to see the bare figure of Aspasia that seemed to be trembling slightly as she acclimated.

Her stellar obsidian skin outlines a unique blessed chest different in its finer details than what Ozymandias was normally exposed to, with her slender waist pulsing with stellar radiance as in the next moment, she waved her hands to cause a stellar obsidian robe to wrap around her figure.
She looked towards Ozymandias with a sense of modesty while breathing out calmly.
|You went a bit overboard there, but at least it brought us to this space. To the Nexus of Megalos Records.|
WAA!
|The Nexus of Megalos Records?| Ozymandias looked around them while he asked lightly.

Apart from the obsidian body of water stretching out with no end, there was only a similar hue of obsidian stellar space above them akin to the Megalos Beyond itself as it didn't seem all that different.

Aspasia nodded lightly while gazing at Ozymandias' blessed visage and the tool he had used to allow them to achieve this profound state of resonance they were currently in- her hand rising and tapping towards him as an obsidian robe came to adorn his body as well.

|Yes. It is moreso a Nexus between you and I, but the Nexus of Megalos Records exists for all Outerversal Morphons out there with a high level of power. It is a place to obtain knowledge and spread knowledge. Currently, we are in a Nexus that most closely resonates with something at the depths of my being. Something relating to the Great Beyonder. It is here that I will be able to rely on his weavings to come to any confirmation about who you are.|
|I see...|

Ozymandias scratched his stellar chin as he wondered, was he about to get exposed here? He could already do everything that these entities believed as he passed this Aspasia before him, everything would be set in stone.
He looked at her figure as he asked.
|Just who is the Great Beyonder?|
A name that rose ever since his entry into the Megalos Beyond!
A name with tremendous influence as its words were believed with damn near certainty.

Aspasia looked at him with analytical eyes as she waved her hands above and caused the stellar space to change- the outline of a blurry figure appearing as his sheer outline alone caused the space above to tremble.
|The Great Beyonder is one of the Oldest Outerversal Morphons known.|
|Is?|
Aspasia spoke in the present tense.
And she nodded in affirmation as she continued.

|Is. He has disappeared for many cycles now, but he is not dead. We may be in a place called the Grave of the Great Beyonder, but this is simply a distinction and a place to honor him that Outerversal Morphons converge in. There are other places like this stretched out across the Megalos Beyond. Think of them like Shrines of the Great Beyonder as we await his return. If he chooses to return.|
An Entity surrounded by tremendous mystery.
Noah thought about his standing deeply as he probed.

|From the weavings I've heard, he disappeared after he made the revelations that put us where we are now. About Signs and an Instrument that would either expand or annihilate the Megalos Beyond. Why would he...disappear?|
A question seeking to get to the crux of the beliefs of the Outerversal Morphons.
And Aspasia took it in strides as she began to walk on the calm black Sea towards him while replying.

|Heretical Morphons like to believe that he paid a great cost to see the possible end or expansion of the Megalos Beyond. That his weavings unraveled and he spread out across the Megalos Beyond- with some areas converging clusters of his weavings as these became known as the Graves of the Great Beyonder.|
She arrived in front of him as her radiant obsidian skin pulsed with pure glory, her palm rising in front of him as Ozymandias raised his own hand to reflect his stellar palm.

|We believe something else entirely. We believe the Great Beyonder achieved a level of Existence that exceeded all of us so much that we cannot even perceive him anymore unless he wishes for us to. A different level of dimensionality entirely. To him, time moves differently. Space moves differently. For him to have been capable of seeing the possible expansion or destruction of the Megalos Beyond...he had to have transcended any common concepts we understand and seen things we cannot see. We very much believe that the Great Beyonder is right here.|
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3239 Origins III
paragraphs: A heavy assertion!
Aspasia- someone that the Great Mother stated that she had a unique connection to the Great Beyonder.
She stated that without a shadow of a doubt, The Great Beyonder was alive and well.
That he had Transcended what they commonly knew and understood to reach an entirely different dimension of existence!
Her palm was stretched out.
His own palm came forward as at this moment, waves began to pulse between them as their palms got closer and closer to each other.

|The Great Beyonder could be watching all of this right now, and we wouldn't be able to know. He could be watching our bodies out there, or even be capable of somehow seeing into this Nexus of Megalos Records that only you and I are in.|
This was a terrifying level of power.
If it was true.
Ozymandias looked at Aspasia closely as he spoke inquisitively.
|You speak with great confidence in this. What gives you such confidence?|
HUUM!
Their palms touched after bursts of singularities clashed between them, waves of resonance spreading as the singularities of Aspasia smiled.

|The Sign and the possible Instrument that the Great Beyonder spoke of...actually showing skepticism about the Great Beyonder. How interesting. Let us see whether you are this Instrument, Outerversal Morphon Ozymandias.|
Waves of Outerversal Authority pulsed between them.
Aspasia seemed to be looking for a specific frequency of something.

And Ozymandias...was gazing at the very depths of what made himself. Just like his counterpart of Noah Osmont was breaking down weavings of Matter, Ozymandias sought to understand the component of the Dark Matter that made him!
Matter.
Across the myriad of Omniverses, everything was made up of matter.
Matter could be broken down into the smaller components known as Atoms!
Trillions upon quintillions and quintillions of atoms, endless particles that were too many to even count.
At this moment, Noah broke himself down entirely as after his body flickered into a stellar mass of cells, these cells further separated.
All of it required careful and effortful usage of Existential Extremity Authority.
The colorless Authority of the Laborer was coursing through him and everything within him as he found that Innately, all the matter that made him sought to be in what it considered a natural form.
A natural state.
And that was his humanoid body.
If he wasn't actively continuing to apply the pressure and authority, the countless particles he had broken himself down into would come together in fantastical weavings to reform back into himself!
|Your Weavings have naturally triggered a state of profound epiphany and understanding.|
As the Weaver, he was coming to learn many things about himself.
Especially when he watched the weavings of his Atlas of Existence be broken down, and different colored musings showed themselves for all 9 different Mundis of Power.
He applied even greater authority as rapidly, it seemed like a cloud of stellar multicolored brilliance was only expanding and being magnified around the golden halls of an extensive library!
Cells broke down rapidly and became atoms.
It may have seemed like something simple, but who could say they could easily break down their very existence into countless smaller compartments and observe them all freely?
When Noah broke himself down to countless atoms, he went even further to break this down as he began to feel the weavings of many Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities buzzing!
Strong Nuclear Force. Weak Nuclear Force. Entropy. Manadynamics. Relativity. Electromagnetism. Gravitation...
Many concepts seemed to swirl heavily as he peered deeply into the weavings of his atoms, his going even deeper as he seamlessly broke his atoms down into Proton, Neutrons, and Electrons!
When he arrived here, he felt a strain.
His existence became an endless field of dense multicolored particles as from them...he began to sense faint waves. Waves.
Strings.
Among these silent waves, other particles flowed here and there as they didn't seem as significant, but even they played a role.

Everything seemed to be moving and tugged with weavings of Existential waves of light, but as he looked at the smallest breakdown of atoms- at his Quintessential Protons, Neutrons, and Electrons, he found that they still seemed too big.
His penetrative gaze could see they were made of something even smaller!
This was...
|Quarks...|
HUUM!
The moment his intent buzzed out their identity, he saw his Protons and neutrons break apart to become blinding singularities that were Quarks.
But only his Neutrons and Protons!
His Electrons...they broke into different singularities that did not seem at all like Quarks.
They moved differently.
They spun differently.
They were tugged by different forces within his existence as the more he looked at them, he could feel his distinction as the Weaver analyze them as quickly, a word rose in his mind!
|Leptons...|
Quarks and Leptons.
This was what he came across as the smallest fundamental parts of himself, his Authority of the Laborer buzzing at it felt a great strain trying to go any further!

He had learned of Quarks and how the Commonwealth had those who had reached a terrifying level of Existence condense everything they had into a single Quark that they would bloom into countless others to form a Fabled Omniverse.
But Command Protector Valeria didn't speak of anything to do with Leptons.
These were also small, minuscule particles that made him!
Their interactions.
How they behaved.
All of it was what made what he did possible.
Lifting a single finger.
Activating Mana.
Utilizing Existential Extremity Authority.
Around the interactions and weavings of his Quarks and Leptons, he could see threads- strings of Existential Extremity Authorities flowing through them!

And this whole time, even though his Authority was stopping it- the countless particles that made him wanted to resume their normal interactions to return to the glorious humanoid form, with Noah theorizing that no matter how he disrupted them, they would always return to be him.
These were his origins.
At this moment, he remembered the one thing Command Protector Valeria mentioned regarding Matter, Anti-Matter, Dark Matter, and the Three Body Problem.

Across the interactions of these three states, their unpredictability and interactions meant that even a small, insignificant change to initial conditions at this level could lead to unfathomable and unpredictable massive changes later on.
He looked across his broken down existence as he saw the colorful Quarks and Leptons that made up his Conceptual System of Existence.
He saw that the assimilated Systems he had taken in, whether it be from the Faesigned Queen, the Satyrus Nymph, or the Sunwinged Leprechanus...they all were still made up of Quarks and Leptons!
They were seamlessly assimilated, but he could still recognize them.
His Systems. Their Systems.
Ultimately, they were all made up of Matter!

chapters.title: Chapter 3240 Origins IV
paragraphs: Matter.
The components that made all different weavings of Existence.

In his state of profundity and epiphany, he was coming to realize that the different Weavings of Existence- the different Systems of Existence that entities utilized...were simply made up of different interactions of Matter. A difference in the makeup, weaving, or interaction of quarks and leptons that made an Existence!
There were other particles he couldn't yet readily see, but quarks and leptons made up the vast majority.
If they were too similar, his Atlas of Existence distinguished it as so.
Their interactions were grouped to be similar to his Conceptual System of Existence, and so they were assimilated into it!
They could be assimilated smoothly because of these similarities, and this only acted to further strengthen the weavings and interactions of the System placed in his First Mundi of Power.
If they were sufficiently different, their interactions and makeup would also explain this!
They wouldn't be able to assimilate smoothly due to their interactions and makeup being too different, and so they would be designated to have their own placement in another Mundi of Power.
The Outerversal Descent System of Existence was like this.
Its makeup was entirely different.
He looked at what made up the weavings of the Outerversal Descent System of Existence.
It was...starkly different.
He couldn't clearly make out the configuration of their smallest particles, nor whether they were made up of Quarks or Leptons entirely.
It seemed to be a mixture.
A mixture filled with Uncertainty.
A stable interaction of what he knew to be Matter, and the wonders of oddities known as Dark Matter!
The moment he saw this, he became certain.
And his will vibrated from the cloud of quarks and leptons as it buzzed out.
|We shall proceed with the connection between Ozymandias and the Infinite Omniverse.|
WAA!
Yes!

After observing the interaction of his own weavings of Matter and how the connection between him and Ozymandias interacted with each other, he was convinced that he had done his due diligence along with all the computations that the Infinite Omniverse itself made, and there should be no adverse effects from him pulling the weavings of the Megalos Beyond into the Infinite Omniverse!
|Yes, Master.|
And so, his will was carried out.
He didn't worry about what could be or what may come. He only got ready to observe how fantastical the interactions of Matter and Dark Matter would be on an Omniversal scale.
Far from here.
Within the Megalos Beyond itself where Ozymandias was connected to Aspasia, with part of their consciousness meeting in the Nexus of Megalos Records.
Here, Ozymandias could feel the weavings and interactions that seemed to be of even greater complexity than those of Matter, with his eyes constantly seeking to analyze and understand.
At this moment, Aspasia was looking for 'something' to tie him to an instrument that an ancient being spoke about cycles ago.
He was unsure whether what he had already done was enough to give her the thing she was looking for, so at this moment...he moved to fabricate it.
She was looking for something, so he would give her something!
HUUM!
From the interminable visage of Ozymandias, a massive tentacle larger than any he had released before erupted between his spinning Halos and was cast down.
It was cast across the organ they were in and through the Grave of the Great Beyonder, going across the Megalos Beyond as it already had a purpose and direction!
It wasn't seeking a Delegatus of simple standing or nature- with its target not even being an entity in the common scope of understanding.
Its target was an Omniverse.
And not just any Omniverse, but the Infinite Omniverse that held the oddity and wonder and endless expansion.
He didn't know what the full result of his actions would be, but within the scope of a fraction of an instant...
BOOM!
The obsidian fishing line of Ozymandias flowed across endless weavings, through the connection of Noah Osmont, and into the heart of his unbreakable connection with the Infinite Omniverse.
|Another unbreakable bond is being forged.|
|A connection spanning across different scopes of Existence is being stabilized.|
His Existence trembled.
His Atlas of Existence spun with glory.
The Infinite Omniverse buzzed.
The visage of Ozymandias shook as the Entity he was connected to suddenly felt the eruption of something she had never sensed before.
This...what was this?!
She didn't know.
Nobody else would know but the person responsible for carrying out a heavy action at this moment!
|Stability has been achieved.|
Noah felt every part of himself trembling as the interactions that made up everything around him seemed to be actively moving faster and faster.
He was still being taken towards absolute efficiency as everything about his existence was rising, and with the completion of this grand achievement...
|A stable pathway between the Megalos Beyond and the Infinite Omniverse has been established.|
|A pathway for Matter and Dark Matter has been formed.|
It seemed like a massive road that nobody could see.
Its structure seemed unbreakable as it radiated stellar obsidian radiance, and the moment it was fully stabilized...all of the surroundings of Ozymandias began to tremble.
The Grave of the Great Beyonder they were in began to buzz as from all around, the structure and weavings of the Megalos Beyond twisted as they began to curve and draw towards Ozymandias.
As if they knew that the undertaking that was about to occur would need an endless infusion of authority!
Outside of the Barrier of the Grave of the Great Beyonder, a heavy standoff was taking place between powerful Outerversal Morphons- some with the distinction of [Great] in their names.
From among them, the eyes of the Observer of Old and Young were the brightest as his senses covered everything.
He was the first to notice the oddity as far above the Grave of the Great Beyonder, he observed the Megalos Beyond to distort.
From this distortion, waves of stellar obsidian radiance then exploded outwards as the gorgeous hue of the Megalos Beyond...began to form small points of dew drops.
Dew drops.
Within the Megalos Beyond.
These dew drops began with the Grave of the Great Beyonder at the center, but gradually began to spread outwards.
It was...rain.
Rain in the fantastical space of the Megalos Beyond.
Seeing such a thing, The Observer of Old and Young sighed as around him, the Great Mother also noticed it and began to tremble with fanaticism!
It was...another Sign that the Great Beyonder had spoken of!
