A difference in the makeup, weaving, or interaction of quarks and leptons that made an Existence!
There were other particles he couldn't yet readily see, but quarks and leptons made up the vast majority.
If they were too similar, his Atlas of Existence distinguished it as so.
Their interactions were grouped to be similar to his Conceptual System of Existence, and so they were assimilated into it!
They could be assimilated smoothly because of these similarities, and this only acted to further strengthen the weavings and interactions of the System placed in his First Mundi of Power.
If they were sufficiently different, their interactions and makeup would also explain this!
They wouldn't be able to assimilate smoothly due to their interactions and makeup being too different, and so they would be designated to have their own placement in another Mundi of Power.
The Outerversal Descent System of Existence was like this.
Its makeup was entirely different.
He looked at what made up the weavings of the Outerversal Descent System of Existence.
It was...starkly different.
He couldn't clearly make out the configuration of their smallest particles, nor whether they were made up of Quarks or Leptons entirely.
It seemed to be a mixture.
A mixture filled with Uncertainty.
A stable interaction of what he knew to be Matter, and the wonders of oddities known as Dark Matter!
The moment he saw this, he became certain.
And his will vibrated from the cloud of quarks and leptons as it buzzed out.
|We shall proceed with the connection between Ozymandias and the Infinite Omniverse.|
WAA!
Yes!

After observing the interaction of his own weavings of Matter and how the connection between him and Ozymandias interacted with each other, he was convinced that he had done his due diligence along with all the computations that the Infinite Omniverse itself made, and there should be no adverse effects from him pulling the weavings of the Megalos Beyond into the Infinite Omniverse!
|Yes, Master.|
And so, his will was carried out.
He didn't worry about what could be or what may come.
He only got ready to observe how fantastical the interactions of Matter and Dark Matter would be on an Omniversal scale.
Far from here.
Within the Megalos Beyond itself where Ozymandias was connected to Aspasia, with part of their consciousness meeting in the Nexus of Megalos Records.
Here, Ozymandias could feel the weavings and interactions that seemed to be of even greater complexity than those of Matter, with his eyes constantly seeking to analyze and understand.
At this moment, Aspasia was looking for 'something' to tie him to an instrument that an ancient being spoke about cycles ago.
He was unsure whether what he had already done was enough to give her the thing she was looking for, so at this moment...he moved to fabricate it.
She was looking for something, so he would give her something!
HUUM!
From the interminable visage of Ozymandias, a massive tentacle larger than any he had released before erupted between his spinning Halos and was cast down.
It was cast across the organ they were in and through the Grave of the Great Beyonder, going across the Megalos Beyond as it already had a purpose and direction!
It wasn't seeking a Delegatus of simple standing or nature- with its target not even being an entity in the common scope of understanding.
Its target was an Omniverse.
And not just any Omniverse, but the Infinite Omniverse that held the oddity and wonder and endless expansion.
He didn't know what the full result of his actions would be, but within the scope of a fraction of an instant...
BOOM!
The obsidian fishing line of Ozymandias flowed across endless weavings, through the connection of Noah Osmont, and into the heart of his unbreakable connection with the Infinite Omniverse.
|Another unbreakable bond is being forged.|
|A connection spanning across different scopes of Existence is being stabilized.|
His Existence trembled.
His Atlas of Existence spun with glory.
The Infinite Omniverse buzzed.
The visage of Ozymandias shook as the Entity he was connected to suddenly felt the eruption of something she had never sensed before.
This...what was this?!
She didn't know.
Nobody else would know but the person responsible for carrying out a heavy action at this moment!
|Stability has been achieved.|
Noah felt every part of himself trembling as the interactions that made up everything around him seemed to be actively moving faster and faster.
He was still being taken towards absolute efficiency as everything about his existence was rising, and with the completion of this grand achievement...
|A stable pathway between the Megalos Beyond and the Infinite Omniverse has been established.|
|A pathway for Matter and Dark Matter has been formed.|
It seemed like a massive road that nobody could see.
Its structure seemed unbreakable as it radiated stellar obsidian radiance, and the moment it was fully stabilized...all of the surroundings of Ozymandias began to tremble.
The Grave of the Great Beyonder they were in began to buzz as from all around, the structure and weavings of the Megalos Beyond twisted as they began to curve and draw towards Ozymandias.
As if they knew that the undertaking that was about to occur would need an endless infusion of authority!
Outside of the Barrier of the Grave of the Great Beyonder, a heavy standoff was taking place between powerful Outerversal Morphons- some with the distinction of [Great] in their names.
From among them, the eyes of the Observer of Old and Young were the brightest as his senses covered everything.
He was the first to notice the oddity as far above the Grave of the Great Beyonder, he observed the Megalos Beyond to distort.
From this distortion, waves of stellar obsidian radiance then exploded outwards as the gorgeous hue of the Megalos Beyond...began to form small points of dew drops.
Dew drops.
Within the Megalos Beyond.
These dew drops began with the Grave of the Great Beyonder at the center, but gradually began to spread outwards.
It was...rain.
Rain in the fantastical space of the Megalos Beyond.
Seeing such a thing, The Observer of Old and Young sighed as around him, the Great Mother also noticed it and began to tremble with fanaticism!
It was...another Sign that the Great Beyonder had spoken of!

chapters.title: Chapter 3241 Origins V
paragraphs: Across the Megalos Beyond, there was only an endless obsidian radiance with stretches of Domains scattered across it.
In the Megalos Beyond, there was no rain.
Rain was a concept known and understood, with some entities even utilizing attacks in the form of rain or something similar.
But what was occurring at this very moment above the Grave of the Great Beyonder was a natural rain that seemed to be coming from the surrounding Megalos Beyond itself!

The rain bounced on the crimson barrier covering the Grave of the Great Beyonder and seemed to stretch outwards, with the bodies of the dozens of Outerversal Morphons outside this domain soon coming to feel the droplets.
PA! PA! PA!
The tentacles of the Great Mother rose as she felt the rain and trembled.
It was extremely pure condensed drops of the very makeup of the Megalos Beyond itself.
When they fell on her tentacles, they broke and scattered into dazzling obsidian waves that visibly made their surroundings brighter.

A shine of obsidian radiance became even more potent as it seemed that with the Grave of the Great Beyonder as the center, the concentration of atmospheric authority and the very weavings of the Megalos Beyond in this area were enriched!
Why was this? What could possibly cause this?!
|Rain shall cover the Megalos Beyond as it will cheer at the arrival of the instrument...|
The Great Mother weaved her intent outwards as her mind was all but made up.

Her intent traversed outwards towards the Herical Morphons who faced them as at the forefront, there was a massive Outerversal Morphon whose entire body was shrouded by a cyclical robe that covered and hid everything in darkness, with a single limb releasing from this cylindrical darkness that formed a purple hand which had an eye and a mouth with thousands of jagged teeth on its palm!
This mouth in the center of the palm opened and released guttural sounds in response to the intent of the Great Mother.
"Rain shall cover the Megalos Beyond as it will weep at the arrival of the instrument..."
The sentence it said was almost exactly the same as what the Great Mother had said.
But a single word was changed.
He uttered weep, and she uttered cheer.
And yet...neither were wrong as both of these sentences were said back to back by the Great Beyonder all those cycles ago!
The mouth on the palm spoke out again as the titanic body of darkness it was connected to began to vibrate.

"It is weeping, O Great Mother. Weeping in dismay at even the possibility of destruction to come. Why risk it? This second Sign only confirms things as we must get through, Great Mother. Whether we have your permission or not."
WAA!
Around and behind this terrifying Outerversal Morphon that bore the distinction of Great, others also moved.
The Great Mother looked at them in distaste as she got out of her reverie and bellowed out while beginning to make preparations.

|Hmph, the Megalos Beyond is cheering and expectant for what's to come! Can you not sense how much more vibrant everything is? Can you not imagine the wonders to come? Because if you seek to stop it...it will have to be over my corpse, O Great Enslaver.|
Her words only caused the tension in the surroundings to burn ever brighter.
Her tentacles began to spin and cycle around her as she began to give off waves of ancient power that few would understand the true terror of.
After her words were said, there was no going back.
A deep sigh escaped from the Observer of Old and Young as he began to transform out of the form of an old man and into a terrific Outerversal Morphon.
Others did the same around him as dozens of Morphons of different forms with coiling tentacles lined up behind the Great Mother in solidarity!
The Great Enslaver looked at this scene and spoke deeply.
"No Great Outerversal Morphon has fallen over the last cycles. If you protect the Instrument ...you will start fulfilling another Sign yourself."
Another sign the Great Beyonder stated.
|Great Ones will fall like the drops of Rain....so what? Who knows which among us will live in the future to come? The ones following the Will of the Great Beyonder, or Heretics?|
She spoke daringly and without fear.
And in response, millions of tendrils began to buzz opposite her as another deep voice not belonging to the Great Enslaver echoed out.
|We also follow the Will of the Great Beyonder, O Great Mother, but we seem to see it differently.|
A voice that made the confident tentacles around the Great Mother to pause slightly as they developed some solemnity.
She didn't think even he would come this fast.
But what had to be done, had to be done.
With her mind made up, she initiated the safeguards she had put into place since many cycles ago around the Grave of the Great Beyonder as thereafter, her power exploded out!
As it did, she couldn't help but feel a tremendous sense of achievement and euphoria.
She wondered.
Would she be able to initiate the third Sign today? Would a Great One fall here?
As unlikely as it was due to their sheer power, she was expectant.

She had thought Great Ones falling would come much later, but who knew how the intricacies of the Great Beyonder worked? All she did know...was that she had come across the Instrument brought forth by the Observer of Old and Young as by now, seeing the Sign of the Rain, Aspasia must have confirmed everything!
'I will see you all again soon enough...'
She had a single thought that revealed a glimpse of what she planned to do.

With their surroundings now filled with drops of rain that scattered to cause the Megalos Beyond to shine with ever increasing obsidian radiance, a massive pop that ushered in the start of a bloody war ensued.
POP!
A booming sound that stretched deeply into the protected Grave of the Great Beyonder behind them.

A sound that was felt by two connected beings, one of them being the entity responsible for ushering this change and releasing unseen and unknown waves of interactions even he didn't fully grasp as he established a stable channel of Matter and Dark Matter!

chapters.title: Chapter 3242 Origins VI
paragraphs: Across an extremely stable pathway, it felt like endless stellar obsidian seas were surging from all around and crossing this single path while heading towards a distant construct.

And yet no matter how much was drawn in, the surroundings didn't show any strain as Ozymandias realized the moment the connection was established, waves of interactions he couldn't yet understand erupted and caused some sort of a reaction.
A reaction with the countless particles of Dark Matter permeating all around this space!

The Dark Matter seemed to feed off of this connection in an unfathomable way, the concentration of authority and atmosphere of the Megalos Beyond itself rapidly increasing with this region of the Organ they were in as the center and only continuing this expansion outwards.

Within the Nexus of Megalos Records where a part of himself and Aspasia was, their touching palms vibrated as Aspasia was currently looking behind Noah as if she could see the blinding and massive obsidian pathway that was formed not towards an Entity, but something else entirely!
Her voice was filled with a sense of incredulity and confusion as she looked at him.
Her eyes squinted closely as if she wanted to follow the endless massive connection stretching out behind him, but Ozymandias looked at her ever closer as he asked calmly.
|Is something the matter?|
As if he had just done the most natural thing in the world.
Aspasia looked at him wordlessly as if she were gathering her thoughts before she asked, almost as if she was whispering so that nobody else could hear....but there should be nobody else here!
|What...did you connect to just now?|
She wondered.
She sought an answer.
And yet...she only saw the singularities of this mysterious being before her curve into a smile as he replied.
|Something big. I need to focus and understand it clearly, do you mind?|
He spoke while his stellar obsidian turned its eyes right ahead of him.
Only their palms had been touching, but unconsciously, Aspasia came to realize at this moment that her whole body was glued to him.
As if she wanted to enter the depths of his existence to understand exactly what had just happened!
|Ah...| As she realized this, Aspasia stepped back, naturally unclasping their palms as she felt the weavings of her own Existence.
|Did you manage to confirm what you wanted to confirm?|
His voice was ever present as it followed her.

Her blank gaze blinked and brightened up as she looked at him, and then sensed the changes occurring around them as well as her intricate connection to the Grave of the Great Beyonder that was currently getting drops of rain on it.
She felt the heavy inflow of rivers of what seemed like the Megalos Beyond itself- not just Outerversal Authority or something like it.
She felt it flow towards him and yet at the same time, nothing was lost.
Around them, the waves of Megalos Beyond seemed to be getting richer.
The weavings of Dark Matter seemed to be getting more potent!
Why was this?

She wanted to understand this unreal phenomenon as it was all connected to the entity before her, and when she looked closely, she could almost see the weavings of something new from the massive connection she only caught a glimpse of.
But now...they were no longer connected, and she couldn't observe it anymore.
So towards his question...
|Yes...I've confirmed what I wanted to confirm.|
She answered succinctly as his singularities blazed, and his figure sat in a meditative position even in this Nexus of Megalos Records as...
CRACK!
Cracks formed even in this ethereal space as obsidian brilliance began to flow towards him, his figure becoming encased by it!
And yet...this Nexus of Megalos Records did not lose anything.
It even seemed to be gaining more as imperceptible waves radiated from him and made everything richer!
Aspasia gazed at this scene with an inquisitive gaze.
She...was not able to find exactly what she was looking for that would confirm this Entity was the Instrument that the Great Beyonder spoke of.
But, the Sign outside of the Grave of the Great Beyonder right now gave him tremendous authenticity.
That was now two Signs, and the most recent one came directly as a result of his actions!
So he could be considered the one that the Great Beyonder spoke of. If the Great Mother asked her, this was what she would say.
But herself...she wanted to also look at this being and understand him more. So she also sat in a meditative position in the Nexus of Megalos Records and watched him.

Outside, their bodies were still connected as he pierced into the very depths of her existence. This was still a connection she could exploit to learn about this being as at this moment, within the core of the Organ they were in, seas of the Megalos Beyond were constantly sinking into his body and flowing into the connection extending behind him.
She felt her own Authority surge faster, her own connection to the Megalos Beyond become deeper, and her own power was steadily rising.
Almost as if she was connected to an agent of the Megalos Beyond itself!
She looked at this being closely as she sensed all the changes around them, and she wondered.
'Just who are you, Ozymandias?'
She wondered, and soon after, she also received a message.
A message from none other than the Great Mother.
|My Little Aspasia, did you see it? Did you see Rain?!|
Her intent drilled into her mind as she could feel her long fed fanaticism. And so she sent back the intent she had prepared.
|Yes, Great Mother. It came as a direct result of his actions.|
She told the truth.
Even though it wasn't the full truth as she didn't mention that she didn't finish the full ritual of confirmation.
But from the other side, the cheer of the Great Mother was overflowing.

|Haha, good. Good! Keep yourself close to him, Aspasia. Guide him. If you can Imprint yourself on him and have him care for you, even better. I've activated the mechanism to take this Grave away from here and towards the nearest Megalos Pantheon. There, gather the support of other Outerversal Morphons. Spread the news of the arrival of the Instrument! There, he can challenge the Crucible of the Beyonder and further cement his position. There, we will begin gathering support as all others will follow.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3243 Change! I
paragraphs: The nearest Megalos Pantheon.
A Domain of unfathomable size where millions of Outerversal Morphons reside.
A holy place among many others that the Great Beyonder deemed sacred, leaving behind his Crucible of the Beyonder there for all of these cycles!
In any Pantheon, conflict and fighting were not allowed.
Such places gathered the weavings of many Outerversal Morphons as across the Megalos Beyond, there were many ways for one to gain power.
Performing Alieia and connecting to Delegatus across the weavings of existence was one.
Another even more straightforward way...was to devour other Outerversal Morphons and inherit all their work.
The countless threads of connections an Outerversal Morphon had formed for who knew how many cycles could become the gain of someone else if they came across a particularly tyrannical Morphon!
So many Morphons made Megalos Pantheons their homes as they lived there for many cycles, only occasionally leaving by sending out clones of their bodies.
And the nearest Pantheon...was the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra!
Little Aspasia heard the commands of the Great Mother as she nodded with affirmation and replied.
|Understood, Great Mother.|
The stage was set.
Rain fell over the Grave of the Great Beyonder, but at this moment, it began to pulse with magnificent scenery.

Far below it, imperceptibly, millions of illusory tentacles formed into an infinity symbol that began to spin, its glow rising up and covering everything as even while surrounded by an unknown number of Heretical Morphons, it was bound to slip from their grasp due to nothing else but the sheer preparations and power of the Great Mother!
HUUM!

The massive illusory infinity symbol spun and gushed out waves of Outerversal Authority, the crimson barrier of the Grave of the Great Beyonder remaining intact as heavy Authorities clashed around it.
But inside of this barrier...one could only see the convergence of Black flames. The massive pulsing organ and floating Pillars of brilliance were nowhere to be seen.
Instead, a unique power shuttled an entire domain across the Megalos Beyond, its destination being one of the many large stretches of Pantheons stretching out across this endless space!
Brilliance.
The speed at which such a thing could traverse was unknown, but Noah felt it closely as seas of stellar obsidian radiance poured from a place he didn't even know existed days ago.
All of it was funneled across intricately as the first speckles of this brilliance landed on an Aletheian Haven!
Within the Infinite Omniverse.
Gravitating across a multicolored Extremity Vein, the Aletheian Haven of Dreams was by itself approaching the size of a hundredth of the known bounds of an average Omniverse.
This scope alone was shocking to grasp, but this Haven was one of the many that made the Infinite Omniverse as its size matched it!
The stretches of sandy gold brilliance seemed endless.
At the center of what used to be the Dream Dimension, the golden sands trembled as they ballooned upwards as if a mountain was forming.
Nearby, a group of Dreams could be seen as they looked like magnificent horses with golden wings fluttering on their backs and a sharp horn rising from their heads.
Their heads rose towards the distantly rising mountains as they felt something.
A mountain more massive than any Reality of Extremity Passages as it rose like a massive tower, and when it reached a certain point...
BZZZT!
Its absolute peak began to crack a moment later, as if it were an active volcano, everything exploded.

Endless waves of stellar obsidian radiance gushed from this golden mountain with so much force that it looked like a pillar of black light was tearing across the Dream Aletheian Haven and only going higher across the skies.
And it did just that.
It endlessly rose up before moments later...drops of stellar obsidian radiance began to wash over the Dream Aletheian Haven and all its nearby golden sands!
And here is where utter wonder unfolded.
As if set on fire.
As if poked and agitated.
The very weavings of the golden sands jumped, the small particulates that made them begin to dance and react to the obsidian brilliance falling from the skies.
PA! PA! PA!
Each clash between a golden grain of sand of the quintillions of grains of sand in this Haven clashed with an opposing grain of obsidian radiance.
Matter and Dark Matter collided.

Even the Commonwealth knew frighteningly little regarding the weavings of Dark Matter. Today, a lesson and a breakthrough would be made as after a single particle of golden sand smashed into an obsidian particle of Dark Matter once, they only repulsed each other.
BOOM!
Twice, they only repulsed each other.
BOOM!
On the third time, they gravitated towards each other as if there was an intricate array of waves and strings nobody else could see, the impact on the third time causing something fantastical.
They came in contact and opposed each other once more, but at the point of contact where they repulsed...a black gold singularity bloomed.
A black gold sand.
Such a phenomenon happened not to just a single grain of sand smashing and repulsive from a single grain of the obsidian radiance gushing down.
It happened to the millions of golden grains of sand nearby as after three clashes, millions of black gold grains of sand formed.
|A new particle...|
In the skies.
A figure of Noah floated grandly as he looked at what occurred with wonder.

The mixture of black and gold currently looked like the millions of stars gravitating around each other akin to a massive galaxy, and after three bursts of contact, millions of black gold stars were born as it only caused this spanning galaxy to become larger.
Once the black gold sands were born, they gushed out like waves towards the surroundings and caused a chain link reaction where even more of them were born!
Noah looked at this with shining eyes as he summarized.
|The interaction of Matter and Dark Matter...produced another particle entirely.|
It was a shocking finding!
One that had to be looked at closely for what it really was!

chapters.title: Chapter 3244 Change! II
paragraphs: They didn't assimilate with each other.
They didn't annihilate each other.

Whether it was due to him and the Infinite Omniverse being in a unique situation or not, Noah observed and discovered on this day particles of Matter and Dark Matter colliding as something entirely new was born thereafter!
Nearby, the Dreams in the form of Winged Unicorns gas unconsciously began to run, but flecks of the newly born black gold sand fell on their hair coat as wondrously, it only sunk in harmlessly.
But thereafter.
NEEIGH!
Cries echoed out from the golden Winged Unicorns as their furry hair coats bloomed with black gold radiance, their sizes beginning to increase greatly along with the level of their Existence!
Noah observed this closely as he continued to analyze everything that occurred.
|The newly formed particle is unnamed, but it is extremely reactive to lifeforms as exposure to it initiates a rapid change in Existence. And this change...|
The change was profound as after it covered a majority of their Existence, an invisible beam of obsidian light only Noah could see stretched out from the Winged Unicorns and rose upwards.
It looked like a thin fishing line as it crossed the Infinite Omniverse rapidly, ascending ever higher as its target fantastically streaked towards the Megalos Beyond!
It was astonishing to see as for the first time, as far as Noah could tell, a link of a Delegatus would be formed, but it was initiated by the Delegatus itself.
The target of this fishing line...Noah could already tell it was none other than Ozymandias who was the one that all of these seas of Dark Matter were flowing through to reach here!
He stared at such scenes wordlessly as around him, the voice of the Infinite Omniverse could be heard.

|Theoretically, Matter and Dark Matter wouldn't clash as freely, with the likely scenario being Dark Matter passing through Matter and only affecting its subsequent interactions. But there seems to be something else causing the current phenomenon. Studying what the Commonwealth refers to as Tainted Omniverses would help in clarifying things.|
Yes.
The Commonwealth called Omniverses that had Outerversal Morphon ruling over them as Tainted Omniverses.
They held threads of Dark Matter with them as they even formed a Dark Matter Core!
A normal Omniverse didn't have a Dark Matter Core, and yet a Tainted one did.
What secrets was it hiding?
Noah had such a thought while observing the wondrous interaction of weavings of Megalos Beyond and his Infinite Omniverse become even more expansive.
From a few thousand miles.
To millions of miles in the span of a second.
To a single light year, and further on!
The Dream Aletheian Haven became a gorgeous black gold landscape gradually as even its skies began to change- the space taking of a glowing stellar black gold hue.
"What changes are occurring to the Infinite Omniverse overall?"
He asked lightly as a reply came soon after.

|With every clash and spread of the Dark Matter through the connection with the particles of Matter just in this Dream Aletheian Haven, more energy is generated. More complex weavings and interactions of existence are generated. Defying Manadynamics, energy seems to be emerging freely along with an increase in mass. It is more stable than Existential Terraforming as the Dream Aletheian Haven alone is on its way to double in size if not triple. The newly produced particle between the clash of Matter and Dark Matter is being studied for better understanding, and has been termed a Psioneutrino.|
...! He discovered a new particle and it was granted a name in itself

A Psioneutrino. What were its qualities? How did it behave? Noah waved his hands from the rapidly changing sands around him, his fingers coming to grasp a radiant dark gold grain of sand between two fingers.
He brought it up to his eyes as different types of Existential Extremity Authorities flowed into it.
He began with Manadynamics.
And...
BOOM!
The Psioneutrino particle in his hands instantly expanded in size and gained a blue ring of light around it!

|The infusion of authority into a Psioneutrino Particle instantly tripled the amount of energy available, with this particle being extremely conducive and stable with other forms of energy. The effects of the imposed authority can be expressed at three times their original output.|
Shocking findings were being made in real-time.
Noah was enamored with it as he then infused the Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Entropy into the Psioneutrino Particle!
BZZT!
Arcs of light buzzed as the color blue was melded seamlessly with a dark purple brilliance of Entropy.
|Acting akin to an intermediary, the Psioneutrino Particle perfectly balances the weavings of two different authorities, allowing both of them to be expressed simultaneously without any rejection.|
Noah's eyes were dazed with brilliance.
This...
This was not just a product between Matter and Dark Matter, but something that only came to be due to the unique connection of him and Ozymandias, and then Ozymandias and the Infinite Omniverse!

There was something between them all that caused the birth of this shocking new particle; and it shouldn't be something that appeared even in Tainted Omniverses where Outerversal Morphons brought down the weavings of Dark Matter.
Noah felt like it could change many things in utterly profound ways.
Generation of energy. A tripling of authority flowing through it. Harmony of different Authorities contained in it!
And these were the only things he had discovered just in the first few seconds.
He looked at the enlarged particle of Psioneutrino in his hands as Manadynamics and Entropy flowed out from it calmly, its size reducing as it returned to its dark gold brilliance.
Noah looked at it with great interest as his gaze then went to the Winged Unicorns that had turned entirely dark gold.
Another pair of wings sprouted from their backs as on their heads, three bright horns could now be seen!
Their eyes were unfathomably bright as tendrils of dark gold lightning flashed from their pupils.
|New species of Existence have been discovered.|
Unknown as imperceptible changes came from the discovery of a new particle- a particle synthesized by Noah's own actions!
As he looked at it, he wondered.
What would happen if he placed a Psioneutrino within the makeup of his existence? Amidst his makeup of Quarks, Leptons, and all others? Just what type of being would he become?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3245 Change! III
paragraphs: 3245 Change! III

There was always the question of unknowns for Noah. He loved to push the boundaries of the unknown as what he found on the other side was always something that brought him either an immense challenge or exhilaration.

Right now, the biggest unknown that he was looking at was the newly synthesized particle that came about as a result of the influx of what looked to be like the Megalos Beyond itself into his Infinite Omniverse.
In the depths of his existence, he could feel his heart pulsing as if he were on the cusp of something grandiose.
And the constant communication that he had with the Infinite Omniverse only further cemented this point, its monotone voice continuing to resound in his mind.

|The newly discovered species carry the attributes of both Matter and Dark Matter. While the core of their existence continues to be made up entirely of Matter, it is only the subtle interactions of the newly synthesized particles that have immensely boosted the functionality, efficiency, and weavings of their existence.|

He listened calmly as every part of his existence itched to start this process himself, but he wanted to be thorough. Currently, the influx of the Megalos Beyond was only within the Dream Aletheian Haven.
The Psioneutrino Particles were those that came about from the constant clashing of the Matter within the Dream Aletheian Haven and the Dark Matter of the Megalos Beyond.
He wanted to have an even wider pool than this, so he gave his command to the Infinite Omniverse.

"Allow the spread of the endless seas of the Megalos Beyond onto the other Havens and start gathering all the newly synthesized particles from each one. Whenever it is ready, we shall see what will be born from the placement of multiple different newly synthesized particles into the very depths of my existence."
|Understood, Master. I would also like to begin the establishment of a separate Haven made up entirely of these newly synthesized particles.|
A daring idea flowed from the Infinite Omniverse as Noah gave a light nod of affirmation.
He even continued further.

"See how the forging of the Omniversal Armaments compares if this newly synthesized particle is introduced. You can even veer from the field of blacksmithing and into alchemy as well and judge the products."
His voice was succinct and filled with possibilities.
He didn't know where all of this would lead. He only knew that he would keep going forward.
Under his direction, another massive Haven floating around the Extremity Vein of the Infinite Omniverse burst with a pillar of stellar obsidian light.
Inside Genesis. Inside Apollyon, Helios, Penumbra, Avalon, Prana...weavings of obsidian brilliance began to emerge fully.
The size of these Havens increased multiple times over and from them, something new arose at every turn.
In totality, the entire Infinite Omniverse began to seethe with an influx of authority as this process fully unfolded.
It took on the path of an Infinite Omniverse in a true sense at this moment.
Across the weavings of the recently discovered Omniverse X-999.
The worms of anti-existence were veiled and hidden, but they were always there.
And a single entity knew exactly where they were this whole time, since the subjugated existences that he had been in control of had been devoured one after another by these very same worms.
Noah Eckert.

He experienced the annihilation of matter itself again and again as his will and consciousness entered the infinitely dark space inside of the Worms of Existence and experienced its annihilation multiple times.

Since the arrival of the protectors, it had been harder and harder to locate the Worms of Existence, but he tugged upon the sensation of annihilation and sent more and more of the forces of the Imperium that he had subjugated to fall prey to these Worms.
And finally, after thousands upon thousands of cycles of annihilation where parts of his soul were instantaneously devoured and obliterated, a different reaction occurred
Instead of the usual annihilation, he found himself still able to observe and see even after his soul was wiped out.
As if he had been baptized within the cycles of annihilation, as parts of his soul faced it again and again, the main component of his soul gradually developed a form of resistance.
And this was all that he was looking for.
It only took another few 100 deaths of his subjugated forces before his mutated will was capable of existing without being attacked as if it were a foreign object inside of the Worms of Existence.

When he arrived at this point, everything else was set in stone. He was patient. He was quiet and he proceeded slowly. He began the very slow but gradual domination of something but he did not yet fully understand.
He only hoped that he would be successful.
At this point in time, he did begin to realize that his soul, which was always distinct and different, had begun to subtly change for better or for worse.
But as always, he liked to believe it was for better!
One Entity delved into Anti-Matter.
One Entity delved into Dark Matter.
When the dust settled, it was hard to predict just what result would come from each of their actions.
Inside the Obelisk of the Protectors.
In the private domain only accessible to the Equestris Protectors, Command Protector Valeria suddenly changed her gaze and tilted it as if she were listening to something.
Soon after...her eyes became firm as she waved her hands to cause the massive illusory image of their target, which they had been discussing this whole time, to disappear.

"Alright, you have been briefed with all the details on what you can expect inside of the Half Tainted Omniverse. The goal for you now is not to die, and contribute all you can in achieving the destruction of that Dark Matter Core. We have the clearance to set off!"
Her words sparked the attention of the powerful three Royal Existential Omniversal Simians whose bodies danced wildly with power.
Her sister, Protector Lucretia, let go of her lazy demeanor as she sat straight on her throne!
And in the midst of this all, Noah only smiled as his eyes pulsed with readiness.
He sat there among them, and yet none of them knew that at this very moment, he was wildly spreading Dark Matter within his own personal Omniverse!

chapters.title: Chapter 3246 Change! IV
paragraphs: 3246 Change! IV
The weavings of the Wheel were their own.
They could not be so easily grasped and understood.
The ebb and flow was something that common life forms would forever stare at in the distance, endlessly out of reach.
Countless things came and went, countless interactions weaved to and fro over cycles and eons unknown.
Could a single stone cast into all these cycles and chaos manage to effect any significant change?
Across the weavings of Existence.
Inside of an Omniverse undiscovered by the Commonwealth.
The weavings of Existential Extremity Authorities were prevalent here, but they seemed distorted and altered compared to normal.
They flowed like endless threads towards a single direction- a direction where a vibrant obsidian stellar hue pulsed and gave all the color in the surroundings.

The deeper one followed the threads of distorted Existential Extremity Authorities, the more suffocating a sensation of power they would feel as soon enough, they would come across titanic Entities with skeletal forms wading about.
Their numbers ranged by the trillions, from different species of all walks of life.
Without fail, their skeletal structures shone with a terrifying black and white hue- almost metallic in nature as they looked unbreakable.

Past these trillions of skeletal life forms, the converging distorted weavings of Existential Extremity Authorities flowed into an extremely heavy obsidian singularity that was surrounded by shattered remnants of millions of Domains of Existence.
It was a Dark Matter Core!
A complete one at that, not one stemming from a Half Tainted Omniverse.
In its very depths, a titanic skeleton the size of a cosmos bowed towards certain darkness, very little being visible in the depths of the massive Dark Matter Core.
|Any orders for me, Master? I hunger to conquer even more under your name...|
The voice was a powerful one, burning with Outerversal Authority and a fearsome sense of destruction!
The place it spoke towards was filled with boundless darkness, and yet the pure brilliance of an obsidian glinting skeleton was barely observable from the sockets that burned with white flames.

|Nothing on the horizon yet on this side, Bellerophon. One of my Chosen is going to put on an interesting show for me as she heads to take one of the heads of Savitar. If she is capable enough and succeeds, I will feed off of Savitar and reward her. If your blade seeks blood...follow up on these rumors of the Sign. I am getting whispers of Rain on the other side, Bellerophon. Rain! Haha, This is bound to make things more interesting as it means the weavings of the Great Beyonder are about to light up with activity. And once his weavings are lit up...|
He spoke with great respect when talking of the Great Beyonder.
And when he spoke of the 'Other side' that referred to the Megalos Beyond, it was almost like he was speaking about one side of a single coin!

|Once his weavings are lit up, they will even affect things here in the Megalos Ynnere. Then, the already active Megalos Nihilos will get even wilder. In this wildness, Bellerophon, we will make grand moves.|
A dense amount of information was unveiled all at once as this being spoke of grandiose things.
He referred to where he currently was, within the space holding this Tainted Omniverse, as the Megalos Ynnere!
There was the Megalos Beyond where this entity stemmed from, and he also mentioned Megalos Nihilos.
Three inexplicable wonders.
Three bodies.
And each seemed as mysterious and endless as the one before it!
Inside of a Vessel the size of a small world.

Under the banner of the Commonwealth, there were many dazzling technological advances that allowed for the forging of fantastical vessels, but the ones carrying powerful Protectors of the Commonwealth more often than not were on the smaller size.
Something smaller wasn't seeking attention.
Something smaller could more easily bypass the attention of the horrors out there.

Inside of this vessel termed as the Omniversal Voyager, Noah walked across a crystalline white floor- his direction being towards the curvaceous visage of Protector Lucretia who was staring out through the transparent glass made of unknown materials.

The Equestris Protectors worked fast after being given clearance, with their leave from the Obelisk of the Protectors being quick while delving into this personal Vessel of Command Protector Valeria that instantly shot out of the Omniverse of the Protectors.

The figures of Command Protector Valeria and the three Royal Existential Omniversal Simian Protectors were at the very front of the vessel, Protector Lucretia being the only one in this area as Noah came to stand beside her while staring out into the endless dark brilliance with the occasional flashes of white around them.
The moment he arrived, Protector Valeria spoke out in a serene tone.

"Do you know how the Outerversal Morphons refer to this endless expanse of Existence we are currently crossing? The Megalos Ynnere. We've heard them mention it many times over the eons as they truly believe in giving us such a distinction, as if we are only a part of something, and not everything. Where we are is the endless expanse of Existence itself, but they seem to indicate otherwise. What do you believe, Protector Osmont?"
Her question was a thoughtful one.
Noah took in the information she offered while replying.
"I don't think we encompass all of the stretches of Existence itself. On this, I would agree more with the Outerversal Morphons."

"Oh? You would side with a viewpoint of Outerversal Morphons?" The brows of Protector Lucretia were raised with interest as her crimson hair danced on her shoulders like flaming snakes, her face showing a playful smile.
Noah smiled with a sharp gaze as he nodded.

"Yes. After all, apart from being able to unravel and expose Outerversal Morphons with my Authorities, my eyes can at times recognize an agent of an Outerversal Morphon with just a mere gaze if they ever happened to stand right before me."
Calm words.
Yet the playful smile on Protector Lucretia faded as her eyes became immeasurably sharp while staring right into Noah!
Tomorrow's working chapter titles: Half Tainted Omniverse! I & II
Adui
Creator's Thought

chapters.title: Chapter 3247 Revelations I
paragraphs: The surroundings buzzed.
Protector Lucretia turned her head sideways as her fair neck was exposed, the tight multicolored battledress on her body pulsing with the light of an Omniversal Armament.
Behind Noah, his own Omniversal Armament buzzed as an air of profound tension bloomed in this small corner of the Omniversal Voyager!
|Your eyes can recognize an agent of an Outerversal Morphon if they were just standing right before you?|
Her voice echoed in his mind as an intent.
She didn't voice outwardly as her boredom and playful eyes became exceedingly calm at this moment.
Noah could see it.
She was contemplating.
She was judging and trying to see if his words held the meaning they held.
Towards her question, Noah smiled as his lips opened without bothering to use any intent.
"Yes. Let's use you as an example. At this distance, if there was anything you were hiding, I would be able to see it plainly. Of course, not that you would be hiding anything whatsoever."

His words only caused her eyes to become ever colder, but in the corner of her gaze, she could see that the few weavings Noah had uttered caught the attention of her sister at the forefront of the Omniversal Voyager.
Almost like an itch that represented the terrifying perception that Omniversal Entities had.
Noah felt this as well, and he wondered how this unique entity before him would react!
He wanted to understand her purpose and even obtain any information that others didn't know as he went about it in a straightforward way.

With the Will of Command Protector Valeria barreling towards them as she wondered what her sister could be discussing with the newly joining Protector, Lucretia lost all the coldness entirely as she walked towards Noah with an exotic gaze, her legs moving with a sense of enticement.
"Mmm, how about you and I go somewhere a bit more private? It may take hours or even days to cross the endless weavings of Existence until we reach that Half Tainted Omniverse..."
She came in front of Noah and put her hands around his neck, both of them noticing the heavy will of Command Protector Valeria observing them at this moment as Noah played along!
"Oh? Then we do have some time on our hands."

His own hands reached out to grab onto her blessed waist, a flash of a chilling light blooming in her eyes that she pushed down deeply and instead gave him a smile, a unique golden authority bursting from her that moved their bodies from this area of the Omniversal Voyager and towards one of the few private lodgings that looked like miniature Havens.

Inside a private lodging filled with vibrant fruits and liquids full of Nectar of Existence and a few thrones surrounding a table, their figures reappeared as they still felt the gaze of Command Protector Valeria!

Protector Lucretia also felt the eyes of her sister as she moved forward with determination, pushing Noah's figure towards a throne nearby and straddling him while the multicolored Omniversal Armament in the form of a battledress began to unwind around her.
It was only when she did this that the gaze of Command Protector Valeria faded away as if she couldn't keep watching any longer.

The moment that occurred, the amorous expression of Protector Lucretia faded as the hands that were sweetly holding onto Noah turned into sharp pincers, her right hand raised as a multicolored Dagger appeared- its sharp tip pointed towards Noah's head as terrifying authority gathered on it!
The Authority was unique, as if no matter what happened now or what would happen in the future, its penetrative light would always find its mark no matter what.
The red hair of the woman holding it danced wildly as her eyes carried an angry light filled with wrath and exhaustion.

|Why won't you all leave me alone?! He promised. After the last news I gave him, he promised to not gaze at me or what I was doing! So why the fuck did he send you? I've done everything he asked. Why jeopardize my standing by blatantly sending a Morphon here when you know that is the one condition I fucking had?!|
Her eyes carried immense rage.
Hatred.
When she spoke about Him.
The one who she thought sent Noah. When she spoke about Morphons.
She was filled with such immense hatred that her hands trembled!
It was the appearance of a Delegatus who utterly loathed that she even was one, and wanted to do anything in her power to make sure she wasn't exposed!
Noah gazed at the terrifying glint of the dagger above him as he smiled.
"That was a lot of reveal in a single outburst...but you must have mistaken me for something else. I am no Morphon nor an Agent of one."
He lied blatantly and with a smile.
His words caused the pupils of Protector Lucretia to tremble before she became even more stern, her will spreading out and layering waves of a unique Existential Extremity Authority around them.
Thereafter, from the tip of her Omniversal Armament, stellar black light gathered.

It was none other than Outerversal Authority as it dripped from the dagger and onto Noah, landing on his forehead as it was akin to a drop of water that split into smaller droplets and slid off his face.
Not even an ounce of a reaction.
Protector Lucretia's face became ashen at such a reality as she pulled her dagger back and got off Noah's figure.
|What? You...you aren't...?! Fuck!|
She made a mistake.
Seeing his knowledgeable eyes as if he had seen through his secret, she had revealed herself so simply!
Her graceful face, full of anger, still grasped the dagger tightly as she came to stare at Noah.

|Why...did you not say anything to others if you saw my identity? If you aren't involved with them, what purpose does it serve you to remain quiet when the only job you were given relied on exposing agents under Outerversal Morphon?!|
What purpose did he have?
When asked this question, Noah rose from the throne his body was pushed in as he shook his head.
"Before that. The Outerversal Morphon behind you, who is it? Just how powerful are they?"

chapters.title: Chapter 3248 Revelations II
paragraphs: Protector Lucretia was silent as she didn't say anymore.
She gathered herself as she still held the dagger in her hands, her authority beginning to rise once more as her face showed hesitation.
This being now truly knew her secret regardless of how they arrived here. She was having internal turmoil on how to take care of this if he truly wasn't involved with Outerversal Morphons!
But she didn't reply.
So Noah pushed even harder.
"Is the one you are bound to Savitar? Or someone else? Are we walking into a trap right now as we head towards the Half Tainted Omniverse?"
His words caused her face filled with difficulty to change as she shook her head vehemently.
|What? I have nothing to do with Savitar. And he...that Entity...he promised safety for me and Valeria. He never goes back on his words.|
"Safety for you and your sister. So the rest of those around you might die."
Noah nodded thoughtfully as he processed many things.
Looking at his nonchalant demeanor in the midst of all of this, Protector Lucretia seemed to have figured something out as she put the dagger down and sighed.
|This is just another one of your bodies, isn't it? Without the power of someone similar to my Sister, I cannot eradicate you along with the root of all of your possible Existence wherever you are.|
She stated something wholly and true as Noah gazed at her and nodded with a smile.
She looked at him deeply once more as if she were trying to figure him out.
|Who are you, really? What do you want?|
Noah smiled.
He had been asked this question many times before.
And his answer always differed.
Towards this red haired entity before him...
"Just think of me as a helper. Just like Old Man Eudemus, I seek to solve the same problems you all face."
His words caused Protector Lucretia to turn placid as she sighed and put her dagger away.

|You didn't say anything when you found out, so you won't say anything now, is that it? I have been tightly carrying this stain on my existence for many years now. Another person knowing of it fills me with great anxiety as if you suddenly decide to flap your mouth...|
She sat on another throne as she massaged her temples and thought of many possible paths she could take.
She made a ridiculous mistake today by being rash as now, she was in a predicament with someone she didn't know all too well.
Someone who, at this moment, was looking at her as if he were observing a certain exotic animal.
"You won't tell me who the Outerversal Morphon behind you is? I may be able to help."
Lucretia turned her gaze towards him with a deprecating look.
|It doesn't matter, does it? What would someone like you even do? This isn't something that can be solved even if you attain a Fabled Omniverse. I am bound. I will remain bound. Until...|
Her gaze was filled with longing.
As if she wanted to be free.
But she could only shake her head and sigh.
She had tried far too many times.

|No. I cannot even say his name. If I do, he will use it as an excuse to gaze at me. I've already made many mistakes today, so I'll make another small one by saying that among Outerversal Morphons, he is granted the distinction of a Great One. Great...that single word means and stands for something more grandiose than you can ever imagine.|
Protector Lucretia shook her head as she seemed tired.
On the other side, Noah sat on his throne and nodded as he gained one piece of information after another.
Uniquely, he raised his head and looked at a high point inside of the miniaturized domain they were in within this Omniversal Voyager Vessel.
At the ceiling of this Domain, he was staring at something.
He was surprised about another thing this whole time.
Because even though Protector Lucretia felt the gaze of her sister fade away, the means of Omniversal Entities were profound.

Only Noah who had begun to look closely at Matter and Dark Matter, and had his status as the Weaver of Extremity and Existence elevated, was able to notice the thin pulsing of an interaction that was as small as a Quark dancing above them like an eye.
An eye that Protector Lucretia didn't see, but Noah saw clearly for it to still be the gaze of Command Protector Valeria.
She saw everything.
And yet...
There was only calmness in the surroundings as nothing happened.
After her sister making a mistake and revealing that she was a Delegatus of an Outerversal Morphon, nothing happened even though she witnessed it all!
Noah's eyes turned ever brighter.
The sister knew?
The Omniversal Entity of the Commonwealth leading a powerful team of Protectors knew that her Sister was an Agent of Outerversal Morphons?!
"This gets better and better...."
He stroked his chin while looking at the small unseen point above, making it clear to this gaze that he could see it!
This gaze that was originating all the way towards the front of the Omniversal Voyager where the Command Protector Valeria was, along with the three Royal Existential Omniversal Simian Protectors.
The three Royal Existential Omniversal Simians were talking amongst themselves as they reclined on radiant thrones while eating vibrant Fruits pulsing with Existence.
|This is the first time I see Lucretia sneak around with someone else since she was with The Great Luminary Protector. Wouldn't he be mad that his replacement is a newbie she met just a day ago?|
One Royal Simian, Protector Actaeon, had a gaze of interest as they sent a mental message to the other two Protectors- Orpheus and Ajax.

|An Omniversal Star of our Commonwealth or a newbie who has not even come close to a Fabled Omniverse...haha. Mmm, I heard they clashed and disagreed on something a while ago, so she can do whatever she wants. But hey...we've been with her for a while, but she didn't go for any of us. Do you think she prefers them furless? She doesn't know the pleasure of a Simian full of fur, or she wouldn't go bac-|
In the midst of what should have been their private weavings to each other, a sharp voice cut in that stopped all weavings entirely.
"Are you all little girls who have so much time to gossip when we are heading to a Half Tainted Omniverse right now? Review the physiology of our enemy if you have so much time!"
The booming voice of Command Protector Valeria shook them as they cleared their throats and rose straighter on their thrones.
Command Protector Valeria gazed at them coldly before she continued her sharp focus on steering the Omniversal Voyager while protecting them and veiling everything.
Her power was vast.
Her might was unfathomable.
She was even fearlessly going to hunt down a body of a Great One at this very moment!
But when she recalled what she just observed between her sister and Osmont.
When she recalled what her own little sister had never dared to even come to her for help.
When she recalled all of this...she felt so powerless.
But such a stifling feeling was temporary.
Inside her, a power that very few entities understood swirled.
With this power, she would cut down all Morphons herself if she had to.
The one they targeted now. The one behind her Sister.
She would eradicate every single one.
No matter the cost, she would find freedom for her sister!
As for this newly entering Protector Osmont that was an extreme unknown that could change many things...
Valeria's eyes became sharp as a part of her will stared straight into his eyes that were turned up in a distant room of this vessel.
As if he could see her clearly, and he was smiling freely as if none of that mattered.

While Noah stared fearlessly into the will of an omniversal entity in a corner of what the Outerversal Morphons considered the Megalos Ynnere, his Existence was about to undergo an unfathomable change within the Infinite Omniverse!
Inside of the Infinite Omniverse.
"Megalos Beyond...Megalos Ynnere..."
The words echoed from a dense stellar cluster interweaving Quarks and Leptons among other unknown particles that made up Noah.
At this moment, he went over the words of Lucretia as he put together many things; all the while, above him, a cloud of dazzling Psioneutrino Particles stably floated.
Some dark gold. Some dark blue. Some dark white, dark green, dark red, dark purple...and on and on.
From each of his Aletheian Havens, he brought multiple Psioneutrino Particles as he prepared.
He never even bothered to question whether altering the very basis of his makeup was possible, he just went ahead and began doing it at this moment!
With a devilish light of expectations, the clouds of countless particles that made him vibrated as he bellowed out.
|Come!|

"Is the one you are bound to Savitar?

Are we walking into a trap right now as we head towards the Half Tainted Omniverse?"
His words caused her face filled with difficulty to change as she shook her head vehemently.
|What?
I have nothing to do with Savitar.
And he...that Entity...he promised safety for me and Valeria.
He never goes back on his words.|
"Safety for you and your sister.
So the rest of those around you might die."
Noah nodded thoughtfully as he processed many things.
Looking at his nonchalant demeanor in the midst of all of this, Protector Lucretia seemed to have figured something out as she put the dagger down and sighed.
|This is just another one of your bodies, isn't it?
Without the power of someone similar to my Sister, I cannot eradicate you along with the root of all of your possible Existence wherever you are.|
She stated something wholly and true as Noah gazed at her and nodded with a smile.
She looked at him deeply once more as if she were trying to figure him out.
|Who are you, really?
What do you want?|
Noah smiled.
He had been asked this question many times before.
And his answer always differed.
Towards this red haired entity before him...
"Just think of me as a helper.
Just like Old Man Eudemus, I seek to solve the same problems you all face."
His words caused Protector Lucretia to turn placid as she sighed and put her dagger away.
|You didn't say anything when you found out, so you won't say anything now, is that it?
I have been tightly carrying this stain on my existence for many years now.
Another person knowing of it fills me with great anxiety as if you suddenly decide to flap your mouth...|
She sat on another throne as she massaged her temples and thought of many possible paths she could take.
She made a ridiculous mistake today by being rash as now, she was in a predicament with someone she didn't know all too well.
Someone who, at this moment, was looking at her as if he were observing a certain exotic animal.
"You won't tell me who the Outerversal Morphon behind you is?
I may be able to help."
Lucretia turned her gaze towards him with a deprecating look.
|It doesn't matter, does it?
What would someone like you even do?
This isn't something that can be solved even if you attain a Fabled Omniverse.
I am bound.
I will remain bound.
Until...|
Her gaze was filled with longing.
As if she wanted to be free.
But she could only shake her head and sigh.
She had tried far too many times.
|No.
I cannot even say his name.
If I do, he will use it as an excuse to gaze at me.
I've already made many mistakes today, so I'll make another small one by saying that among Outerversal Morphons, he is granted the distinction of a Great One.
Great...that single word means and stands for something more grandiose than you can ever imagine.|
Protector Lucretia shook her head as she seemed tired.
On the other side, Noah sat on his throne and nodded as he gained one piece of information after another.
Uniquely, he raised his head and looked at a high point inside of the miniaturized domain they were in within this Omniversal Voyager Vessel.
At the ceiling of this Domain, he was staring at something.
He was surprised about another thing this whole time.
Because even though Protector Lucretia felt the gaze of her sister fade away, the means of Omniversal Entities were profound.

Only Noah who had begun to look closely at Matter and Dark Matter, and had his status as the Weaver of Extremity and Existence elevated, was able to notice the thin pulsing of an interaction that was as small as a Quark dancing above them like an eye.
An eye that Protector Lucretia didn't see, but Noah saw clearly for it to still be the gaze of Command Protector Valeria.
She saw everything.
And yet...
There was only calmness in the surroundings as nothing happened.
After her sister making a mistake and revealing that she was a Delegatus of an Outerversal Morphon, nothing happened even though she witnessed it all!
Noah's eyes turned ever brighter.
The sister knew?
The Omniversal Entity of the Commonwealth leading a powerful team of Protectors knew that her Sister was an Agent of Outerversal Morphons?!
"This gets better and better...."
He stroked his chin while looking at the small unseen point above, making it clear to this gaze that he could see it!
This gaze that was originating all the way towards the front of the Omniversal Voyager where the Command Protector Valeria was, along with the three Royal Existential Omniversal Simian Protectors.
The three Royal Existential Omniversal Simians were talking amongst themselves as they reclined on radiant thrones while eating vibrant Fruits pulsing with Existence.
|This is the first time I see Lucretia sneak around with someone else since she was with The Great Luminary Protector.
Wouldn't he be mad that his replacement is a newbie she met just a day ago?|
One Royal Simian, Protector Actaeon, had a gaze of interest as they sent a mental message to the other two Protectors- Orpheus and Ajax.
|An Omniversal Star of our Commonwealth or a newbie who has not even come close to a Fabled Omniverse...haha.
Mmm, I heard they clashed and disagreed on something a while ago, so she can do whatever she wants.
But hey...we've been with her for a while, but she didn't go for any of us.
Do you think she prefers them furless?
She doesn't know the pleasure of a Simian full of fur, or she wouldn't go bac-|
In the midst of what should have been their private weavings to each other, a sharp voice cut in that stopped all weavings entirely.
"Are you all little girls who have so much time to gossip when we are heading to a Half Tainted Omniverse right now?
Review the physiology of our enemy if you have so much time!"
The booming voice of Command Protector Valeria shook them as they cleared their throats and rose straighter on their thrones.
Command Protector Valeria gazed at them coldly before she continued her sharp focus on steering the Omniversal Voyager while protecting them and veiling everything.
Her power was vast.
Her might was unfathomable.
She was even fearlessly going to hunt down a body of a Great One at this very moment!
But when she recalled what she just observed between her sister and Osmont.
When she recalled what her own little sister had never dared to even come to her for help.
When she recalled all of this...she felt so powerless.
But such a stifling feeling was temporary.
Inside her, a power that very few entities understood swirled.
With this power, she would cut down all Morphons herself if she had to.
The one they targeted now.
The one behind her Sister.
She would eradicate every single one.
No matter the cost, she would find freedom for her sister!
As for this newly entering Protector Osmont that was an extreme unknown that could change many things...
Valeria's eyes became sharp as a part of her will stared straight into his eyes that were turned up in a distant room of this vessel.
As if he could see her clearly, and he was smiling freely as if none of that mattered.

While Noah stared fearlessly into the will of an omniversal entity in a corner of what the Outerversal Morphons considered the Megalos Ynnere, his Existence was about to undergo an unfathomable change within the Infinite Omniverse!
Inside of the Infinite Omniverse.
"Megalos Beyond...Megalos Ynnere..."
The words echoed from a dense stellar cluster interweaving Quarks and Leptons among other unknown particles that made up Noah.
At this moment, he went over the words of Lucretia as he put together many things; all the while, above him, a cloud of dazzling Psioneutrino Particles stably floated.
Some dark gold.
Some dark blue.
Some dark white, dark green, dark red, dark purple...and on and on.
From each of his Aletheian Havens, he brought multiple Psioneutrino Particles as he prepared.
He never even bothered to question whether altering the very basis of his makeup was possible, he just went ahead and began doing it at this moment!
With a devilish light of expectations, the clouds of countless particles that made him vibrated as he bellowed out.
|Come!|

chapters.title: Chapter 3249 A Higher Form of Existence! I
paragraphs: Every action had an equal and opposite reaction.
Every choice had an effect. Causality could be twisted and distorted in any myriad of ways, but at the end of the day, what was intended or unintended would unfold!
On this day, Noah had an intention of what he wanted the result to be. It was unknown whether this would be exactly what he achieved.
|Newly synthesized Existential Elementary Particles are being placed alongside other Existential Elementary Particles that make up Noah Osmont.|

His stellar cloud of quarks, leptons, and other unknown wonders he didn't fully know of faced an intrusion of a multicolored cloud of Psioneutrino Particles, with even the idea of something like this not being feasible as if someone tried to do something like this....their existence would very likely break down.
How could you just add something else to a mixture that was already completed?
To do so would cause an imbalance as every single interaction that your Existential makeup utilized would be thrown out of order!
Very likely, your makeup would unwind from such an event as you would cease to exist.
But, the Elementary Particles utilized here were Psioneutrino Particles.
Unique constructs that seemed to perfectly meld into any authority they were placed in without fail.
So when placed into the Existential makeup of someone...
HUUUM!
A glorious multicolored brilliance overshadowed by a stellar obsidian light flashed.
| The Psioneutrino Particles were efficiently and smoothly placed between the weavings of Quarks and Leptons.|
|A slight disruption to the interactions of other Particles observed.|
His very existence trembled as he felt like he was smacked with the intensity and heaviness of trillions of suns.
A slight disruption to the interactions of his existence caused this!
The waves. The strings that his Particles followed the motion of as they interacted with each other.
They only felt a slight disruption as after it...
|New interactions are being established accounting for the Psioneutrino Particles.|
|Harmony and resonance between all that makes up your existence is sought.|
A glorious stellar obsidian radiance covered the dense cloud of trillions of Particles that represented his existence as they all began to swirl.
It looked beautiful.
Akin to a radiant gravitating galaxy.
Akin to a system that was just...Quintessential.
|Quintessential resonance between the makeup of your existence has been achieved.|
|The accumulated results are now brought to fruition.|
The cloud of trillions of swirling particles spun faster as it all began to converge towards a humanoid form.
But unlike what it used to be, it seemed to be larger in proportion.
More magnificent.
More glorious!
HUUM!

A beam of stellar multicolored radiance shot from him as his body came together, the inclusion of the Psioneutrino Particles causing shocking and unfathomable changes to his existence as the mere weavings of who he used to be were different!
The flow of energy.
The flow of existence.
The make up!

It was all different as the vibrant cloud of stellar brilliance came together to form a large humanoid entity, his fair skin scintillating with stellar luster as on his back, a pair of gorgeous wings unfurled.
One was filled with vibrant colorless white feathers, while the other radiated a pure black wonder.
The body looked muscular and chiseled as if sculpted with perfect proportions, and around the fair skin...vibrant obsidian bands that looked like tattoos began to appear.
Around the chest.
Around his hands.
On his lower body.

Thick and gorgeously proportioned obsidian bands formed all around as if they were black Halos wrapping around his body, with these bands pulsing to life at this moment as they felt like they were alive!
At this time, his face that looked like a celestial entity lost in time opened its eyes.
The eyes....were contrasted with pure white and black.
The moment they opened...
BOOOM!
A brilliant light flashed as in the next moment, his whole body was seemingly snuffed out of existence.
Inside of the transforming Infinite Omniverse. Within the Haven of Helios, inside a private Domain concentrated with dense Existential Authority.
A high rise skyscraper made from gold glass towered above the clouds, and on its topmost floor, there was an expansive room taking up the whole space.
Inside this room, a wide golden bed could be seen with gold silky sheets strewn about, with a figure of Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Tyranny lying back with eyes closed.

To his right, the blue hair of Adelaide fell on his chest as she nested on his side while breathing softly, while to his left, the visage of Barbaros was wide awake as her fair fingers were tracing the outline of his pectoral muscles.
It was a calm reality, and yet in the next moment...
HUUM!
The eyes of Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Tyranny opened its eyes that shone half white and half black.
And right away, Barbatos' hands that were tracing his chest and Adelaide's head that was leaning on him instantly...passed through him.
As if he wasn't material solid Matter.
Their bodies seemingly phased through his body as they hit the soft bedding they were on, and an instant later...
WAP!
Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Tyranny entirely disappeared before their eyes.
"Little Fish?"
The gorgeous expression on Barbatos remained the same as she called out softly, not jumping to worry right after as in front of her, Adelaide was stern as she patted the area where Noah was just at!
There was no spatial light as if he teleported away, no eruption of weavings or authority.
It was just like he...blinked out of existence.
And it wasn't just in this place.
Far from here, in the Haven of Apollyon where crimson flames were raging.

Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Loot was standing in front of the Primogenitor of Steel, Ishtar, Sargon, the Seer of Sima, and a dozen other unique characters as they looked at the piece of an Armament radiating an omniversal light rising from a crimson gold lava filled mountain ahead of them.
Dazzling Blacksmith's Forges floated all around as each one was shining with an omniversal light at this moment!
Steel was talking to Noah's Clone when...
WAP!
His eyes flashed white and black, and his figure instantly disappeared right before their very eyes.
Almost as if he never existed to begin with!

chapters.title: Chapter 3250 A Higher Form of Existence! II
paragraphs: Across what the Outerversal Morphons referred to as the Megalos Ynnere.
Within the Omniversal Voyager, Protector Lucretia thought of an uncertain future as she sprawled on a throne opposite to Noah.
Her mind was calculating many possibilities based on any actions she took as after a certain point of time...
She felt something off as she blinked and looked towards the throne where Noah was.
And...
He was no longer there.
As if he had never been there.
He was just...gone!

Protector Lucretia rose from her throne with incredulity as she blinked and spread out her authority, but she felt nothing nearby as she even slowly spread her authority across the Vessel they were in.
And...nothing.
|What the fuck?|
He disappeared as if he had never been in this vessel since the very beginning.
Flashes of interminable brilliance.
This was what Noah felt alongside the intents of prompts that allowed him to know exactly what was happening.
|A change irreversible across the weavings of the Wheel of Existence has been brought to fruition.|
|You have transcended the limitations of your designated form of life and existence.|
|You have become a unique and never before discovered form of Existence|
|Your Existence has gained the distinction of the Omniversal Archontes Engineer.|
|Your Existential Omniversal Lumen Emperor Lineage is transitioning to the Omniversal Archontes Engineer.|
|The weavings of Invictus Maximus have reached full saturation and begun their emergence.|
A robust array of changes.
His very makeup was altered as the very core of his being changed.
His very lineage and form of life changed!
And yet uniquely...no changes were observed or felt by anyone in the Infinite Omniverse.
Under his own gaze, all the parables that made him were buzzing and interacting full of life and existence.
The introduction of the Psioneutrino Particles caused everything to act as if it were supercharged, the breadth of his existence tripling right away as it continued to rise even now.
The concentration of his Authorities. The level of power he could wield as a lifeform. Everything was scaled upwards in an unfathomable way.
When he opened his eyes, he could see the weavings of the Infinite Omniverse around him, and yet none of its weavings reacted to him.
Instead, his eyes felt like they were observing countless golden strings glowing calmly and with utmost stability all around him.
Golden strings.
Countless of such golden strings as from them, tendrils flowed out serenely and infused themselves unto his existence.
This was...
A higher form of Existence.
Something he gained access to by changing his own Existence!
The golden tendrils of light flowing through him were so pure and stable that the moment they touched him, they instantly traveled across all the trillions of cells that made up his existence.

The quintillions upon quintillions of quarks, leptons, Psioneutrinos, and other particles that made him- these golden tendrils of brilliance were absorbed into all of them nigh instantly before they felt ever so enriched!
He didn't fully understand it.
But at this moment, he had to put it aside as his Existence felt like it was exploding.
HUUM!
On his chest, nine brilliant singularities shone as they cried out from the very base of his existence.
His Mundis of Power.
Those that held his Systems of Existence!
They were crying out with emotion and fervor at this moment as they advanced far ahead!
|The Atlas of Existence has advanced from the Echelon of Laborer.|
[The Atlas of Existence has entered the Echelon of Administrator.|
|You have become the Administrator of the Atlas of Existence.|
From a Laborer to an Administrator.
It was a fantastical change, but Noah felt a sense of oddity within his Atlas of Existence.
When the weavings of his existence came together, there was a foreign one that converged within his Atlas!
And he stared at this weaving of existence that came to be clustered...in the Third Mundi of Power.
|The weavings of a sufficiently different System of Existence have naturally flowed their makeup into the Third Mundi of Power.|
|The System of Existence of the Ingeniare has taken the place of the Third Mundi of Power.|
Ingeniare.
A word closely related to the distinction and type of existence he had just become- an Engineer!

An engineer was someone who designed and built things, and Noah had gained such a distinction by placing a newly found particle that came as a product of Matter and Dark Matter into his existence- achieving a state even he didn't fully grasp.
Noah stared closely at the fantastical change blooming within him as at this time, he felt a tug.
It was a unique tug that described...emotions of worry of those he deemed close, his existence blinking its eyes as the origin of this worry was actually right next to him.
In the Haven of Helios.
One of his many bodies was still lying on the wide golden bed, its visage much more radiant than before as unique obsidian bands wrapped his fair skin like ancient tattoos.
He could see Adelaide and Barbatos, and yet they couldn't see nor sense him as they tried communicating with him through their Lineage!
Their hands passed right through his body as if their very existence could not grasp anything about him.
Uniquely, Adelaide was still staring at the same spot on the bed where he lay.
As if her senses and connection to him were so deep to the extent that they told her he was there, and yet her authority and everything else said otherwise!
It was a shocking finding as under Noah's eyes, he gazed at the countless golden threads and strings only he could see stably moving around him...and blinked.
The vibrant bands of tattoos around his body then flashed with a golden brilliance.
And he felt like he moved his vision from a well-lit room and towards a slightly darker one, but the moment he did so...
Barbatos screamed out as Noah reappeared in front of their eyes right where he was!
But...her small fair feet were standing and passing through his sculpted abdominal muscles.
Adelaide's vibrant blue hairs phased through his shoulders and chest as even though he was right in front of them, their hands and bodies passed right through him as if he weren't entirely real!
And yet there he was.
He smiled at them as his brilliance caused them to be dazed.
"Did I worry you?"
It was the first sentence that the Omniversal Archontes Engineer spoke since his conception!
