Barbatos screamed out as Noah reappeared in front of their eyes right where he was!
But...her small fair feet were standing and passing through his sculpted abdominal muscles.
Adelaide's vibrant blue hairs phased through his shoulders and chest as even though he was right in front of them, their hands and bodies passed right through him as if he weren't entirely real!
And yet there he was.
He smiled at them as his brilliance caused them to be dazed.
"Did I worry you?"
It was the first sentence that the Omniversal Archontes Engineer spoke since his conception!

chapters.title: Chapter 3251 Maximus! I
paragraphs: He rose from the wide golden bed while looking at Adelaide and Barbatos.
The latter stumbled backward as her slender legs and small figure still phased through his body, her gaze one of worry as she harrumphed while her body lay bare.
"Did you worry us...you disappeared all of a sudden, and even now...is everything okay?"
Her tone gradually lost its gusto as she came down and spoke softly.
Noah smiled and felt the uniqueness of the surroundings under his gaze as the bands of tattoos on his body flashed again and...
Adelaide let out a gasp as her fingers were able to feel him again.
It felt like they were finally back on the same weavings of existence as he wasn't something their hands could just pass through!
The eyes of Adelaide became moist at such a reality as she also spoke softly.
"Is...everything okay? Have you made another advancement?"
"Mmm..." Noah nodded as he saw the two were slightly shaken up, especially Adelaide who held on to his body and didn't let go as if she feared he would disappear again in the next second.
She looked at him up and down to make sure he was still all there.
She traced the bands of stellar obsidian tattoos on his body as Barbatos did the same.
Adelaide then looked into his eyes with tears forming in hers as she spoke tenderly with slight hesitation.

"Do you...know my biggest fear? It is not some apocalypse or even death, but that one day, I would look straight into your eyes...and you wouldn't look at me the same. That you would reach an unfathomable level of Existence that when you saw me...you wouldn't think much of me. As if you were looking at a piece of stone or observing an ant on the ground below."
Her biggest fear.
Her eyes trembled as she revealed this and continued. "Sometimes...I even have thoughts of you stopping where you are. Not going any further. I...I know it's selfish. I know it's...I know."
Her words weren't able to finish as she closed her eyes feeling a sense of shame.
Tears ran down freely as Noah sighed lightly while giving her a hug, turning towards Barbatos beside him who was also sniffling slightly while keeping on a strong front as he also pulled her close.
His voice was deep and filled with determination as he replied.
"A day will not come where I would gaze at you all with any less love than now. Likely, I will only ever look at you with boundless love that increases. You do not need to worry."
His words caused the two women to hug him ever tighter.
He had made heavy and powerful advancements that had taken him towards a new stage of existence entirely, and its implications were too grand!
He didn't even release the boons of his new Lineage to all others yet.
He had to understand it first before anything else.

His other parts of existence could do this as his body here hugged two women closely, reassuring them that no matter how high he reached, there would never come a point where he would look at his own family as if they were nothing.
That, he was sure of!
Inside the Omniversal Voyager.
WAP!

Noah's figure returned to what he was coming to call Lower Weavings of Existence, his visage causing the shocked Protector Lucretia, who was about to make some noise, to step back as she looked at him with scrutiny.
|You...what did you do? How did you do that?|
She was surprised more than anything as what had just occurred now showed a glimpse of a terrifying power!
Where this being could disappear at will and she wasn't able to even sense him no matter what.
He wasn't entirely honest with them about his capabilities.
Yet he looked at her calmly as if he were gazing at something small in the corner of his eyes, his hands waving dismissively as he replied.

"You have your System of Existence with its secrets, and I have mine. I just made a little breakthrough there since I have to prepare for the unknowns of the Half Tainted Omniverse. You and your sister are guaranteed safety while the rest of us could be whisked off, remember?"
He spoke so simply as apart from Lucretia, he could feel the hidden gaze of Command Protector Valeria even more closely honed in on him now.

He wondered whether his disappearance had also fully veiled him from the senses of an Omniversal Entity, or whether she could still capture weavings of his existence when he was in the place filled with threads of golden lines that he would label for now...the Higher Weavings of Existence!
With a glimmer, his vision switched to his many other bodies that remained within the glorious Higher Weavings of Existence, more details about the recent transformation unveiling themselves.

Very few if any others were affected by his advancement, but there was someone who kept the very core of her existence within a part of Noah's soul who was greatly affected after the recent elevation.
In the Higher Weavings of Existence.

Noah looked at the endless golden threads that still released tendrils of brilliance into him, his white and black eyes flashing as he saw the scene of an Infinite Forge within the depths of his soul.

There, a dense number of golden infinity symbols swirled with a terrific golden light filled with Psioneutrino Particles gushed down like an endless sea that gravitated around all the densely swirling infinity symbols- becoming more potent at every turn.
In the center of it all and absorbing a large part of this...was the figure of Ruination.
Her eyes were closed as her crimson red skin had unique tattoo like markings, the aura she emanated being a dreadful one!
|Inside of the weavings of your Existence, the Tool of the Omniversal Archontes Engineer is being refined.|
Ruination was gaining an unexpected boon while Noah himself broke down just where he was at, pulling his gaze away from her momentarily.
He closed his eyes and felt everything booming within him!

chapters.title: Chapter 3252 Maximus! II
paragraphs: Everything.
The countless threads and interactions within his body.
The threads and interactions outside of his body.
And information flowed.
|The Efficiency of your Existence has attained the absolute level of 100%|
|Your Resistance to Existence Based Weavings has reached 51%.|
|You have attained the Existential Veil of Transcendence.|
The Existential Veil of Transcendence!

Noah focused on this new quality of himself to interpret exactly what had occurred, his will finding an intricate weaving of his Quarks, Leptons, and Psioneutrino Particles dancing around him in an unfathomable way to enact a thing film of golden brilliance around his existence.
It was these waves of interactions that responded to the countless golden strings all around him.
As if he had reached a new frequency or wavelength that corresponded to these Higher Weavings of Existence.
This was the reason he was able to appear in this fantastical space and even absorb the tendrils of golden light from these immeasurably stable strings.

|For any entities who have not escaped the grasp of the Lower Weavings of Existence, their very perception of you will be dulled to the extent that your very Records can cease to ever exist under their gaze.|

|The manipulation of your weavings of existence when facing others will be nearly impossible, with the degree of variation changing based on the level of their Existence. Entities extremely accomplished in the breadth of their existence and yet still incapable of escaping the confines of the Lower Weavings of Existence are still capable of affecting and perceiving you to an unquantifiable extent.|
He gradually understood.
His actions of changing his very makeup of existence had opened up a pathway to a new state of existence extremely early.
This place he was in.
The golden threads endlessly stretching out around him.
It was a form of transcending into another Echelon of existence based purely on his makeup and not on his actual power.
Other entities with an extremely high level of Existence were not able to grasp something like this- with an example being Command Protector Valeria or any other Omniversal Entity.

Their Existence itself was extremely potent and vast in its breadth, but they had yet to fundamentally change the very makeup of existence- or reach a stage where they naturally underwent such a change.
'Maybe further on...'
Noah mused as he looked at the golden threads around him.
Yes.
He theorized that likely, within the Omniversal Realm, one's existence would be potent enough for them to be able to alter their weavings and arrive to a place like this.
For Noah, he had multiple impossible factors to make it a reality this early on.
His action of following threads of an Outerversal Morphon into the Megalos Beyond with over half of his existence to bring about the fruition of Ozymandias.

Then, utilizing Ozymandias to come in contact with Dark Matter, and then owning something like the Infinite Omniverse with its Aletheian Havens as when he mixed all of them, he synthesized a brand new particle!
Only thereafter did all of these possibilities unfold.
Who could say that they had all of these things?
Who could have predicted such a sequence of events from the day that he obtained the Spiritual Land in the Beast World that had not grown to become the Infinite Omniverse?!
'A small and insignificant initial change to certain conditions...can lead to unfathomable results over time...'
HUUM!
His existence buzzed as he repeated these words he heard of a few times.

Behind him, his wings that burned with a colorless white and black grandeur expanded outwards gloriously, the countless threads of golden strings in this area of Higher Weavings of Existence overlapping on their feathers as they gave the illusion that they covered everything!
Causality.
Cause and effect.
When looking at the overall weavings of existence, the infinitesimally small actions and conditions initiated a long time ago always led to increasingly unpredictable results.
Noah learned this when looking at the chaos theory.
Noah heard of this again when looking at the Three Body Problem.
At this moment, his existence sought greater control of this unpredictability as...
|The Organ of the Archontes Engineer, Invictus Maximus, has been fully realized.|
An Organ of his very being.
Something he saw a glimpse of what seemed like forever ago when it was actually not all that far away- something that gave him a glimpse of countless possibilities.
It blazed with brilliance behind him as after extending outwards, the blinding wings retreated to wrap around his body fully with unmatched radiance!
His eyes pulsed as waves of information began to rise.
He saw himself.
His initial conditions.
Where he was currently at.
He then saw the countless unpredictable future results.
Around his figure, his body pulsed with black and white radiance as multiple illusory scenes played out around him.
In one scene, he saw himself standing in an expanse of shattered Domains of Existence.
They looked like massive stretches of obsidian shattered glass, heavy tendrils of Outerversal Authority surging all around!

He saw Command Protector Valeria rushing ahead like a blinding light as a Golden Wheel began to manifest above her, the Three Royal Existential Omniversal Simians following her closely as from behind Protector Lucretia had her eyes closed as if she were trying to sense something.
And around them, flashes of obsidian radiance whipped out at such terrifying speeds that their Existence could barely be observed.
This...was a possible result of existence based on where he currently stood.
Other scenes showed variations of this- some being favorable, while others showed the deaths of some of the Protectors he was with!
At his stage of power, with entities of terrifying levels of existence around him, he could glimpse future conclusions.
And if he altered initial conditions powerfully enough with his knowledge, would he not be able to guarantee a certain result?
His newly formed Organ of the Archontes Engineer blazed.
Invictus Maximus had only just begun to show a tip of its capabilities as its light only became ever more radiant!
With it, he would always ensure victory.
Unconquerable. Invictus!

chapters.title: Chapter 3253 Tainted! I
paragraphs: Unconquerable was the goal.
The end result after countless possible initial conditions and changes that could be made.
And after attaining this current stage of power...
|Hello!|
All weavings came to a halt.
All scenes faded.
In the midst of countless golden threads, Noah turned to his right as there, shockingly, a figure of an Entity could be seen.
An entity he didn't sense the entrance of, nor warned about by his recently appearing Invictus Maximus or any other forms of his power!
It meant that it was an Entity far above him in leagues.

He knew that in this place he termed the Higher Weavings of Existence, there were bound to be other terrifying beings that had appeared before him, and he would slowly explore to see just what was out there!
What he didn't expect was to be found within minutes of his entry.
He looked at the entity where the intent had stemmed from.
Humanoid in nature by all accounts.
Legs and arms that were covered by a white robe, but his head...was entirely bald and far too circular as it only had two white singularities for eyes and a mouth!
No nose. no ears.
The mouth was currently curved into a friendly smile, the white singularities actually showing enthusiasm as they looked towards Noah.
Having such a terrifying entity before him, everything around Noah was retracted as he replied with a calm nod.
|Hello.|
His reply only caused the smile on the entity ahead of him to deepen as his fair skin shone with brilliance.
Around him, Noah could see the golden threads change their movements and gravitate around him in unique motions, entirely different from how they ignored him entirely.
|Hello friend! I haven't seen you around here before. I am Bob, who are you?|
Bob.
A ridiculously simple name was given by this entity as Noah carefully looked at it while reciprocating its demeanor, a smile appearing on him as he replied.
|I am Noah, Noah Osmont. Are you familiar with these parts, Bob?|
Since this entity didn't make a move, neither did Noah.
And this entity, Bob, nodded his head vigorously as he neared Noah.

|Yes, my friend! I've traveled all around these parts. Did you just arrive? When I arrived here, it was hard to find lots of friends to talk to, but now, there are so many! I don't want you to be bored like I was when I first arrived, so how about I take you somewhere special? There's been something I'm itching to get my hands on for a while, and you might just be perfect to help me get it!|
His enthusiasm was unmatched.
He spoke of many things as a great deal of details could be discovered under his calm words, with Noah choosing to go along with it as he nodded.
|Sure.|
He didn't know much about the place he was in.
But he was curious just what oddities and wonders had already transcended their level of existence to arrive here.
|Haha, great! This way, Friend!|
Bob's smile covered all of his face as he came forward and...grasped Noah's hand.
He didn't phase through or miss, Noah feeling the pincers-like grasp as thereafter, Bob squinted his eyes as his other hand tugged on a golden string a distance away from them.
And...
HUUM!
The golden strings vibrated as their figures instantly disappeared- covered by a golden light as Noah felt himself traversing unfathomably vast distances in an extremely short period of time!
As if they were utilizing the golden string that Bob pulled on and taking it to an extremely far away place.
Within moments...
WAP!
Their figures reappeared.
Everything here felt richer.
Golden strings pulsed in abundance.
Noah's eyes were bright as he gazed before them to see a dense cluster of golden strings that formed into the shape of a massive tree.
But this wasn't the most astounding thing.
It was the fact that surrounding this massive tree, golden dew drop shaped fruits hung gloriously- radiating an enticing glare that caused his very own existence to tremble.
Bob had long since released his hand as he crossed his own hands on his chest while speaking with a smile.
|I've taken you a little deeper into the Expanse, Friend. The tree you see before us is one of the many fun things you will come across here, but when I near it...|
His body rapidly floated towards the dense cluster of golden strings that formed the massive tree, but the moment he neared...
HUUM!
His figure became increasingly wrapped with golden strings that stopped his advancement until he couldn't move forward anymore!

|It is very sensitive to complex weavings of existence as someone like me cannot get close. But if it's you, Noah, you should be able to get close no problem! Just grab me a few, and you keep the rest. The taste of the Hearthraes is impeccable, and it can also solidify the weavings of your-|
ROAAR!
In the midst of his words.
A booming roar suddenly echoed out in the distance as Noah's Invictus Maximus Organ pulsed, showing him endless darkness!
In the distance, traveling on thousands of golden strings, a cloud of stellar purple light roared out as it came towards them with immense malice.
The sheer pressure its existence exerted was so terrifying that Noah knew this was not an entity he could face right now.
It was likely in the Omniversal Stage if not higher, with its intent filled with a devouring light of greed hungrily staring at none other than Noah and Bob!
But just as it neared them...
The smile on Bob faded, his hand rising as he tapped out.
A tap.
A single, simple, tap.

And yet...it felt like existence itself had turned its back on the entity formed of purple clouds, the golden strings around it briefly turning black as they released an interminable obsidian wave that instantly caused the whole body of this Entity to break down and disperse!
With a mere tap.
Moments later, the golden strings returned to their normal self as Bob shook his head while smiling again.
|I hate interruptions the most. Ah, so how about it, friend? Can you try and get us some of those Hearthraes? After that, we can have a feast and share some stories.|
Bob.
This terrifying being spoke nonchalantly after eradicating an immeasurably powerful entity with a tap of his fingers.
Noah's figure took everything in strides as he began walking towards the unfathomable cluster of golden lines forming into Authorities as he replied.
|Sure, Bob. Let's try and get these Hearthraes.|
He spoke succinctly as he went forward, his weavings of existence working overtime as he wondered and sought to analyze.
Who the fuck was this Bob?

He didn't phase through or miss, Noah feeling the pincers-like grasp as thereafter, Bob squinted his eyes as his other hand tugged on a golden string a distance away from them.
And...
HUUM!
The golden strings vibrated as their figures instantly disappeared- covered by a golden light as Noah felt himself traversing unfathomably vast distances in an extremely short period of time!
As if they were utilizing the golden string that Bob pulled on and taking it to an extremely far away place.
Within moments...
WAP!
Their figures reappeared.
Everything here felt richer.
Golden strings pulsed in abundance.
Noah's eyes were bright as he gazed before them to see a dense cluster of golden strings that formed into the shape of a massive tree.
But this wasn't the most astounding thing.
It was the fact that surrounding this massive tree, golden dew drop shaped fruits hung gloriously- radiating an enticing glare that caused his very own existence to tremble.
Bob had long since released his hand as he crossed his own hands on his chest while speaking with a smile.
|I've taken you a little deeper into the Expanse, Friend.
The tree you see before us is one of the many fun things you will come across here, but when I near it...|
His body rapidly floated towards the dense cluster of golden strings that formed the massive tree, but the moment he neared...
HUUM!
His figure became increasingly wrapped with golden strings that stopped his advancement until he couldn't move forward anymore!
|It is very sensitive to complex weavings of existence as someone like me cannot get close.
But if it's you, Noah, you should be able to get close no problem!
Just grab me a few, and you keep the rest.
The taste of the Hearthraes is impeccable, and it can also solidify the weavings of your-|
ROAAR!
In the midst of his words.
A booming roar suddenly echoed out in the distance as Noah's Invictus Maximus Organ pulsed, showing him endless darkness!
In the distance, traveling on thousands of golden strings, a cloud of stellar purple light roared out as it came towards them with immense malice.
The sheer pressure its existence exerted was so terrifying that Noah knew this was not an entity he could face right now.
It was likely in the Omniversal Stage if not higher, with its intent filled with a devouring light of greed hungrily staring at none other than Noah and Bob!
But just as it neared them...
The smile on Bob faded, his hand rising as he tapped out.
A tap.
A single, simple, tap.

And yet...it felt like existence itself had turned its back on the entity formed of purple clouds, the golden strings around it briefly turning black as they released an interminable obsidian wave that instantly caused the whole body of this Entity to break down and disperse!
With a mere tap.
Moments later, the golden strings returned to their normal self as Bob shook his head while smiling again.
|I hate interruptions the most.
Ah, so how about it, friend?
Can you try and get us some of those Hearthraes?
After that, we can have a feast and share some stories.|
Bob.
This terrifying being spoke nonchalantly after eradicating an immeasurably powerful entity with a tap of his fingers.
Noah's figure took everything in strides as he began walking towards the unfathomable cluster of golden lines forming into Authorities as he replied.
|Sure, Bob.
Let's try and get these Hearthraes.|
He spoke succinctly as he went forward, his weavings of existence working overtime as he wondered and sought to analyze.
Who the fuck was this Bob?

chapters.title: Chapter 3254 Tainted! II
paragraphs: Bob.
The name buzzed in Noah's mind as on the Infinite Omniverse, another one of his bodies sat on a multicolored throne that was slowly becoming Tainted with a glorious stellar obsidian light.
|The dimensionality and existence of that being seems extremely high, Master. Prolonged contact with them may not be ideal.|
The words of the Infinite Omniverse rang out within his mind as even it couldn't make heads or tails of that entity as of yet.
But since he wasn't designated as an enemy right away, Noah observed how things would play out.
Meanwhile...
|The progress is astounding...|
He turned his attention towards his connection with the Infinite Omniverse as he sensed all the fantastical changes brought about by the constant flow of the Megalos Beyond into it.

His body on the throne also carried the same obsidian bands of tattoos that simmered with brilliance, colorless white and black wings extending behind him as at this moment, within his Atlas of Existence, his Third Mundi of Power pulsed.
The System of Existence of the Ingeniare.
A designation of someone who built and designed things!

At this moment, he found its authority automatically moving and weaving across his connection with the Infinite Omniverse as seconds later, a blue illusory model of the whole Infinite Omniverse bloomed in his mind.
The Extremity Vein.
The Aletheian Havens rotating around it.
|The design of the current Infinite Omniverse has been deemed to not be one of utmost efficiency.|
|A new design is proposed that would increase the output of authority and gradual elevation of existence by 584%|

The System of Existence of the Ingeniare proposed such a thing as inside of Noah's mind, the Aletheian Havens were altered from simply rotating around the Extremity Vein, a new model showing the Havens looking like wide disks that wrapped around the Extremity Vein!
Akin to the Vein rising up and piercing the very center of the circular flat Aletheian Havens as they spun around it and generated terrifying waves of existence.

|The force generated from the interactions of Fundamental Particles of Existence across all Aletheian Havens can be focused towards the very center and utilized for the refinement of Existence, forging of Armaments, and more.|
The Authority of the Ingeniare surged.

It was a part of Noah as he fundamentally made all of it, and it buzzed with activity at this moment as after looking at all the proposed changes he was coming up with himself, he passed them on to the Infinite Omniverse.
And the vibrant construct that was already rapidly changing trembled, even vaster and more fantastical changes of design beginning to take place!
Across the Megalos Ynnere.
Noah opened his eyes and breathed out calmly as he walked past the throne that Protector Lucretia was sitting on while cautiously staring at him.
|Where are you going?|
She hadn't taken her eyes off of him ever since he phased out of and in existence before, her authority trying to grasp him as much as she could.
Noah spoke without looking back.
"We are about to arrive."
|What are you talki-|
HUUM!
As she gazed towards him incredulously, the Omniversal Voyager they were on rapidly slowed down, the voice of the Command Protector Valeria echoing out across the vessel.

|We're entering the bounds of the Half Tainted Omniverse. From here on out, we will proceed with caution. As we discussed, the goal is to not be discovered for as long as possible. The deeper we go in before discovery, the better. If we get found out early, the droves of Agents of Anti-Life we will have to fight through will bog down a great deal of our authority, so avoid this as much as possible. Come on!|
The eyes of Lucretia squinted as she listened to the intent of her sister, rising and following the entity that continued to get ever so mysterious.

Within moments, they had joined all the other members of the Equestris Protectors, with the Command Protector Valeria looking her calm gaze onto Noah's figure that was holding the Kusanagi- Omniversal Cleaver Armament briefly before her authority rose around her in the form of twinkling golden light that gradually became masked obsidian.
This light wrapped around all five of them as their eyes blazed with attention!
|Stay close.|

The words of the Command Protector Valeria were light as their figures disappeared from the vessel a moment later, appearing out into an area that held branches of obsidian vines pulsing with Outerversal Authority.
Noah looked at the waves of authority with familiarity as it almost looked similar to the weavings of some parts of the changing Infinite Omniverse, but not quite.
These seemed...a lot less stable.

Behind them, the Omniversal Voyager miniaturized and disappeared into Command Protector Valeria as she stood in front of them with variance, her body flashing with dimmed radiance as below their feet, an illusory wheel formed.
A wheel full of intricate lines within it as the moment it appeared below them, it began to spin with a dim glow.

The spinning motion absorbed some of the weavings of existence from below and gushed out a thin film of above where their figures stood, a Veil coming to cover them as a moment later, they disappeared and seemed like tendrils of obsidian Outerversal Authority just moving across space!
|Let's go.|
The voice of Command Protector Valeria echoed out as the Three Royal Existential Omniversal Simian Protectors pulled out their Omniversal Armaments.

Protector Lucretia gazed around her at the weavings of the Outerversal Authority tainting the Megalos Ynnere around them as she had a melancholic look, her gaze turning forward to see the smiling face of Noah knowingly nodding towards her as she became stern and gazed ahead.
Noah observed all of this with calm eyes as he had seen this reality play out on multiple different results with the grandeur of Invictus Maximus.
He didn't see everything, but he saw through most things that were to come ahead in this venture.
It was a unique sensation as far ahead, there was an optimum result he was looking forward to the most that he sought to make a reality!

It was the result of aiding the only Omniversal Entity in their midst to successfully take down one of the bodies of Outerversal Morphon Savitar and to use this as an opportunity to do something deeply within the nature of Outerversal Morphons.
To eat up the work of others.
To take the strings of connections to an unknown number of Delegatus the moment that Outerversal Morphon Savitar perished.
It...was also an opportunity for him to test himself. To test his power!

chapters.title: Chapter 3255 Tainted! III
paragraphs: Possibilities of the future unfolding in many possible directions already flashed before Noah's eyes as his job was a simple one.
He had a future in mind, and he simply had to fill in the gaps for it to come to fruition.
The first gap was delving into this massive Half Tainted Omniverse where an Outerversal Morphon had made his home.
Getting past droves of lifeforms it had bent to its will, and eventually getting past the Outerversal Morphon itself!
WU!

A low scream echoed out a light year away as they delved deeper into the Half Tainted Omniverse, Command Protector Valeria turning towards this direction as there, they could see a few black beasts moving on four limbs, their bodies covered by a shrouded of stellar darkness as they only had jaws at the front of their bodies.
They looked massive, and yet...
SAA!
One of them flashed to instantly a pear a few miles from them as a slimy red tongue lashed out from its jaws to taste the surrounding atmosphere.
The first thing to observe was its shocking speed.
A speed that very few Apogee Autarch could even reach as it was a terrifying sight to witness.
The hand of Command Protector Valeria rose as their figures came to a stop, the obsidian wheel spinning below them calmly as their figures remained masked.
The only thing one could sense or feel when gazing in their direction were more tendrils of Outerversal Authority.
SAA!
In a flash, the massive yet speedy beasts disappeared as they resumed their movements once more.
Softly, the voice of Command Protector Valeria rang out in their minds.

|We have come across Agents of Outerversal Morphon Savitar in other Tainted Omniverses where his most powerful bodies reside. We've come to call them another common moniker for a few Agents of Anti-Life- Existence Reapers. They are fast, and their bodies are capable of rapidly corroding existence if they ever get their hands on you. Your tasks once we get discovered will be to disrupt their weavings of existence without letting them get close.|
DUM!
The Wheel below them pulsed as if it was alive and breathing.
The body of Command Protector Valeria had begun to vibrate with concealed power that seemed to be contracting and ready to be released at any moment.
A heavy bloody ax swirling with trillions of crimson galaxies emanating an Omniversal light was grasped by Protector Actaeon.
Protector Orpheus and Ajax grasped a long multi colored spear and a bow respectively, their bodies swirling with intense concentrated weavings of existence as they were ready to go!
Only Noah and Protector Lucretia seemed to be on the nonchalant side as their group delved deeper and deeper into the Half Tainted Omniverse.
Miles away from them, more and more Existence Reapers appeared and disappeared, their massive bodies and wide jaws moving on four limbs pulsing with heavy Outerverversal Authority!

These were past lifeforms who used to thrive in this Omniverse, and they were now turned into other things entirely as a single one could be made from the existence of one powerful Entity or the horrific product of millions of other existences forcefully fused together.
But undoubtedly, each one carried the power of the Outerversal Morphon Savitar.
Each one was a Delegatus!
DUM!
Their surroundings entirely became tinged with obsidian radiance.
The spinning wheel they stood on moved silently as below it, an endless stretch of shattered black glass began to appear.
Tentacles of darkness grew out of them akin to an infestation as a few dozen Existence Reapers were perched on them.
And the deeper they went...
The clusters of Existence Reapers became denser.
Hundreds.
Thousands.
Hundreds of thousands!
DUM!
The breathing of Protector Lucretia could be felt as the multicolored battle robe on her hugged her body ever closer.
The three Royal Existential Omniversal Simian Protectors grasped their weapons ever tighter as they were on high alert!
At this moment, from where they came from, it looked like thousands of Existence Reapers covered everything.
And yet they fearlessly delved deeper as if they were in a nest!
Noah smiled at this scene.
Why were Protectors required to be powerful?
This was the reason why.
They delved into an Omniverse tainted with Outerversal Authority as they were surrounded by millions of Entities that could hurt even an Autarch with a mere touch!
And yet they delved in without fear.
|Be ready.|
Filled with power, Command Protector Valeria's voice echoed out once more.
Even bigger Existence Reapers with tendrils of fur floated around aimlessly as one who was the size of a world passed just miles away from them!
Its hairs vibrated as if feeling the surrounding Existence, but they continued to remain veiled and passed it to go deeper.
Until...
DUM!
Massive tendrils of darkness entered their vision.
Titanic Existence Reapers floated as they radiated sparks of obsidian radiance, their very existence warping nearby space.
Below them, stretches of shattered Domains of Existence lifelessly pulsed within thousands of other Existence Reapers releasing a cacophony of roars.
In the far distance, the pulse of what seemed to be like a breathing living organ could be felt.
The Dark Matter Core that was actively altering this Omniverse- or what remained of it!
Reaching this point was already an astounding enough result as at this moment, Command Protector Valeria came to a stop.
The wheel below them stopped moving forward.
In the next moment.
WUU!
In front of them, a massive furred Existence Reaper opened its jaws and roared out as a crimson tongue radiated waves in front of it!
Waves that instantly disrupted Existence and revealed the five figures floating above an obsidian Wheel.
A buzz of Outerversal Authority began to rise. From all around, millions of Existence Reapers turned their jaws towards their direction.
All the cacophony of noises died down as immense silence filled with blood curdling horror came in.
And at such a time...
|Do not die.|
Command Protector Valeria spoke out coldly as akin to an arrow knocked from a bow, she blasted off!

chapters.title: Chapter 3256 Tainted! IV
paragraphs: Command Protector Valeria was the first one to shoot off as she went towards the depths of this obsidian brilliance- two massive Existence Reapers standing opposite her as the hairs on their bodies instantly elongated and turned into millions of spears that surged towards her.
And yet...
Her eyes only flashed with radiance.

Within her depths, boundless weavings of existence surged as instantly, two spinning golden wheels the same size as the Existence Reapers formed, their glows unfathomable glorious as with a single spin...
RIIP!

They surged forward like disks of existence and sliced the massive Existence Reapers in half, her figure tearing across between them unabashed as not a single tendril of Outerversal Authority touched her!
She went to seek Savitar.
And those who came with her...
SAA!
Were faced with millions of flashing obsidian lights of Existence Reapers who moved at shocking speeds!
Protector Acteon grasped his weapon tighter as golden brilliance surrounded him along with a shout.
|For the Commonwealth!|

A bloodied ax was swung as a flash of obsidian Reaper was pushed away. The other two Royal Existential Omniversal Simian Protectors also moved as their potent existences sought to evade and destroy as many Existence Reapers as they could while pushing forward!
Then, there was Noah.
He had yet to make a move.
Protector Lucretia kept her gaze on him as her body became surrounded by dozens of spinning golden wheels that would rebuff any Existence Reaper coming towards her.
She wondered.
What was this being's power?
She was suspicious and curious.
He said he wasn't a Delegatus of an Outerversal Morphon.
But why?
Why did he act the way he did?
She wanted to see his power with her own eyes as at this moment, she noted a flash of powerful obsidian light surging towards him!
And it wasn't alone as over a dozen other terrified Existence Reapers targeted him.
And he...
Opened his arms out with a smile as Kusanagi remained on his back.
He...actually closed his eyes as he didn't prepare any defenses!
'What the fu-'
Protector Lucretia was incredulous as she instinctively wanted to move to shield him!
But the Existence Reapers were too fast.
The furred limbs of the first one appeared on his chest like spears as even at this moment, he did nothing!
Lucretia nearly closed her eyes to not see the devastation in the next moment.
But...
SAA!
As if he didn't exist. There was no point of impact, and the body of the Existence Reaper passed through his figure as if he weren't real!
SAA! SAA!
The dozen other Reapers sought to smash into him the same, and the same thing repeated where shockingly, their attacks passed through his body as if he didn't truly exist.
His eyes opened wide thereafter as if he had confirmed something.
And his smile was deep as he voiced out and laughed.
"You cannot even touch me."
The level of his power.
The place he had reached.
He was gradually ascertaining it as at this moment, his carefree demeanor and laughter caused a cacophony of noises as tens of thousands of Existence Reapers felt mocked and challenged!
They turned into flashes of obsidian light that came at Noah from all directions.
And fantastically...
SAA! SAA! SAA!
They all phased through him.
His arms were spread out wide as he smiled.
"Glorious."
His voice was magnetic.
Behind him, colorless white and black wings unfurled.
He felt the tens of thousands of Existence Reapers targeting him and the hundreds of thousands buzzing in the background, ready to join the fray.
He saw them all as if they were small particles constantly moving across space and interacting with each other.
Interacting with him.
But their wavelengths could never reach him.
They were on a whole different level of Existence!
His wavelengths though...could reach all of them with surety.
Invictus Maximus blared.
And Noah opened his lips with unfathomable Tyranny and regality.
"Fatality."
A booming circular wave released from his wings with him at the center.
It was so fast that it covered the surrounding thousands of miles in the blink of an eye!
The speedy obsidian flashes of light that were covered by this wave of brilliance stopped.
And a moment later...
POOF!
Their bodies exploded into clouds of stellar obsidian particles!
All tens of thousands of Existence Reapers who were closest nearby!

Every single one, without fail, exploded into a cloud of obsidian particles as Noah beckoned them all towards him in the next moment- these clouds turning into streams of black light that were pulled into his wings.
|The Value of your Outerversal Descent System of Existence has increased by 44.|
|The Value of your Outerversal Descent System of Existence has increased by 68.|
|The Value of your Outerversal Descent System...|
Prompts came and went as all around, a heavy silence remained as Protector Lucretia looked towards Noah with incredulity.
The three Royal Existential Omniversal Simian Protectors drew cold breaths as Protector Actaeon voiced out in shock.
|What the hell, newbie?! You've been holding out on us?|
A level of power that seemed to be nearing the Omniversal Stage buzzed from him.
He seemed unfettered even after the words of Protector Actaeon, his wings flapping with brilliance as he surged forward in the same direction that Command Protector Valeria had disappeared towards.
WU!
In the surroundings, the clouds of thousands of Existence Reapers seemed ever more agitated as they swarmed toward Noah more than anyone else in all directions.

And yet after they clustered towards him by the thousands, they all phased right through his body as his wings would vibrate, and the cluster of Existence Reapers around him would explode into bundles of stellar obsidian clouds that were drawn into his wings!
It was a devastating scene of power.

One that left others shocked as he crossed into the depths of the Half Tainted Omniverse, the pulsing of a Dark Matter Core seemingly radiating an enticing light in the distance while he felt the booming clashes of utterly terrifying power.
What else could they be but the impacts of an Omniversal Entity and an Outerversal Morphon?
There, light years away, a scene he had only observed in possibilities showed itself.
The massive figure of a skeleton with countless limbs rising from it.
Terrific flames burned in its sockets as in the surroundings, hundreds of drained shattered Domains of Existence lay!
Seas of Obsidian radiance surged around him as from them, millions of tentacles filled with Dark Matter pierced into existence.
|I am the One Who Walks.|
WAA!
|A puny thing like you actually dared to aim at a part of me?|
A voice dripping with intense power and majesty.
Filled with deep ancientness and hatred!
It stemmed from Outerversal Morphon Savitar as before him, the small figure of Command Protector Valeria stared forth coldly!

sentences.text: Command Protector Valeria was the first one to shoot off as she went towards the depths of this obsidian brilliance- two massive Existence Reapers standing opposite her as the hairs on their bodies instantly elongated and turned into millions of spears that surged towards her.
And yet...
Her eyes only flashed with radiance.

Within her depths, boundless weavings of existence surged as instantly, two spinning golden wheels the same size as the Existence Reapers formed, their glows unfathomable glorious as with a single spin...
RIIP!

They surged forward like disks of existence and sliced the massive Existence Reapers in half, her figure tearing across between them unabashed as not a single tendril of Outerversal Authority touched her!
She went to seek Savitar.
And those who came with her...
SAA!
Were faced with millions of flashing obsidian lights of Existence Reapers who moved at shocking speeds!
Protector Acteon grasped his weapon tighter as golden brilliance surrounded him along with a shout.
|For the Commonwealth!|
A bloodied ax was swung as a flash of obsidian Reaper was pushed away.
The other two Royal Existential Omniversal Simian Protectors also moved as their potent existences sought to evade and destroy as many Existence Reapers as they could while pushing forward!

She wondered.
What was this being's power?

He said he wasn't a Delegatus of an Outerversal Morphon.
But why?
Why did he act the way he did?
She wanted to see his power with her own eyes as at this moment, she noted a flash of powerful obsidian light surging towards him!
And it wasn't alone as over a dozen other terrified Existence Reapers targeted him.
And he...
Opened his arms out with a smile as Kusanagi remained on his back.
He...actually closed his eyes as he didn't prepare any defenses!
'What the fu-'
Protector Lucretia was incredulous as she instinctively wanted to move to shield him!
But the Existence Reapers were too fast.
The furred limbs of the first one appeared on his chest like spears as even at this moment, he did nothing!
Lucretia nearly closed her eyes to not see the devastation in the next moment.
But...
SAA!
As if he didn't exist.
There was no point of impact, and the body of the Existence Reaper passed through his figure as if he weren't real!
SAA!
SAA!
The dozen other Reapers sought to smash into him the same, and the same thing repeated where shockingly, their attacks passed through his body as if he didn't truly exist.
His eyes opened wide thereafter as if he had confirmed something.

"You cannot even touch me."

The place he had reached.
He was gradually ascertaining it as at this moment, his carefree demeanor and laughter caused a cacophony of noises as tens of thousands of Existence Reapers felt mocked and challenged!
They turned into flashes of obsidian light that came at Noah from all directions.

SAA!
SAA!

His arms were spread out wide as he smiled.

He saw them all as if they were small particles constantly moving across space and interacting with each other.
Interacting with him.
But their wavelengths could never reach him.
They were on a whole different level of Existence!
His wavelengths though...could reach all of them with surety.
Invictus Maximus blared.
And Noah opened his lips with unfathomable Tyranny and regality.
"Fatality."
A booming circular wave released from his wings with him at the center.
It was so fast that it covered the surrounding thousands of miles in the blink of an eye!

POOF!

chapters.title: Chapter 3257 The One Who Walks! I
paragraphs: The One Who Walks.
It was a unique distinction to hear, and the entity who stated it could not be taken lightly as his form was grandiose.
A massive purple skull that cried out utmost glory, with thousands of limbs protruding from behind this skull!
Dazzling purple flames burned in its sockets as around it, debris of decimated Existential Domains lay.
They pulsed weakly with an obsidian light of Corruption as behind this skull, a swirling mass of obsidian light that seemed to be absorbing everything for many light years stood.
The glimpse of the Dark Matter Core.
Command Protector Valeria looked at it all with a calm gaze as her body swirled with the grandeur of a Fabled Omniverse.
She stared deeply into the eyes burning with purple flames as she voiced out.
|I wouldn't aim at any part of you if you just stayed away from our Lands. Must you all be here?|
Her voice held no fear.
She had built up her existence to such an unfathomable extent that even though she knew the enemy before her was a terrible one, this was just one of his bodies.
She could handle a single body.
The purple flames within The One Who Walks sneered as its wide jaws crackled.
|How can we not be here, puny thing? Your Omniverses are akin to untapped fruits waiting to be plucked. This one is almost ripe as your interruption is very much unneeded.|
His voice held unmatched confidence and might.
And yet Command Protector Valeria was undaunted as from behind her, an illusory cerulean wheel rose to her left, and a crimson wheel rose to her right.
They both pulsed with intricate interweavings of lines between them as they emanated ecstatic waves of power.
They released a potent glow of existence that covered her body with celestial auroras of red and blue radiance that easily kept the obsidian radiance of Outerversal Authority at bay!
The purple flames within the socket of Savitar flared at this scene as his booming voice echoed out once more.
|Do you know why they call me the One Who Walks?|
He asked.
And before him, Command Protector Valeria scoffed with a reply.
|Many of your bodies within Tainted Omniverses have asked this question. You seem to really like this accolade.|
|Kaka...!| Her reply caused booming cackling laughter from Savitar as his many limbs clapped and made horrific sounds.
|Yes! If you have heard of me from those who managed to survive my assault, then you may know. But first and foremost...the One Who Walks makes it so that others...will no longer be able to do so.|
WAA!
Obsidian radiance flashed immeasurably quickly.
It covered the whole Half Tainted Omniverse in an instant as wondrously, invisible black lines stretched out and covered everything.
Lines pulsing with Dark Matter that imposed an undeniable Authority.

|Of all those here, none will be able to walk away, O Peon of the Commonwealth. I do not sense from you the quality of existence my other bodies feel from those above-average Peons I have faced before. As sad as it is for you, this is likely the end of your path. Do not worry...I will take from your body and change it to something far greater. This, I promise you.|
HUUUM!

From behind, Noah's figure decimated rows of Existence Reapers to see the glorious scene of shattered Domains of Existence and the figures of Outerversal Morphon Savitar and Command Protector Valeria.
He arrived just in time to hear the words of the One Who Walks as he also turned his flames towards him!
|Oh?|
Seeing the interminable destruction and ease he held, the flames of Savitar were aroused.
|You are...an oddity. You are with her and smell so foreign...and yet familiar at the same time. Have you also come to die?|
Words that could very easily be misconstrued echoed out as Noah arrived gloriously.

Existence Reapers who even neared him with their unfathomable speed exploded before they even neared, their brilliance being pulled towards his wings right after as he floated in with his hands behind his back!
Seeing him, Command Protector Valeria didn't even turn around as her will already captured everything, her intent surging towards him.
|I won't be able to protect you much, so you best have tremendous confidence to be here. If you have any designs or plans, it's best you share them now, otherwise, let me take care of it all.|
Just like the Outerversal Morphon, she blazed with confidence.
It didn't just stem from her Omniversal Stage of power.
It was something deeper.
Her System of Existence!
Noah could now feel it closely as within him, his Third Mundi of Power moved Innately.
Ingeniare was already breaking down the System of Existence that Lucretia utilized, and it was the same for Command Protector Valeria.
Noah smiled as he replied while floating closer.
|You don't worry about me and face him as you would. I will provide support to ensure his fall.|
He spoke confidently as prompts began to fall before his eyes.
|The System of Existence utilized by the core forces of the Commonwealth has been broken down and quantified.|
The System of Existence that the most prominent Entities of the Commonwealth followed.
|The System of Existence of Kuklos is being documented.|
Kuklos!
A word closely related to the weavings of the Wheel!
In the heart of the existence of all Protectors of the Commonwealth, there was a single similarity.
At the base of their Existence, there was the illusion of a Wheel.

|With the mimicking of the Wheel of Existence at their core, the Existence of the followers of the System of Existence of Kuklos face a refinement and elevation of existence at every turn of the Wheel. After their Existence has been raised to a sufficient level, they can utilize the weavings of the Wheel to bend Existence to their will with half the effort and twice the results.|
The dazzling blue and red wheels that appeared behind Command Protector Valeria caused her white skin to flicker with gem-like radiance.
Paired with the spinning Fabled Omniverse coming to life around her, she turned into a radiant beam of light that surged fearlessly toward Savitar!

chapters.title: Chapter 3258 The One Who Walks! II
paragraphs: A beam of unfathomably powerful light that rejected the Outerversal Authority in the surroundings and made way to achieve a single purpose.
Savitar looked at this brilliant light as he scoffed.
He was the One Who Walks.
He walked across the Megalos Beyond and attained a power that allowed him to be distinguished as The Great Savitar.
A Great One.
Many didn't truly understand what this distinction meant in the grand scheme of things.
Even if Savitar was on the lower rungs of a Great One, he was still a Great One!
Even if his Existence was spread out across the Megalos Beyond and Megalos Ynnere, he was still a Great One!
His Body in this Half Tainted Omniverse may only carry a portion of his power, but even this was enough.
Because what he saw under his gaze and what his enemies saw were entirely different.
His flames twisted into a cruel smile as he let this be known.
|Gahaha, your Existence is powerful, but it is crude. Unlike those other Peons of the Commonwealth, you have not attained that State of Existence.|
A State of Existence.

No matter how much power one held over existence, if they did not flow with it as if they were one. If they were not capable of melding with existence and using it to further their alteration of reality, they would not be placed in the rungs of experts.
|Kaka! Let me show you.|
WAA!
His flaming sockets became sharp as for the first time, his body moved forward.
A massive skull filled with thousands of outstretched limbs, and yet its speed was so unfathomable that it disappeared entirely in the next moment!
Command Protector Valeria kept her calm as the potent glow of existence around her only solidified further, but her gaze changed in the next moment as she turned around.
The thousands of limbs of Savitar were like spears as they bloomed half an inch away from Noah's figure that was floating calmly.
Too fast.
No matter her power, Command Protector Valeria would not be able to reach her on time!
A single limb of Savitar was faster than all others as like a sharp spear, it thundered above Noah's head and crashed into him instantly!
The only thing that would be left would be decimation.
|That is but a glimpse of the pain to come for you, Little Peon. You have other compatriots just like him, yes? They will follow you in deat-...?|
His words didn't finish as he noticed something ecstatic.

His limb smashing onto Noah's figure didn't cause the complete erasure of existence, and wondrously, it was like his spear-like limbs were hitting a very stretchy net- much of its force becoming dissipated as the impact that did arrive only smashed his target downwards rapidly as he smashed onto a shattered glass Domain of Existence in the distance!
BOOM!
And even on this shattered Domain of Existence, his body bounced as if it were a balloon.
His figure was still intact.
On his face was a profound expression and a smile as he confirmed a single thing!
The Existence of Savitar was too profound as he was still able to affect his Existence.
And yet the extent of this effect showed that much of the power of this being would be dissipated, and what remained...
"Ah..." Noah brought his hand to his forehead where the sharp point of the limb of Outerversal Morphon Savitar had hit.
There, a drop of incandescent golden blood dripped, his fair skin split open slightly as it already began to heal.
Potent obsidian waves of light sought to ravage this wound and make it even more disastrous, and yet they were devoured seamlessly under the skin as they disappeared.
"You have caused me to bleed."
His finger traced the closing wound as his words caused the One Who Walks to gaze down at him blankly!
Above him, his thousands of limbs rose instinctively as two massive crimson and cerulean wheels smashed towards him while spinning.

The fur on his limbs buzzed like a rough hide as they grasped the intricate structures within the Wheels, bearing their heavy weight as the purple flames within its sockets kept their gaze locked on to Noah!
But the weight of the Wheels was unfathomably heavy- the existence they carried being undeniable as a dozen limbs were twisted and broken from the pressure.
Yet Savitar didn't bat an eye.
|Interesting.|
HUUM!
Instead, obsidian singularities filled with Dark Matter began to appear en masses all around.
In this whole space and as far as the eye could see.

And from these singularities, cylindrical beams of scorching obsidian radiance erupted out in two directions- forming what seemed like two Pillars of pure Outerversal Authority connected to a singularity anchored in space as they began to rotate and spin!
SHIING!
They covered all nearby surroundings.
They constantly spun like milestones that would crush anyone on their path!

Command Protector Valeria's red hair fluttered gorgeously as her body twisted sideways to evade the swing of one of these obsidian Pillars of pure Outerversal Authority, her figure shooting back towards Savitar as she kept part of her gaze on Noah.

Below her feet, a golden wheel bloomed and expanded, smashing into and stopping the spins of nearby Pillars of obsidian radiance while her hands twisted- the crimson and cerulean wheels that Savitar held off with his limbs bearing down with even greater pressure as she voiced out coldly.
|Your opponent is me, O One Who Walks.|
Her might was indomitable even in the face of this Outerversal Morphon!
And yet even at such a time...
"What State of Existence are you talking about, Outerversal Morphon Savitar?"
Noah's voice echoed out in its midst as the wound on his forehead had already closed.
The State of Existence that Command Protector Valeria had yet to reach.

The Flames of Savitar flickered after receiving such a nonchalant question in the midst of all of this, and in the next moment, his massive figure disappeared into the surrounding space once more before hundreds of his limbs turned into spears that bloomed in front of Noah!
But now, they were painted with thunderous flames of obsidian brilliance, Savitar's voice echoing out as these spears came in contact with Noah instantly.

|You are interesting. It is a shame only this small body is here, I would love to inspect you with my main body too...how about you make a trip to the Megalos Beyond with me? I will answer all your questions there.|
Even as he made a horrendous attack, he spoke so simply.
And Noah, with his Existential Veil of Transcendence, got a chance to test exactly what the limits of his defenses were!

Below her feet, a golden wheel bloomed and expanded, smashing into and stopping the spins of nearby Pillars of obsidian radiance while her hands twisted- the crimson and cerulean wheels that Savitar held off with his limbs bearing down with even greater pressure as she voiced out coldly.
|Your opponent is me, O One Who Walks.|
Her might was indomitable even in the face of this Outerversal Morphon!
And yet even at such a time...
"What State of Existence are you talking about, Outerversal Morphon Savitar?"
Noah's voice echoed out in its midst as the wound on his forehead had already closed.
The State of Existence that Command Protector Valeria had yet to reach.

The Flames of Savitar flickered after receiving such a nonchalant question in the midst of all of this, and in the next moment, his massive figure disappeared into the surrounding space once more before hundreds of his limbs turned into spears that bloomed in front of Noah!
But now, they were painted with thunderous flames of obsidian brilliance, Savitar's voice echoing out as these spears came in contact with Noah instantly.
|You are interesting.
It is a shame only this small body is here, I would love to inspect you with my main body too...how about you make a trip to the Megalos Beyond with me?
I will answer all your questions there.|
Even as he made a horrendous attack, he spoke so simply.
And Noah, with his Existential Veil of Transcendence, got a chance to test exactly what the limits of his defenses were!

chapters.title: Chapter 3259 State of Existence! I
paragraphs: As Noah tested the limits of his Existential Veil of Transcendence.
There was another gaze that was directed towards the Half Tainted Omniverse, and this gaze was one filled with interminable brutality, and concentrated shrewdness.
Far above the Half Tainted Omniverse.
A cloud of darkness could barely be seen as it had melded into the tendrils of Outerversal Authority in the surroundings.
Even against the Existence of another entity with the Great One distinction in the Half Tainted Omniverse below, this cloud of brilliance was not discovered!
|I have you to thank, my Little Delegatus.|
His deep gaze stared past the crowds of Existence Reapers being killed or pushed away by brilliant spinning wheels under the command of Protector Lucretia.
Her red hair was akin to burning flames as dazzling crimson Wheels that sought to imitate something very few could understand spun.
|Such a shame that your Sister has not yet become One With Existence.|
One With Existence!

A terrifying state of being where the concentration and the interactions that one's existence had with the surrounding reality was so in tune and full of resonance that they intrinsically became one with their surrounding existence.
When they acted, they would come to find that very little of their Authority would be required to achieve the same result.

If they had to release an attack that could wound an enemy at the Omniversal Stage, they would come to find that they could release the same attack, but with barely a hundredth of the required authority to cast it!
What they could do was filled with endless possibilities.

The Protectors that had reached such a height with their existence were the ones that the bodies of Great Ones and other Outerversal Morphona within the Megalos Ynnere commonly fought against. |Mmm, very well, I would lend a little bit of aid to ensure that this body of Savitar's is cut off. He will suspect something...but he won't be entirely sure as by the time he even reacts, I would have bound all of the Delegatus connected to this body of his.|

The cloudy gaze flickered as at this moment, it did more than just see. From above the Half Tainted Omniverse, a terrifying but silent authority began to leak out and cover the domain of the One Who Walks.
It released waves of resonance with all nearby weavings of existence to the point that it seemed like they were fully part of it!
|What say you, oddity?|
The One Who Walks rebuffed the terrifying wheels of Command Protector Valeria, his gaze on the figure of Noah that continued to pull his interest in a way that he could not fully understand.
For some reason, the very weavings of Dark Matter inside of his existence felt an enticing pull that wanted to bring this entity to him the more that his limbs clashed with him
The One Who Walks made a single definitive conclusion. This oddity had the power to defend against his terrifying waves of Outerversal Authority, but he did not have the power to wound him.
It was as if he had reached a terrifying state of defensive existential prowess, but his offensive side had not caught up just yet.

'How come? What exactly did you attain that makes it so that without even a Fabled Omniverse like the rest of the Peons of the Commonwealth, you can survive against existence-altering strikes filled with Outerversal Authority?'
The more he thought about it, the more enticing this oddity seemed!

Around this space, the obsidian beams spinning around singularities carried horrific intent as Command Protector Valeria destroyed some while evading others, her body beginning to expand an utterly gorgeous Omniverse that erased everything it came across.
Omniverse.
Could one even wrap their mind around such an idea? For the power of a single being to emulate the might and existence of an Omniverse?!
BOOM!
The power Savitar displayed was shocking, with Command Protector Valeria showing her own glory, but at this moment...
|Huh?|
The purple flames in Savitar's skeletal sockets flickered as he sensed something.
Something that had melded into the very fabric of existence of this entire Half Tainted Omniverse, and even himself!
Anger quickly rose soon after as Savitar felt his authority get restricted greatly.
Silently!
|WHO?!|
His booming shout echoed out, but there was no reply.

The extremely perceptive Command Protector Valeria instantly felt the crushing wheels she summoned that were being held at bay move down with much reduced resistance- tearing through the beams of Outerversal Authority much quicker as she made her way towards Savitar with much more ease!
It was a unique progression as it felt like half of the power of Savitar was effectively cut off.
She didn't know if it was a scheme. She didn't know why. She only used this chance to ensure the completion of their objective here today.
The decimation of one of Savitar's bodies and the destruction of a Dark Matter Core.
|YAA!|
Her existence burned brilliantly as she used this chance to release one of her strongest attacks- seeking to not give Savitar any chance to unleash his power after he fell into this weakened state!
Above and below, radiant crimson and cerulean wheels formed.
A scorching hell above, an endless sea below.

Their sizes were pristine, but the color and dangerous waves of existence that these Wheels released were even more glorious to look at as they sought to mimic and pull from the sheer standing of the Wheel of Existence that very few understood!

The wheels spun and applied an unfathomably heavy pressure on the massive body of Savitar, his limbs creaking and shattering as his Outerversal Authority...was not capable of stopping its advancement as easily.
It was a drastic change.
Something had interfered and made things this way!
'Who? Who?! Who?!' Savitar felt increasing anger as with his power, he felt the weavings of Existence rapidly tilt away from his favor for this body here.
And he at least wanted to know who was responsible!

chapters.title: Chapter 3260 State of Existence! II
paragraphs: At the same time, the figure of Noah below Savitar exploded with authority as his colorless white and black wings stretched out brilliantly.
Invictus Maximus.
They foresaw the assurance of a favored result.
Under his gaze, his Third Mundi of Power pulsed as Ingeniare blazed like flames that were only just beginning to burn.
They clustered in his eyes as he saw...the foreign appearance of an unbreakable Outerversal Authority covering everything like a ceiling.
And this ceiling was akin to a blanket of Dark Matter that effectively cut off a large part of Savitar's power from the Megalos Beyond where his main body should be!
A foreign interference that would go to help them- of course, it wasn't for no reason.
'Interesting...'

His eyes twinkled as his own movements didn't stop. The wings turned into dazzling colorless white and black feathers that formed into lines that began to bind the Limbs of Savitar, some even seeking to wrap around his massive skull to anchor this being in place as two wheels rotated above and below him.
Noah was within this same space, yet the terrifying power of these Wheels was not directed at him- but even if they were, he had interminable confidence to withstand them.

But the power of Command Protector Valeria was not to be scoffed at as she directed her authority to achieve her goal here, Savitar roaring out as the honor and grace of a Great One was being spat on at this moment.

|Impudence! You think that you are taking on an opportunity when you're falling into the schemes of others. Someone else has just made a move and you're only acting as a sword on their behalf! Take a step back and think before doing someone else's bidding, O Peon of the Commonwealth!|
His authoritative voice boomed out as if he still controlled everything.
Yet neither Noah nor Command Protector Valeria stopped their actions as the expansion of Noah's wings began to light up with the Authority of the Administrator of the Atlas of Existence!
The colorless hue was much deeper.

It almost seemed liquefied and more real as the power of all three of his Systems of Existence were pulled upon to momentarily aid in holding down an Entity who far exceeded the stages of Existential Dominium Realm- and should have been someone only those in the Omniversal Stage could handle.
Yet Noah's Existential Veil of Transcendence made many things possible.
|Fools!|

The cruel voice of Savitar boomed out as its authority could not suppress both Noah and Command Protector Valeria- his skull beginning to gain visible cracks as the hundreds of spinning Pillars of obsidian radiance stopped being anchored in space and converged towards his body like splicing beams of Existence.
Noah knew his words were not false.
His mind already worked out all the possibilities as he already had an idea of what the foreign interference was!
Since it was a Veil of Dark Matter, the culprit was another Outerversal Morphon.
And out of many possible Outerversal Morphons, who else would know precisely where they were and what they were doing?
He smiled silently as the face of Protector Lucretia rose up.
'Is this the influence of the one who bound you?
He asked such a question to himself as he then placed himself in the perspective of the foreign Outerversal Morphon who leaked Savitar.
What could he gain from this? From a body of Savitar being destroyed?
Noah's eyes radiated unfathomable radiance.
'You are here doing exactly the same thing as me?'
What was he doing right now? He was also interfering and keeping the weakened body of an Outerversal Morphon in place so that after his death...
The Delegatus he had bound would be his!
Now, it seemed there was another seeking to do the same thing.
So who would come out on top? Who would claim the ultimate prize?
|I will not sit here and be disgraced by a bunch of kids being used by others.|
The deep voice of Savitar echoed out as he stopped struggling.

His purple flames gazed above at Command Protector Valeria who looked like a celestial controlling parts of the Wheel of Existence, and he then gazed below towards Noah and his wings that had turned into countless threads encapsulating him!
|A Great One cannot be disgraced by those who are not. You all have managed to earn my ire today, and I will come to collect.|
The words were intense as the expression of Command Protector Valeria instantly changed, her intent booming out towards Noah.
|Release him!|
It was a shout for him to let go.
For him to move as far away as possible.
But even in this situation, Noah did not move a muscle and remained right where he was.
His wings were telling him that this was where he had to be if he wanted to achieve his aims!
The sockets of Savitar instantly extinguished all radiance as his intent rang out for the last time.
|Feel a glimmer of my wrath.|
BOOOM!
He did not wait for his existence within this body to be extinguished.
He ended it himself- and he did so in the most terrifying way possible.
He detonated everything this body stood for!
An Entity with the Distinction of a Great One would rather detonate one of his bodies than face the disrespect and schemes of others!

A blinding obsidian light that unraveled all weavings of Matter exploded out Command Protector Valeria grit her teeth as her figure flickered, stepping on the crimson wheel above as her figure disappeared and was teleported on the blue wheel below- her figure rising up and seeking to pull Noah away from the point of the explosion!
At the same time, dozens of vibrant illusory wheels manifested around them like bastions of unbreakable shields.
The impact was heavy.
Everything felt like it was broken.
The wheels called out shattered and reformed rapidly as the obsidian light was so blinding that Command Protector Valeria had to close her eyes.
The very weavings of matter felt like they were decimated!
Any form of existence would feel a burning sensation as if they were being scorched out of existence!
But in the midst of all this, as she began to feel her existence burning and her Omniversal Armament become torn....Command Protector Valeria felt a body cover her.
She felt her head pushed into a strong chest, and her back wrapped by strong hands filled with unfathomable steadiness.
And the burning of her existence stopped right after.
All weavings of existence were in chaos as even she couldn't easily see what was happening.
But above her, millions of dazzling threads connecting to Delegatus nobody else could see but a single man flashed ever so briefly.
And within this period of time, all of these threads were absorbed into colorless white and black wings as they traversed rapidly across a Second Mundi of Power!

chapters.title: Chapter 3261 The Oriole! I
paragraphs: A burning sensation.
The self-implosion of one of the bodies of an Outerversal Morphon was not a simple thing, where even Noah, with his Existential Veil of Transcendence, was affected by a large degree!

Those who had not stepped into a higher dimension of existence- the place he called the Higher Weavings of Existence and the place referred to by the unfathomable entity, Bob, as the Expanse...could still injure him.
If their existence was powerful and potent enough, they could still reach him.
He wanted to gauge just to what extent they could still reach him as the action that Savitar had taken made this abundantly clear.

Two conclusions were made as Noah's wings were retracted gloriously, wrapping around the body of Command Protector Valeria while he withstood the endless burning rays of an imploding Outerversal Morphon while also taking in the strings of connections leading to millions of Delegatus.
'Low ranking Omniversal Stage Entities will have the vast majority of damage mitigated against me, with any injuries dealt being inconsequential.'
The first conclusion.
Noah smiled under the burning rays of obsidian radiance as he confirmed the previous statement during this fight with Savitar, and bringing into account the power of Command Protector Valeria.
'And depending on the System of Existence utilized by the enemy, the mitigation of damage can be further increased.'
Yes.

He, as an Outerversal Morphon who was now getting to grasp Dark Matter, with his body even made up of Psioneutrino Particles formed from Dark Matter- was highly resistant to this fundamental aspect of Existence.
Thus, even though the implosion of Savitar was heavy as it dealt injuries that actually burnt a bit of existence, he could still stand it!
Part of his feathery wings were scorched as they healed rapidly, and his skin carried third-degree burns that rapidly began to close up and heal.
Behind him, the obsidian radiance calmly faded as not a single ounce of reality floated there.
Their surroundings were filled with chaotic weavings of Matter and Dark Matter, Outerversal Authority still ravaging everything nearby as slowly, light returned.

Noah's wings that covered him and a figure in his arms opened wide, light flowing down to dance on the crimson red hair of Command Protector Valeria as her head rose from his chest and came to stare at him.
Her beauty alone with heart shaking as anybody who had forged a Fabled Omniverse emanated such pure grace and honor that very few could even stare at without bowing their head down.
And yet...
She stared deeply and calmly into Noah's eyes as he stared back without worry.
The Honor of his Existence.
The Dignity.

They were all so high that she was shockingly the one who found her eyes pressured, her figure pulling away from his body as she gazed up towards the patch of scorched existence and the humming Dark Matter Core in the far distance.
After confirming the erasure of Savitar, she turned her gaze back towards Noah as her voice echoed out.
|What are you exactly after?|

|You unveiled my sister's situation, were unfettered by it, and you stood against an Outerversal Morphon to ensure its death. Your actions are contradictory as I cannot leave it alone without understanding exactly what you want. Old Man Eudemus has vouched for your existence, but...|
Her eyes swirled with two golden wheels.
She was slowly recovering her power as she wondered about the weavings of the man before her!
Noah looked at this powerful Protector of the Commonwealth before him as he smiled.
His body fully healed as his wings retreated into his back and disappeared.
His magnetic voice then echoed out with words that caused the eyes of Command Protector Valeria to tremble.
|I can break off the connection between your Sister and the Outerversal Morphon who had bound her.|
Words that were akin to a bomb echoed out.
By sheer proximity alone, the moment that this body of Savitar died, all the connections it had would briefly fall into a limbo before they were destroyed.
In the state of limbo, the closest and most powerful Outerversal Morphon there could obtain all of these connections.
Far above the Half Tainted Omniverse where one of the bodies of a Great One had imploded...there was an Entity.

And he was the only one here with such an influence of an Outerversal Morphon who could pull the threads of connections, even if it was only a mere glimmer of himself that was here in order to not be seen by Savitar himself.

So the veiled entity who had interfered and blocked off Savitar's source of power prepared as the moment he affirmed the brilliant light of Savitar to be extinguished here, his authority spread out to capture the countless lines associated with him before they disappeared!
And.
And...
|Huh?|
The lines never came.
|What...?|
The veiled Will buzzed.
Its authority encapsulated everything nearby, including the Half Tainted Omniverse below!
And still, nothing!
As if the many lines of Delegatus under the banner of this body of Savitar were never free to be taken.
Or...
'Somebody else has taken them?'
A daring possibility.
But there was only this single possibility!
There was an Outerversal Morphon even closer to Savitar than him, and they had taken control of all the connections in limbo the moment that he died.
And who could it be?
He knew the identities of all new entrants into this past domain of Savitar.
He knew all of them except for one.
The records of Protector Lucretia flashed before the weavings of this entity.
And soon...the visage of a man appeared.
'Hazy...'
He was hazy to see.
This showed how powerful of an existence this entity was to the extent that he couldn't fully be viewed with records by even someone like him!
But he still had the gaze and words of Lucretia.
Of the new Entity who joined their team.
'Noah...Osmont, is it?'
The Will of a Great One burned brightly as it turned its gaze towards a single man!
