He, as an Outerversal Morphon who was now getting to grasp Dark Matter, with his body even made up of Psioneutrino Particles formed from Dark Matter- was highly resistant to this fundamental aspect of Existence.
Thus, even though the implosion of Savitar was heavy as it dealt injuries that actually burnt a bit of existence, he could still stand it!
Part of his feathery wings were scorched as they healed rapidly, and his skin carried third-degree burns that rapidly began to close up and heal.
Behind him, the obsidian radiance calmly faded as not a single ounce of reality floated there.
Their surroundings were filled with chaotic weavings of Matter and Dark Matter, Outerversal Authority still ravaging everything nearby as slowly, light returned.

Noah's wings that covered him and a figure in his arms opened wide, light flowing down to dance on the crimson red hair of Command Protector Valeria as her head rose from his chest and came to stare at him.
Her beauty alone with heart shaking as anybody who had forged a Fabled Omniverse emanated such pure grace and honor that very few could even stare at without bowing their head down.
And yet...
She stared deeply and calmly into Noah's eyes as he stared back without worry.
The Honor of his Existence.
The Dignity.

They were all so high that she was shockingly the one who found her eyes pressured, her figure pulling away from his body as she gazed up towards the patch of scorched existence and the humming Dark Matter Core in the far distance.
After confirming the erasure of Savitar, she turned her gaze back towards Noah as her voice echoed out.
|What are you exactly after?|
|You unveiled my sister's situation, were unfettered by it, and you stood against an Outerversal Morphon to ensure its death.
Your actions are contradictory as I cannot leave it alone without understanding exactly what you want.
Old Man Eudemus has vouched for your existence, but...|
Her eyes swirled with two golden wheels.
She was slowly recovering her power as she wondered about the weavings of the man before her!
Noah looked at this powerful Protector of the Commonwealth before him as he smiled.
His body fully healed as his wings retreated into his back and disappeared.
His magnetic voice then echoed out with words that caused the eyes of Command Protector Valeria to tremble.
|I can break off the connection between your Sister and the Outerversal Morphon who had bound her.|
Words that were akin to a bomb echoed out.
By sheer proximity alone, the moment that this body of Savitar died, all the connections it had would briefly fall into a limbo before they were destroyed.
In the state of limbo, the closest and most powerful Outerversal Morphon there could obtain all of these connections.
Far above the Half Tainted Omniverse where one of the bodies of a Great One had imploded...there was an Entity.

And he was the only one here with such an influence of an Outerversal Morphon who could pull the threads of connections, even if it was only a mere glimmer of himself that was here in order to not be seen by Savitar himself.

So the veiled entity who had interfered and blocked off Savitar's source of power prepared as the moment he affirmed the brilliant light of Savitar to be extinguished here, his authority spread out to capture the countless lines associated with him before they disappeared!
And.
And...
|Huh?|
The lines never came.
|What...?|
The veiled Will buzzed.
Its authority encapsulated everything nearby, including the Half Tainted Omniverse below!
And still, nothing!
As if the many lines of Delegatus under the banner of this body of Savitar were never free to be taken.
Or...
'Somebody else has taken them?'
A daring possibility.
But there was only this single possibility!
There was an Outerversal Morphon even closer to Savitar than him, and they had taken control of all the connections in limbo the moment that he died.
And who could it be?
He knew the identities of all new entrants into this past domain of Savitar.
He knew all of them except for one.
The records of Protector Lucretia flashed before the weavings of this entity.
And soon...the visage of a man appeared.
'Hazy...'
He was hazy to see.
This showed how powerful of an existence this entity was to the extent that he couldn't fully be viewed with records by even someone like him!
But he still had the gaze and words of Lucretia.
Of the new Entity who joined their team.
'Noah...Osmont, is it?'
The Will of a Great One burned brightly as it turned its gaze towards a single man!

chapters.title: Chapter 3262 The Oriole! II
paragraphs: The thoughts of a Great One buzzed.
Yes. A Great One!
The one holding the string of Protector Lucretia was a Great One as naturally, only someone of this caliber would dare to make a move on an entity like Savitar.
But for all of his efforts to go to waste- for someone else to reap the rewards of his efforts...
The Great One mulled silently.

Noah Osmont was a Protector. From the records of Lucretia, a newly added one at that, as it meant he had to be adorned and cleared to not be on the side of Anti-Matter or Dark Matter before he was given such a distinction.
And yet...he was an Outerversal Morphon!
|Interesting...who are you? You cannot be a nobody, and you should have sensed my intervention. Yet you did what you did regardless. You dared to steal from me...|
The Will of a Great One formed a chilling smile as its intent weaved.
For this Entity, he always had the tendency to know everything about his enemies before he made a move.

He found the process of information collection the most thrilling, as after all possible knowledge about his target was known, he could easily dismember them, their power, and everything else under their banner!
Savitar had fallen to be one of his many targets as he knew a great deal about him.

Like where one of his bodies was hidden, and how he could expose it to the Peons of the Commonwealth to have Protectors sent to kill this body of Savitar on his behalf- only for him to reap the rewards.
He planned, learned, and schemed, and when he made a move...he may even use others as he wouldn't make the move himself!
He had lived far too long.
'Too many eons and cycles can make anyone paranoid...'
He had seen again and again entities of Unfathomable power be toppled, their weavings of existence only ever showing shock and disbelief when they perished.
An Outerversal Morphon staring in shock towards him as they believed him to be their closest ally, and yet he killed them.

An Outerversal Morphon who knew nothing about him, but had gained an opportunity of a Grave of the Great Beyonder that held Pure Dark Matter Crystals. He lost his life even before any of this could be enjoyed.

A Protector of the Commonwealth who had a bright future ahead of her as her Sister had attained the Omniversal Stage and she herself wasn't too far off...only to find herself forced to be a Delegatus of the very enemies she was fighting again!
There were many examples of those who had fallen to his whims and plans.
And even with all preparations, things could still fail unexpectedly as they did just now due to something he couldn't have even accounted for.
Due to someone.
The Great One felt a thrill rising within him as he found himself a new target.
With the current Will he had here, he could even choose to make a move against this being right now.
But the chances of success were unknown since he did not know much about him.
And even if he destroyed a single body, so what?
He would have other bodies out there.
Some on Megalos Ynnere. Some in Megalos Beyond.
He would find out where every piece of him lay, and only then would he make a move!
'Ahh, I can already taste it...this will be a long hunt!'
His will buzzed with tremendous weavings of existence.
Down below, Savitar had mentioned a State of Existence.
One With Existence.
This was only the first State of Existence that entities who had greatly forged their Existence could attain.
For those who were even grander, their Existence would begin to change and be distorted.
Until they developed something...utterly unfathomable to others.
HUUUM!
Silently, around the veiled Will of a Great One that was filled with endless darkness melded with existence...the outline of an Eye formed!
The Eye of Existence!
A piercing eye that could get past endless lies and discover countless truths of Existence!
This Eye opened wide at this moment and locked onto none other than Noah Osmont.
'Let us see...'
At this stage of power, Entities could veil weavings of their existence very well, even to the extent that their records would be things others could not find out.
Utilizing the Eye of Existence, this Great One was going about it a different way.
He didn't alert his new target, but his Eye of Existence pulled on the records of his surrounding Existence.
Where he had appeared before.
How he had interacted with the Existence of his surroundings.
The terrifying authority of this Great One focused entirely on the interactions his target had with surrounding weavings of Existence and nothing else!
And the Eye saw.
Interactions within this Half Tainted Omniverse.
Interactions leading to a Vessel.
Interactions tracing all the way back to the Omniverse of the Protectors.
It was glimpses- mere pieces, but it gradually formed a story.
The story of his target!
The Eye continued to see as from the Omniverse of the Protectors, it grasped the weavings of another vessel that traversed Great distances.
And this vessel originated from another Omniverse.
'Oh, a newly discovered one?'
Omniverse X-999!
The Great One traced the interactions of Existence all the way back there as in this place...there were too many interactions!
'Is this...one of your homes?'
The Great One that had reached the state of attainment of the Eye of Existence smiled with unfathomable brilliance.
'Let's probe around and discover more, shall we?'
The information he was getting was too sparse.
Only interactions.
They told him a lot, but also very little.
'Let's see, how about using others again?'
His weavings moved.
A newly discovered Omniverse.
This was a prize as what if he led some Outerversal Morphons there?
'Hmm...hmmm!' The Great One hummed a tune as he realized he was enjoying this particular hunt a great deal.
This was because in all the interactions he was uncovering with his powerful State of Existence, he still didn't uncover any truly personal details about his target.
He wanted to know more!
He was a Great One.
He was the Great Ponderor, Nietzsche!
And he would come to know.
He would come to understand.
Only after he understood would he make a move.
And by the time he made a move, his enemy would already be defeated!

chapters.title: Chapter 3263 Dictum! Decree! Ordinance! I
paragraphs: Within the Expanse.
What Noah called the Higher Weavings of Existence.
His figure that had reached the depths of the incandescent cluster of golden lines forming the huge tree stopped momentarily as he frowned.
The wings behind him fluttered.
Invictus Maximus released a warning.
But the warning was messy and without a whole lot of information!
Noah focused on it and quickly locked down where its source stemmed from, his weaving pointing to nothing else but the Half-Tainted Omniverse, where one of Savitar's bodies had just perished.
Where he had stolen millions of lines of connections and sent them towards Ozymandias.
Who had he stolen from? Who was scheming and had acted in the middle of the battle to reduce Savitar's power by half?
'The Master of Protector Lucretia...'
The Outerversal Morphon who had bound Lucretia!
Noah's eyes shone brightly as he was certain this sense of danger stemmed from this being as currently, there could be no others.
He began to think and plan.
|My friend, you're almost there, come on!|
Behind him, the figure of Bob was jumping up and down with excitement as if cheering him on- his intent focused on the Hearthraes dangling like glimmering cosmos on this tree.
The Hearthraes were shaped like golden dewdrops filled with immensely concentrated existence, and unlike when Bob went forward...Noah didn't face restrictions that stopped him whatsoever.
His hand simply reached out and grasped the golden dew drop, plucking it lightly as when he did, it was like a string had been cut.
TRIING!
Vibrations spread out across the countless golden strings nearby, with Noah's Existence locking onto the dewdrop in his hands!

|Hearthrae|:: A unique type of Existence that forms in order to be assimilated into the weavings of another Existence- a type of Katholikon. The peak of achievement of its existence is when it is devoured, with the boons it provides being solely dependent on the one who devoured and assimilates it. Entities whose Existence holds an unshakable foundation, potential, records, and complexity of weavings paired with the amount of time their weavings have been active will be capable of benefiting a great deal. An Existence who is more powerful but with a weaker foundation or advanced in the passage of time will experience much less benefit, albeit the taste of a Hearthrae will remain impeccable.
A ridiculous treasure.
Something Noah had never grasped before, with this item actually benefiting those who were youngest since their existence was active!
But how many entities who were extremely young could achieve a Transcendence of their existence and arrive in this place?
There were an unknown number of even Omniversal Stage Entities above Noah who had not arrived at this stage of existence!
Likely, it was entities who had their weavings of existence active for millions, billions, or even eons and cycles of existence who would be in a place like this.
Someone like Bob.
But uniquely, Bob was so powerful and complex that his very weavings were prevented from getting near this unique location!
It was an oddity of wonder of this Higher Weavings of Existence.
Of the place Bob called the Expanse!
Noah grasped the Hearthrae in his hand as he felt the golden dew drop buzz with excitement, waves of golden light actually releasing from it as they formed into an intent that said...
|Eat me!| |Eat me!| |Eat me!!!|
Right.
This treasure was actually a type of existence, but it formed for the sole purpose of being devoured.
Its achievement in life was to be devoured!
And its weavings made this abundantly clear as it almost danced on Noah's hand.
|Haha, good! Grab some more, my Friend. The more the merrier!|
Bob's voice echoed out from behind as Noah gazed at the vibrant countless strings making up this tree and moved towards all the areas holding golden dew drops.
It was serene.
Peaceful.
As if he had become the farmer he always envisioned himself being at the end of everything, and he was harvesting fruits while literally surrounded by golden strings of radiance all around.
HUUM!

His existence felt a sense of profound serenity and peace as he plucked one golden dew drop after another, losing his own sense of time entirely as he felt like he was doing the most mundane and yet the most fantastical thing at the same time.
The moment he came to grasp his sense of time once more, he found himself at the very top of the Golden tree cluster of lines.
All dew drops were picked clean as they gravitated around him, overflowing from his arms and wings!
The moment he plucked the last dew drop.
The last Hearthrae on this glittering tree.
HUUM!

The countless threads of golden lines trembled before converging towards a single plasmic golden line- this line burning with brilliance as it turned its sharp end towards Noah and surged forward at speeds far faster than his existence could even keep up.
SAA!
In a flash, the plasmic beam of golden line smashed onto his body and passed through him before it disappeared into the distance.
|You have been recognized by the Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree.|
|Your existence has gained the quality of the Primaltree Treasure Compass that will naturally be led to other Primaltree Tresors and other Existential Katholikons within the Expanse.|
In the depths of his existence, the markings of a golden tree appeared and buzzed with activity as Noah made a tremendous gain by doing something seemingly mundane!
At the same time the marking of the Primaltree Treasure Compass was forged within him...
|The weavings of Loot, Protagonist, and Quintessence within your Conceptual System of Existence have made a significant advancement.|
|The Value of your Conceptual System of Existence has increased by +50,000!|
Something even deeper within him responded as his existence cheered.
At this time...
|Haha, you picked them clean, my Friend. Come, let me show you how to best enjoy these.|

The figure of Bob appeared beside Noah after the disappearance of the Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree, grasping one of the many golden dew drops swirling around Noah as his hand pulled on a golden string near them, and...
WAP!
They disappeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 3264 Dictum! Decree! Ordinance! II
paragraphs: Those with power could do things that those without power would look at with awe and shock.
The things Bob was doing were worthy of awe, but Noah only watched them with analytical eyes as within the span of an instant, he found that their surroundings had changed once again.

They appeared in a space where the strings of golden lines surrounded a massive distorted space that held no strings, all of them pushed to form an encirclement of golden strings around this space that actually shone with white radiance.
Akin to a white singularity amidst all the grandeur of gold.

|Come, in this space, we should have no disruptions as we enjoy the Hearthraes with ease. For obtaining all of them, is there anything a new entrant like you is curious to know? I am very knowledgeable, you know!|
Bob hit his chest with confidence as his circular head with the twinkling singularities and devilishly wide smile only became more regal and yet menacing.
Noah floated into this space with Hearthraes swirling around him as he wanted to see how far he could take it with this unknown entity, and just what more he could gain from him.
|What do you know about States of Existence, Bob?|
The thing that Savitar mentioned only truly powerful Protectors having.

Hearing his question, Bob blinked while staring at Noah quizzically, his face flashing with golden brilliance as it instantly flashed with an unfathomable Eye that seemed to observe everything before it disappeared.
He then looked towards Noah as if he was observing a rare animal and shook his head with surprise.
|You really don't know because you actually haven't attained any State of Existence yet...haha, how did you even get here?|

The question from Bob was an important one as he sat down at the center of this white space, tapping his finger out to cause a crystal golden table to appear where all the Hearthraes around Noah floated towards.
His voice then echoed out.

|There are multiple States of Existence that one comes across as their Existence becomes more complex and builds greater Records. At some point, one will come to attain the state of One With Existence.|

At this point, Bob took his limb out and stretched it as in the next moment, it melded in the surrounding space until the entire limb could no longer be seen, as if it entirely assimilated and became one with the surrounding space!

|This is a rudimentary state of existence, the first threshold to cross if one is to eventually transcend their Existence and arrive here. And you, my friend, have yet to even attain this state of existence, but here you are.|
Silence.
Bob stared towards Noah while blinking with bright white brilliance, his voice continuing to echo out.

|After the State of One With Existence, an increasingly complex entity is capable of attaining the state of the Eye of Existence if their very Source of Existence is strong and complex enough. In that state, the number of information about the weavings of Existence at your fingertips is unfathomable. You begin looking at Existence in an entirely different way. This step is what allows you to find the eventual doorway of Transcendence to arrive here.|

|Over the countless cycles, many have reached the apex of this State of Existence and been lucky enough to arrive in the Expanse. But, there is one more State of Existence that some truly terrifying Entities attain before they step foot in the Expanse.|

One With Existence! Eyes of Existence! Preset pathways that all others had to follow, and yet Noah had made a major jump and attained his entry into the Higher Weavings of Existence without any of these. Without having attained any of these states at all.
How difficult was what he had done? How impossible was it? And after these two states, there was still one more.
They all dealt with increasing complexity and power of one's existence to reach an extremely high point before such states could be attained!

|For some, transcending their existence is immeasurably hard due to a great deal of complexity that others cannot even compare to. Such Entities go a step further into the Third State of Existence. Some call it the Decree of Existence. Others call it the Dictum of Existence, or the Ordinance of Existence depending on where they are from. But it is a state where one takes all the complexity of their existence and reduces it all to a single Decree. A single Dictum. A Single Ordinance! Such entities are unfathomably powerful. Should you meet them in this endless Expanse and evoke their ire, say your prayers and prepare for endless darkness, my friend.|
WAA!
Bob spoke with a smiling expression as he broke out into laughter while waving his hands.
|Don't worry though. Even if thousands of such entities appear before us right now, they won't be able to lay a hand on you with me here.|
The mystery surrounding Bob deepened as he uttered a heavy statement.
He talked of Entities so complex and unfathomable in power, and yet he stated that even if thousands of such entities appeared, they wouldn't be able to lay a hand on him.
He crossed his hands and stroked his chin as if he were pondering at this moment, his intent echoing out.

|Entities whose Existence becomes unfathomably complex are very hard to kill. Within the Expanse, and even out there in the Megalos Nihilos, Megalos Beyond, and Megalos Ynnere- you will come across Resurgent Existences. Entities who were once unfathomably powerful but faced destruction...and yet they didn't completely perish. The complexity of their existence and the records they left behind...they find a way to be reborn into another lifeform within their preset bounds of Existence. Those are some truly scary buggers- the ones who have died again and again and keep coming back. I can't tell you the number of times I've had to kill the same entity over multiple cycles...ah!|

|But hey, forget all that. These Hearthraes before us are where existence is really at. The taste! Oh, depending on your foundation and how young you are, they should even help you go towards the first State of Existence.|

The things Bob was doing were worthy of awe, but Noah only watched them with analytical eyes as within the span of an instant, he found that their surroundings had changed once again.

They appeared in a space where the strings of golden lines surrounded a massive distorted space that held no strings, all of them pushed to form an encirclement of golden strings around this space that actually shone with white radiance.
Akin to a white singularity amidst all the grandeur of gold.
|Come, in this space, we should have no disruptions as we enjoy the Hearthraes with ease.
For obtaining all of them, is there anything a new entrant like you is curious to know?
I am very knowledgeable, you know!|
Bob hit his chest with confidence as his circular head with the twinkling singularities and devilishly wide smile only became more regal and yet menacing.
Noah floated into this space with Hearthraes swirling around him as he wanted to see how far he could take it with this unknown entity, and just what more he could gain from him.
|What do you know about States of Existence, Bob?|
The thing that Savitar mentioned only truly powerful Protectors having.

Hearing his question, Bob blinked while staring at Noah quizzically, his face flashing with golden brilliance as it instantly flashed with an unfathomable Eye that seemed to observe everything before it disappeared.
He then looked towards Noah as if he was observing a rare animal and shook his head with surprise.
|You really don't know because you actually haven't attained any State of Existence yet...haha, how did you even get here?|

The question from Bob was an important one as he sat down at the center of this white space, tapping his finger out to cause a crystal golden table to appear where all the Hearthraes around Noah floated towards.
His voice then echoed out.
|There are multiple States of Existence that one comes across as their Existence becomes more complex and builds greater Records.
At some point, one will come to attain the state of One With Existence.|

At this point, Bob took his limb out and stretched it as in the next moment, it melded in the surrounding space until the entire limb could no longer be seen, as if it entirely assimilated and became one with the surrounding space!
|This is a rudimentary state of existence, the first threshold to cross if one is to eventually transcend their Existence and arrive here.
And you, my friend, have yet to even attain this state of existence, but here you are.|
Silence.
Bob stared towards Noah while blinking with bright white brilliance, his voice continuing to echo out.

You begin looking at Existence in an entirely different way.
This step is what allows you to find the eventual doorway of Transcendence to arrive here.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3265 Advancement! I
paragraphs: Bob grasped a golden dew drop while stating such words.

The Hearthraes may even be capable of aiding one towards the austere States of Existence Noah brought a golden dew drop in front of his eyes as he digested the powerful waves of information that Bob had just released.
The complexity of Existence.
The mention of Megalos Beyond that belonged to Dark Matter, Megalos Ynnere to Matter, and Megalos Nihilos to Anti-Matter!
The complexity of existence that allowed Entities to grow unfathomably powerful even if they hadn't transcended their existence.
In the midst of all of this, Noah felt like he stood at an incomparably small viewpoint, with his existence having managed to enter a wide field of play very early!
He had been growing within the Megalos Ynnere this whole time, and he had only just stepped into the vast stretches of the Megalos Beyond.
As for Megalos Nihilos that should be the source of the Worms of Existence? He hadn't even seen anything of it!
He felt like there was much to be done as he threw the Hearthrae that was buzzing with excitement into his mouth.
And...
BOOOM!
An explosion of brilliance erupted within him.
The moment it entered his mouth, the Hearthrae dissolved into threads of incandescent radiance that acted like catalytic enzymes.
Like catalysts that urged and initiated waves of reactions in his existence, with him feeling his breadth and all possible scopes of parameters of his existence beginning to buzz!
At the same time, it felt like the threads of golden lines were searching for something within his existence.
They sought for age of his existence.
They sought to understand his foundation.
The complexity and records of his existence comparative to his age and potential!
His age was unrealistically young for his current achievements.
His Foundation was incomparable compared to others!
The complexity of his records compared to his age and potential? All of these were unfathomable to even quantify.
But the Hearthrae sought for all of these details as the moment it held a certain degree of confidence...
BOOOM!
Such radiant golden light exploded out with such a disgusting level of concentration that his body turned to almost become translucent glass.
Above him, the illusion of a golden tree that was extremely similar to the Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree appeared.
Its countless branches twirled and released strings of golden light that swung down and converged towards Noah's visage.
Under him, another appalling concentration of Existence formed as the illusion of a massive mountain formed.
A purple mountain that anchored itself on the countless golden strings down below- their golden brilliance flowing into it as on the peak of this mountain- endless purple clouds gathered!

After a potent amount of such clouds formed, the mountain erupted with purple brilliance that surged like a billowing sea towards Noah's figure- all of it gushing into his translucent figure that was akin to a black hole that took in everything.
Countless strings of golden light above, endless clouds of purple light below.
Bob looked at this scene as he nodded with appreciation, bringing a Hearthrae into his mouth as he chewed on it as if he were chewing on a grape.
His body only flashed with a slight golden radiance as no commotion happened around him.
|The Manifestation of the Primordial Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree and the Primordial Mountain of the Expanse during absorption...almost the highest possible result one could achieve. Almost...|
There were many factors that could influence just how fruitful the blessings of the Hearthraes plucked from a Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree were!
But if one exceeded the norms of these factors, they could bring about manifestations that would make their absorption equal something others couldn't even understand.
Bob devouring the single Hearthrae right now, for example, could have given him a benefit of +1 due to his age and other factors.
But the single Hearthrae that Noah devoured could be giving him a hypothetical beneficial value of +1,000,000!
That was how wide the discrepancy could be when taking into account the complexity of one's existence compared to their age, among other factors.
At this moment, in his translucent state, Noah reached out to grasp another Hearthrae that was thrown into his mouth right away.
Above him, the Primordial Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree became more brilliant, and below him, the Primordial Mountain of the Expanse became ever more luminous.
His Existence itself was suffused with effulgent waves of purity as ever so unconsciously, his translucent figure began to meld with his surrounding existence!
It was the first step.
He was already going towards one of the States of Existence due to how horrific the effects of the augmentations to his existence were.
|You've taken the first step...and there are many more to come.|
In front of him, Bob continued to chuck more and more Hearthraes into his own mouth as he truly did enjoy their taste.
This delicacy was something he couldn't easily get due to the complexity of his existence, as it should not even be viable for him to attain it here!
It wasn't for him, or those like him.
So he smiled while he enjoyed the taste, his intent continuing to flow out regardless of whether Noah could hear him or not at this time.

|The Expanse is a dangerous place, and also one filled with opportunities. It will be rare for you to meet those weaker than you here, so your Existence will be tested. You are far from declaring the Ordinance of your Existence, but I can already sense the regality, dignity, and tyranny within that will make others your enemies rather quickly unless you bend your head...will you bend your head though?|
He seemed to be musing to himself.
He also seemed to be talking to Noah, and yet Noah's existence was currently wrapped up in such brilliance that it didn't even seem like he was capable of focusing on anything else.

|Over the cycles, countless entities across the Megalos Beyond, Megalos Ynnere, and Megalos Nihilos have arrived here. Over the past eons, they have sensed things. They know that something is coming as they have begun gathering themselves together. Strength in numbers, so they think. But even numbers will not hold a candle for what is coming, only your own existence. So...do all you can to be ready.|
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 3266 Advancement! II
paragraphs: After he stated these words, Bob seemed to have come out of a reverie as he realized over half of the Hearthraes between him and Noah were missing, his hands having been fast to eat them all as he coughed at this moment while pulling his hand away.
He had taken just a little bit too much for the sheer taste.
|Alright, that will be all from me. This space here can act as a refuge for you if you need it. Good luck, Little One. You're the Ninth one I've come across...and likely the last.|
His circular head shone as he began to hum and rise up, floating upwards.
Unnaturally, his head twisted as he looked above while voicing out calmly.
|You like peeking at others, don't you? Why just hide over there and watch in silence.|
He left the blank white space he brought Noah in, the space he stated that it could be a refuge for him if he needed it.
Far above, where countless golden lines flowed, existence fizzled in and out as a hazy figure stared toward Bob with caution and calmness.
|Sir...we are not supposed to intervene.|
The words from this hazy space were respectful and yet reproachful at the same time.
Bob heard them while waving his hands dismissively.
|What intervention? I just met someone by chance, and his weavings followed me around for a bit. Are you trying to make trouble for me?|
His mouth, which was always smiling, turned cold as his eyes flashed.
Above, the hazy existence instantly began to tremble while shaking their head.
|I wouldn't dare to, sir.|
|Mmm, then let's go.|
Without looking back, Bob flashed away and disappeared entirely.
Above, the hazy figure stared towards the translucent visage of Noah briefly, almost as if they were debating something, but after an instant, they also disappeared!
All that was left behind was a wide white space surrounded by endless golden strings around it.
Inside of it, a translucent figure encompassed by waves of radiance could be seen- an illusory Primordial Hearthraes Lotus Primaltree above him and a Primordial Mountain of the Expanse below him!
In a Half Tainted Omniverse.
Command Protector Valeria had been looking towards Noah with caution after his last words that brought about great shock.
He stated that he could break off the connection between her Sister and the Outerversal Morphon who had bound her!
She wanted to question such a statement, but in the next moment...
HUUM!
His figure began to radiate a shocking amount of golden and purple radiance.
|...Why are you glowing?|
She asked such words while squinting her eyes, but the man before her waved his hands dismissively while gazing behind him.
Past the scorched space.
Towards the tendrils of Outerversal Authority converging into a massive central singularity- the Dark Matter Core!

He could also sense that far in the distance, the figures of Protector Lucretia and the other three Royal Existential Omniversal Simian Protectors were wrapping up the Delegatus of Savitar who had lost their master here- the Existence Reapers who were scrambling out while crying like children- many of them escaping towards the shattering waves of Outerversal Authority in the distance.
Among the connections Noah had sent towards Ozymandias, many also included these Existence Reapers among others as Ozymandias would have to grasp them all and identify them!

And alongside all of this, ridiculous changes that he was trying to keep up were initiated by one of his bodies that was within the Higher Weavings of Existence, their boons stretching towards his Atlas of Existence and everything else that made him.
All of it happened at once.
But even now, he had to move quickly to get something else he wanted!

He began to drift towards the space with scorching obsidian radiance where one of Savitar's bodies had perished- going towards the tendrils of the distant Dark Matter Core as he voiced out towards the Command Protector Valeria.

"I'll help with your sister, and all I ask in return is to be the one that destroys the Dark Matter Core. I can gain something from it that will even help with cutting off the link from your Sister to the Outerversal Morphon she is connected to."
Lies were mixed with truth as Command Protector Valeria gazed towards him with hesitation.
Why did she continue to ask for missions of hunting down Morphons? Why did she feel such hatred for them?
It was all for the sake of saving her sister from their grasp.
If this entity could truly be true to his words...
Her gaze shifted multiple times over as she felt the auras of the three Royal Existential Omniversal Simian Protectors turn towards this direction along with Lucretia.
Between them and Noah's figure that was going towards the Dark Matter Core, her body flashed as she turned into a streak of light that went to intercept the rest of the Equestris Protectors!

Within moments, she crossed the heavy folds of Outerversal Authority and appeared in the space where Existence Reapers were running rampant just moments ago, seeing the figures of Protectors clearing any remaining ones away while coming forward as they stopped and smiled with happiness when they saw Command Protector Valeria.
|Haha, Commander, Savitar has perished? I thought we would have to come aid you after we cleared his Peons!|
Protector Acteon radiated his intent wantonly as they gazed towards the distant interminable storms of Outerversal Authority.
Lucretia also drew near her sister while controlling her buzzing existence, her eyes cautiously staring towards the direction where Noah had also surged towards.
|And Protector Osmont?|
A question she threw towards her sister.
One that Command Protector Valeria nodded calmly to as she began to summon crimson and blue Wheels to wipe off any remaining Existence Reapers.
|He is observing the complete destruction of the Dark Matter Core. Come on- let us rid this broken Omniverse of these Agents of Anti-Life entirely!|
Her valiant Command echoed out as the others...only nodded and followed.
In the distance, Noah was coming upon a buzzing Dark Matter Core!

chapters.title: Chapter 3267 Advancement! III
paragraphs: A Dark Matter Core.

Something formed after an Outerversal Morphon descended onto an Omniverse- drawing all weavings of existence stretched across it towards a single singularity that transformed everything into weavings of Dark Matter.
The Quintillions upon quintillions of lifeforms stretched out across all the Existential Domains containing countless Planes of Existence, Cosmos, Universes, and trillions of worlds.
All were burned and acted as the fuel to further the Dark Matter Core, with Existence Reaper rising from the wanton fusion of the strongest Existences within the Omniverse!
It was a heavy and cataclysmic ordeal that decimated a great deal of life, and Noah came upon this vibrant Core at this moment as he sighed.
Its formation was cruel and brutal, but since it was already here...
|Are you ready for an infusion of even more Dark Matter?|
Noah sent his thoughts out to the Infinite Omniverse that was continuing the process of rearrangement and transformation based on his Source of Existence of Ingeniare.
|Yes, Master.|
The voice of the Infinite Omniverse was firm as on Noah's fingertips...Psioneutrino Particles began to gather.

They acted akin to particles holding a heavy gravitational pull towards the weavings of Dark Matter ahead of them- tendrils of obsidian radiance beginning to flow towards Noah as in response, a film of incandescent obsidian radiance began to erupt from his hand and fold over the Dark Matter Core that was light years wide ahead of him.

He barely seemed like a speck of dust before it, and yet his power was so deep and heavy that the released black film of radiance wrapped around the light years wide Dark Matter Core in an instant, and then...the weavings of Existence themselves began to distort.
His connection with the Infinite Omniverse was put in focus.
His new weavings of existence made up of Quarks, Leptons, and Psioneutrinos were put in focus!
And then, a tug occurred.
A tug.
But with this mere tug...
WAP!
The Dark Matter Core disappeared.
KAA!
The remnants of anything to do with the Half Tainted Omniverse cried out a devastating bellow.
Noah closed his eyes.
He felt the profound changes his Existence was undergoing at this very moment as it allowed him to be in tune with his surrounding weavings of Existence very, very closely.
The effects of the Hearthraes on him were appallingly great as the values for every single one of his Systems of Existence were shooting up rapidly.
And he felt ever closer towards all surrounding weavings of existence.
As if he could feel a wind passing through everything, and this wind tickled his very skin.
So he could feel it all.
The weavings of existence of quintillions that had perished within this Omniverse.
He felt their minute threads of pain and seconds before they were either eradicated or turned into something else. He felt the shattered Domains of Existence that seemed to be crying in desolation.
|The Complexity of your Existence is rapidly and Quintessentially increasing.|
A prompt flashed in his mind, but he didn't pay attention to it.
He simply felt!
In the grand scheme of things, it could be easy for his mind to be numbed to the idea of the deaths of quintillions upon quintillions of beings.
But it did occur.
An Outerversal Morphon did cause it.
Of course, in their perspective, all of these lives meant nothing and were inconsequential to their grand plans!

But there were families here with dreams. Parents who sought to protect their children. Children who wanted to emulate their parents. Kings and Emperors who wanted to protect their people and enact dynasties lasting for millions of years.
In all of them- as he felt the bursts of the end of their weavings of existence, Noah saw himself.
His biggest fear was to be the father of a family in an Omniverse like this- where they now lay dead without even truly knowing what had killed them.
Only weavings of hatred and regret left behind.
He felt it all very closely.
And he made a promise to all these weavings of pain and decimation that he never wanted to experience himself.
'I will lay waste to the one who caused all this destruction'
The One Who Walks, Savitar! At this moment, the Omniversal Archontes Engineer swore that he would erase the weavings of this existence!
HUUM!
His body buzzed as it began to meld with the surrounding weavings of existence.
Behind him, he felt the auras of Command Protector Valeria and the rest of the Equestris Protectors near, their gazes falling on him as their eyes opened wide.

They saw as in the next moment, his body began to disperse as if it held the same properties as the surrounding weavings of existence- everything about him glowing incandescently before it disappeared into the surroundings!
This was different from his disappearance before on the Omniversal Voyager.
They had seen him meld with the surrounding existence.
This...
This was...!
|One With Existence!|
Protector Lucretia screamed out in shock.
The others watched on in a daze as Command Protector Valeria's gaze became unfathomably stern.
A place she was close to, but had not yet reached.

This being, who wasn't even an Omniversal Entity, was grasping it at this moment as...just who was he? Seeing the absence of the Dark Matter Core also, Command Protector Valeria wondered- didn't this have anything to do with him grasping a new state of existence?
There were too many questions and very few answers.
After all of this, she had to sit down with him and get some answers!
Far from the Half Tainted Omniverse that was breaking apart.
Across the Megalos Ynnere and its endless Omniverses.
Within Omniverse X-999, there was a miniature Omniverse inside of it that at this moment...began to approach the same level of breadth and complexity as Omniverse X-999 itself.

Within it, a massive infinity-shaped Extremity Vein coursed with heavy and concentrated waves of Existence, and surrounding this Vein, rings of colorful, flat Aletheian Havens wrapped around it gloriously! ter.

chapters.title: Chapter 3268 Advancement! IV
paragraphs: Inside this wondrous Omniverse, there was already a steady stream of stellar obsidian radiance that was flowing in from its very depths.
From a connection to a distant entity in the Megalos Beyond!
And yet at this moment...
BOOM!
A clap of thunderous sound boomed out as below the circling Aletheian Havens, an extremely dense obsidian core arrived.
A Dark Matter Core!
The moment it arrived, it trembled in an unstable manner as if it sought to cause the very disruption of existence.
But...
WU!
From the massive Extremity Vein, a heavy pressure boomed down that utterly stopped any sense of instability in a domineering manner.

From the Extremity Vein, colorless, blue, and purple radiance descended as the very concentrated weavings of Quintessence, Manadynamics, and Tyranny gushed down massive tendrils of their brilliance that wrapped around this Dark Matter Core!
These tendrils of light...almost seemed like tentacles.
Almost like the features of the inhabitants of the Megalos Beyond!

But they domineeringly wrapped around the Dark Matter Core and stopped any sense of instability, these tendrils of Existential Extremity Authorities clenching as they shockingly split apart the circular blazing core in three, extremely pure Outerversal Authority leaking out that was then sucked into these tendrils and towards the pulsing Extremity Vein.
THUMP!
THUMP!
The Core, as if it were a beating heart, was slowly but surely drained.
And when one looked at the glorious space of the Infinite Omniverse, one would come to notice that some of its weavings were painted with a stellar obsidian hue.
A hue only present in the Megalos Beyond.
It was a subtle change, but it was only the beginning.
What will happen in the future?
When Ozymandias continued to allow weavings of the Megalos Beyond to flow into the Infinite Omniverse?
Would this Infinite Omniverse still belong with the designation of something from the Megalos Ynnere, or of the Megalos Beyond?
Or something else entirely?
This question couldn't be entirely answered at this moment.
But within the depths of the Infinite Omniverse, there was the Manifestation of this construct itself.

Her multicolored visage made up of many different authorities formed the definitive shape of a feminine entity, and yet right now, from her legs where countless lines of authorities extended towards the dazzling throne Noah sat on....vibrant, incandescent, radiant obsidian tentacles began to grow!
The change was not missed by the Infinite Omniverse, her Manifestation staring towards the Master on the throne who currently looked far above.
Towards the connection leading to the Megalos Beyond.
There, Ozymandias was about to step onto a grand field of play.
The Megalos Beyond!
A space of endless obsidian radiance, its ends never before observed even after cycles upon cycles passing.

A new entrant had made his mark in a short period of time as since his entry, he had stepped into the Grave of the Great Beyonder that was then shuttled across the Megalos Beyond towards a certain Pantheon- with those around him believing a single thing!
The appearance of the Sign.
The Instrument that the Great Beyonder spoke of!
The Instrument that would either allow for the destruction of the Megalos Beyond or its endless flourishing.
It was a daring statement as who could believe such a thing?
How could a single being be capable of causing such a huge effect on the Megalos Beyond that had existed for an unknown scale of time?
If only the words could be taken with such skepticism.
But the issue was that they stemmed from the Great Beyonder.
And this Entity...held far, far too much history and trust across the Megalos Beyond.
BOOM!
Obsidian space split apart and formed into a huge rift as from it, a domain encased by a crimson barrier came to fruition.
It was none other than a certain Grave of the Great Beyonder as when it arrived, it brought changes with it.

The connection from a certain Ozymandias to something far greater than a single entity still prompted certain changes, with a flourishing of the very weavings of the nearby Megalos Beyond occurring as in response, there was rain.
Stellar, dark drops of rain that when they flew across the pristine space, an increase in the concentration of Dark Matter would occur.
And the place where the Grave of the Great Beyonder appeared was not a barren one.
Not too far in the distance was a Pantheon that was their target all around.
The Megalos Pantheon of Umbra!
It was like a deep crimson black landmass that was ten times the size of any common Omniverse, its weavings lively as this Pantheon had stood strong for many cycles.
Equivalent to trillions of years.
Its foundation was deep and unfathomable, and the countless Outerversal Morphon residing within it were even more so.
At this moment, the reason for the appearance of Rain, which had never before appeared in the Megalos Beyond...underwent even more changes.
In addition to the connection to an Infinite Omniverse, there were a few other things occurring simultaneously.
A part of himself in the Higher Weavings of Existence was consuming Hearthraes that were causing massive and appalling changes.
Changes that, among many other things, initiated the induction into a State of Existence that only truly complex existences could arrive at.
One With Existence.
At this moment, Ozymandias felt interminably comfortable as his existence felt like it was being cradled by the Megalos Beyond itself.
He felt like his body was melding with the surrounding Megalos Beyond itself!
This...only caused the already ongoing reaction to become even wilder.
The rain became heavier.
More widespread.

The Grave of Great Beyonder pulled towards the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra as at this moment, it came with it...an ever increasing storm of rain that increased the breadth of existence of the Megalos Beyond itself!

The Grave was akin to a grain of sand compared to the Pantheon itself, and yet from around it, the drops of rain forming were too numerous as they converged into a rainfall! Instantly, millions of wills that were peacefully moving about in the nearby sections of the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra began to be aroused...

chapters.title: Chapter 3269 He Has Come! I
paragraphs: Within the space that pulsed like an organ where Ozymandias and Little Aspasia had remained connected for some time.
Their connection had not been broken as Noah was in a meditative seated position, the weavings of his existence hazy as they seemed to meld in and out of his surroundings.
Whatever reaction he was causing allowed for the concentration of the Megalos Beyond itself to be richer, and the drops of rain forming from his actions only increased in quantity!
Aspasia looked at this scene with sharp eyes as she came to a firm decision.
Following the Will of the Great Mother, she moved!
They were just now arriving at the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra, an extensive domain stretching out for countless light years as even the omniverses of the Megalos Ynnere could not compare.
Inside of this Grave of the Great Beyonder, they were akin to being in a vessel arriving at this place.

And since this vessel held the entity exhibiting all these Signs- and the one that the Great Mother had definitively come to the conclusion that he was the Instrument too...he had to state his welcome.
And so, Aspasia moved to make this welcome.
Her obsidian visage pulsed, her hand coming to smash into her chest as behind her- a secondary visage that looked just like her flashed before it disappeared.
Outside of the Grave of the Great Beyonder floating into the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra.
HUUM!
Outerversal Authority gathered brilliantly to form the visage of a stellar illusory Aspasia.

It was massive in size, coming out to be even slightly larger than the Grave of the Great Beyonder itself as this figure of Aspasia raised her hands up while the obsidian drops of rain passed through her!
|The Sign that the Great Beyonder had promised! The Instrument that shall offer salvation to the Megalos Beyond...has arrived!|
Her voice boomed out as far as it could reach.
It was showmanship.
She wanted to be seen.
She wanted to be heard.
But truly, how could she not be heard when she quite literally came with Rain?
Something that never, ever appeared in the Megalos Beyond as there were no worlds or conditions to make such a thing possible here.

There were only an unknown number of Megalos Pantheons where many powerful Outerversal Morphons converged, and smaller domains floating in the endless stretches of the Megalos Beyond like the Graves of the Great Beyonder.
The moment Aspasia uttered her words, the wills that had begun to gaze at the shocking phenomenon above a small part of the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra shook.
The Sign? The Instrument?
Many had to dig up from their memories and records as soon, everything clicked.
The words of the Great Beyonder flashed and buzzed in their minds as they looked at the drops of rain falling from a distance.
|Rain shall cover the Megalos Beyond as it will cheer at the arrival of the instrument...|
|Rain shall cover the Megalos Beyond as it will weep at the arrival of the instrument...|
Depending on who the Outerverversal was, different words buzzed in their minds.
But in a united front, a single sentence of the many that the Great Beyonder had uttered flowed out thereafter.
|Great Ones will fall like the drops of rain...|
Rain.
Rain!!!

Some of these drops of rain began to land in insignificantly small portions of the vast Megalos Pantheon of Umbra, and when they hit the black earth of the endless rolling mountains...radiance flourished.
The concentration of Existence itself within the Megalos Beyond flourished!
From the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra, nearly a tenth of it was aroused by Aspasia's words and news traversed quickly.
The Grave of the Great Beyonder they were on was infinitely small compared to the Pantheon, yes, but...how could they not attract attention with such a phenomenon?
Very soon, a few hundred Outerversal Morphons of great size and variation began to gather towards their location.
Since it was within the bounds of the Pantheon, no combat or killing was allowed as decreed by the Great Beyonder- so there was absolute safety in these havens that were Pantheons.
|Is it...is it truly them? The instrument of salvation?|
An intent flowed out from one of the Outerversal Morphons to gather.
It was an entity with the shape of a flower, with thousands of tendrils making its stem.
A terrific aura buzzed from it as hearing the words acted like a trigger for Aspasia- her massive illusory figure waving her hands and causing a certain scene to appear.
It was the scene of Ozymandias within the Grave of the Great Beyonder, his figure brilliantly melding in and out of his surroundings!
|He was born moments ago, and the First Sign of countless connections formed in an instant was observed!|
WAA!
|Now, he ushers rain for the first time in the Megalos Beyond as at the same time...|
They could see his figure melding in and out of existence.
They understood what this meant.
He was just born, and yet he was already...
|One With Megalos!|
One With Megalos.
For those in the Megalos Beyond, this was Existence.
At this moment, they saw that this newly born Morphon who brought the rain was somehow already becoming one with existence!
A State of Existence that Outerversal Morphons who had grown increasingly complex could attain over time.
This was undoubtedly the one that the Great Beyonder spoke of.
Seeing the shock and reverence before her, Little Aspasia nodded as she cemented everything.
|The Instrument has come...to call upon those who trust in the words of the Great Beyonder! The Instrument has come...for the Crucible of the Beyonder within this Pantheon!|
Her words were resonant.

The attention they caught was stupendous as in moments, thousands upon thousands of Outerversal Morphons began to surround the Grave of the Great Beyonder coming into the Pantheon protectively, their eyes and intents expressing fervor!
A distance away, there were thousands of Morphons who stayed back- their eyes showing a cold light.
They also believed in the words of the Great Beyonder.
And in them, he also stated that this Instrument could be the one to bring destruction!
Their Existence wholly denied this as they did not wish to see his coming, nor his success.
Gradually, two groups began to form as the Grave of the Great Beyonder descended onto the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra!

But in a united front, a single sentence of the many that the Great Beyonder had uttered flowed out thereafter.
|Great Ones will fall like the drops of rain...|
Rain.
Rain!!!

Some of these drops of rain began to land in insignificantly small portions of the vast Megalos Pantheon of Umbra, and when they hit the black earth of the endless rolling mountains...radiance flourished.
The concentration of Existence itself within the Megalos Beyond flourished!
From the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra, nearly a tenth of it was aroused by Aspasia's words and news traversed quickly.
The Grave of the Great Beyonder they were on was infinitely small compared to the Pantheon, yes, but...how could they not attract attention with such a phenomenon?
Very soon, a few hundred Outerversal Morphons of great size and variation began to gather towards their location.
Since it was within the bounds of the Pantheon, no combat or killing was allowed as decreed by the Great Beyonder- so there was absolute safety in these havens that were Pantheons.
|Is it...is it truly them?
The instrument of salvation?|
An intent flowed out from one of the Outerversal Morphons to gather.
It was an entity with the shape of a flower, with thousands of tendrils making its stem.
A terrific aura buzzed from it as hearing the words acted like a trigger for Aspasia- her massive illusory figure waving her hands and causing a certain scene to appear.
It was the scene of Ozymandias within the Grave of the Great Beyonder, his figure brilliantly melding in and out of his surroundings!
|He was born moments ago, and the First Sign of countless connections formed in an instant was observed!|
WAA!
|Now, he ushers rain for the first time in the Megalos Beyond as at the same time...|
They could see his figure melding in and out of existence.
They understood what this meant.
He was just born, and yet he was already...
|One With Megalos!|
One With Megalos.
For those in the Megalos Beyond, this was Existence.
At this moment, they saw that this newly born Morphon who brought the rain was somehow already becoming one with existence!
A State of Existence that Outerversal Morphons who had grown increasingly complex could attain over time.
This was undoubtedly the one that the Great Beyonder spoke of.
Seeing the shock and reverence before her, Little Aspasia nodded as she cemented everything.
|The Instrument has come...to call upon those who trust in the words of the Great Beyonder!
The Instrument has come...for the Crucible of the Beyonder within this Pantheon!|
Her words were resonant.

The attention they caught was stupendous as in moments, thousands upon thousands of Outerversal Morphons began to surround the Grave of the Great Beyonder coming into the Pantheon protectively, their eyes and intents expressing fervor!
A distance away, there were thousands of Morphons who stayed back- their eyes showing a cold light.
They also believed in the words of the Great Beyonder.
And in them, he also stated that this Instrument could be the one to bring destruction!
Their Existence wholly denied this as they did not wish to see his coming, nor his success.
Gradually, two groups began to form as the Grave of the Great Beyonder descended onto the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra!

chapters.title: Chapter 3270 He Has Come! II
paragraphs: The Sign!
The Instrument!
He came and brought down rain!
Like fire, such news spread across the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra.
Within its depths, countless intricate structures weaved together as at this moment, truly powerful beings began to move.
Within moments, a billowing aura that caused others to shudder bloomed in front of the thousands of groups of Morphons.
It was an entity that seemed like an amalgamation of tentacles that formed a massive ring.
Trillions of tentacles overlapping together to form a circular ringed lifeform!
Such a being held heavy prestige as the moment he appeared, hushed whispers echoed out.
|A Great One...|
|The Great Wheel...!|
An Outerversal Morphon alongside the same prestige as the Observer of Old and Young and other Great Outerversal Morphons.
His tentacles pulsed as he spoke out while feeling the drops of rain and the illusory image of Ozymandias.
|Let the Instrument present itself...If it is so, I will personally lead them to the Crucible!|
WAA!
A Great One had spoken!
Little Aspasia felt his power and nodded, her weavings traveling back towards Ozymandias as among those Outerversal Morphons she knew, The Great Wheel was one of the compatriots of the Great Mother.
An ally.
Within the Grave of the Great Beyonder.
Ozymandias received waves of intent as his eyes fluttered, countless flashes of information crossing within them as there were simply too many things he was doing at once.

Millions of lines of connections from Savitar were added to him all at once, this phenomenon only causing his interaction with the Megalos Beyond to get even more pronounced on top of the changes brought by the link to his Infinite Omniverse.
This was the direct cause of the increased Rain- alongside his own existence elevating of course.
'One With Existence...'

He felt the beginnings of this imperceptible state where his existence was telling him he could just disappear into his surroundings if he wished, the sensation being utterly wild as he wondered just how high his values had risen after all of this.
His extremely powerful Existence came up with the answer in a mere instant.
[Megalos Regnum Echelon 3 (53,799/100,000)]---[Megalos Willpower I]---[Megalos Dignity]
[Outerversal Physiology Echelon 3 (88,219/100,000)]---[Outerversal Organs I]---[Dark Matter Core]
He was only just born as an Outerversal Morphon, but his speed was astounding to a large degree.
He felt the subtle changes within himself as he focused on the new additions due to jumps from the Second to the Third Echelons.
The Dark Matter Core was akin to an extremely small singularity inside of him that told him he was now capable of a single thing.

The capability of influencing a body of existence outside of the Megalos Beyond, and if successful, it would form a similar Core from that Body of Existence that could be utilized to further propagate his power!
The capability that Savitar and many others were utilizing across the Megalos Ynnere.
With it, Ozymandias could theoretically do the same thing onto the bodies of existence within the Megalos Ynnere.
It was an ability worthy of looking at closely.

His feature of Outerversal Organs was further elevated as his brain radiated waves of pure Outerversal Authority, his heart pumping even more as it felt like a body was being given multiple engines to allow it to run with even grander waves of power.
It was only the features of the other Aspect of Power of an Outerversal Morphon that Ozymandias had to spend a little more time adjusting to in order to fully grasp its possibilities.
The Aspect of Megalos Regnum that had also jumped to the third Echelon.
Megalos Willpower, and Megalos Dignity.

For the Willpower, Ozymandias felt like he could spread his will out as this alone could be used to exert his power, and his Dignity...held an unquantifiable augmentation with how he interacted with the Megalos Beyond and other Outerversal Morphons entirely.
For these, he needed more time to understand.
WAP!
His eyes fully opened as his figure, which was melding with existence, rose up.

His stellar skin was tinged with deeper and deeper hues of obsidian radiance, the Halos of eldritch might born from tentacles rotating while gushing out streams of Outerversal Authority over his body.
His face was exquisite as it only held the pair of blinding white singularities for eyes, an aurora of obsidian wings pulsing with eldritch tentacles glimmering behind him as he looked out.
His gaze turned outside of the Grave of the Great Beyonder as he saw the thousands of Outerversal Morphons gathered, as well as the massive ring of tentacles that had just appeared before them.

With but a thought, his visage took a step and disappeared, his grandiose figure making his entrance while surrounded by Obsidian radiance as he appeared outside of the Grave and in the space of the vast stretches of the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra!
The never before rain became ever heavier around him.
Moments after, Aspasia's actual body also appeared beside him as flashes of Outerversal Morphons continued to appear thereafter behind them.
The gaze of Ozymandias remained on the one that Aspasia had sent weavings of to be the Great Wheel.
After his entry into the Higher Weavings of Existence and now with him pushing himself towards the state of One With Existence, what he was able to see was greatly expanded compared to before.
He knew that he could roughly...make an estimate of the quantification of powerful beings like the one before him with at least 70% accuracy!
And so, his existence buzzed as his eyes flashed, focused on the terrifying Great Wheel.
Immense pressure that almost caused one to keep their gaze down radiated from him, but Ozymandias got what he wanted.
[The Great Wheel]
[Megalos Regnum Echelon 7 (233,844,439/1,000,000,000)]---[Megalos Willpower V]---[Megalos Dignity IV]---[@&#^$^#]....
[Outerversal Physiology Echelon 8 (3,944,552,782/10,000,000,000)]---[Outerversal Organs VI]---[Dark Matter Core V]---[@$%$]...
A terrifying set of values was shown.
The Great Wheel!

chapters.title: Chapter 3271 The Crucible of the Beyonder! I
paragraphs: A Great One.
Such a being vibrated with a baleful intent of excitement at this moment as his booming voice echoed out.
|The Instrument has arrived at our Megalos Pantheon of Umbra...let us embrace him and lead him towards the Crucible of the Beyonder!|
WAA!
The words were resonant as they spread out all around.
In the surroundings, thousands of powerful Outerversal Morphons gathered under the banner of the Great Wheel as wondrously, their forms were similar to his.
Tentacles shining with radiant obsidian luster- some with wings or other features as undoubtedly, they mimicked the Great Wheel himself.
All of these were under the banner of the Great Wheel as within this Pantheon of Umbra, he was not just a Great One.
He was also one of the hegemons that controlled the weavings of this Pantheon.
An Outerversal Eldritch Emperor.
Those under his banner forcibly changed their bodies to look like him, but not all.
He had many followers.
And he himself was a follower of the Great Beyonder.
Such a being arrived to welcome the supposed Instrument mentioned eons ago!
Within the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra were many beings.
And it just so happened that in a corner of Umbra, the massive visage of a skeleton with thousands of limbs floated with pulses of anger above an obsidian stretch of land.
|The Sign? The Instrument? Such an obscene thing makes itself clear just when one of my bodies dies?|
The words of Savitar were silent, to himself, and filled with coldness as he was among those who never favored the coming of the Instrument.
Why place his livelihood on someone else just because of the words of the Great Beyonder?
Did he have to treat this being that had long since disappeared with such fanaticism as others?!
|Hmph.|
The visage of Outerversal Morphon Savitar disappeared, only to reappear on the top of an exceedingly tall mountain- the tallest one in this vast Pantheon.

Here, another Outerversal Eldritch Emperor held his base of operations- this tall mountain being covered by stellar obsidian mist as there were countless holes poked across it filled with unique crimson twisting structures and buildings.
Savitar passed through many intricate structures of this mountain, only to arrive at an area where the black earth was turned into obsidian waves of plasma.
In these waves of plasma, a figure was submerged- only a single purple eye being discerned of its massive stature.
Savitar appeared near this space as he voiced out.

|The so-called Instrument has arrived at your Pantheon, with your rival even personally taking him towards the Crucible of the Beyonder. Will you just sit still while this occurs? He is currently a weak little chick. Even after these Crucibles and even in this next cycle, he will still be weak enough for any Great One to kill.|
Savitar voiced out to the other Great One under the wide stretches of obsidian plasma.
Within, a sonorous voice emanated out.

|The Decree of no Morphon perishing within the sacred lands of any Pantheon is what keeps the order of our Megalos Beyond. I will not be one to break this order. As for the Crucible...who knows if he even survives it. If he does, he will need to leave this Pantheon to go to others to overcome their Crucibles too before his standing can be cemented. You are right in that he is currently weak. We can always make a move then, O One Who Walks.|
Towards the end, the words showed their annoyance and distaste as Savitar only harrumphed, staying here briefly before he disappeared.
Within the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra.

More and more Outerversal Morphons were aroused from obscurity as in the obsidian space painted by a stellar crimson hue, clouds of massive Morphons surrounded similarly formed Entities whose bodies looked like the ringed coalescence of countless tendrils.
The followers of the Great Wheel.
They passed over massive colosseum-like structures that rose up like towers and skyscrapers, with some areas being covered by leafless trees making up forests stretching for light years!
The Dark Forests of the Pantheon of Umbra.
Over 50% of this entire Pantheon, which was ten times larger than any common Omniverse, was covered by ancient leafless trees they now crossed over.
And as they did, drops of rain followed the Instrument as many Morphons watched on in awe!
Aspasia followed closely near the Instrument that followed the lead of the Great Wheel, his mere presence there causing the drops of rain to fall on the leafless trees as...
HUUM!
The obsidian trees brimmed with life thereafter, tiny, inconspicuous leaves beginning to rise!

All of this was privy to the eyes of the watching Morphons as whether they favored the Instrument or they were on the side of Heretical Morphons, they could not help but admit what they were seeing was the real deal!
They were crossing over all these lands to head towards the center of the Pantheon of Umbra.
Where the Crucible of the Beyonder lay- as this was another place to cement the standing of the Instrument!
It was said.
The Crucibles of the Beyonder would be the trials that would forge an Instrument to aid in the flourishing or destruction of the Megalos Beyond, or destroy this instrument entirely!
The Crucible of the Beyonder...

It was a terrifying region of space taking over a small portion of a few major Megalos Pantheons, with many Outerversal Morphons not even knowing how the Great Beyonder constructed them and made them the way they were.

Each Crucible was different, but the Great Beyonder had left behind words that stated anybody else who passed the trials of the Crucibles he laid out...were destined to be Morphons whose names would ring out across the Megalos Beyond and even outside of it!
And over the cycles, some had managed to pass any few portions of the Crucibles as they gained partial rewards.
Millions of Outerversal Morphons who were most astounding in the Megalos Beyond had their power attributed to those who partially cleared a Crucible, or multiple of them.
In history, the number of beings who fully cleared a Crucible numbered no more than 10!
Regardless of power, no more than 10!
