chapters.title: Chapter 3272 The Crucible of the Beyonder! II
paragraphs: This was because an Outerversal Morphon who was just born, or even a Great One could all challenge the Crucible.
Its challenge...was tailored to the challenger as the level of difficulty would change drastically depending on who was challenging it.
As for the rewards...they were the unfathomable Transcendent Megalos Abilities that made the Great Beyonder so powerful.
Those who managed to clear even a portion of the Crucibles would gain small sections of these Transcendent Megalos Abilities as even these alone were enough to make them renowned Morphons.

|The Crucible of the Beyonder in our Pantheon of Umbra is also known as the Crucible of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos- aptly named for the Transcendent Megalos Ability one can gain if they successfully clear the Crucible.|
The Amarantos Dream of the Megalos!
This was the Transcendent Megalos Ability one could inherit from clearing the same named crucible.

Led by a procession of terrifying Outerversal Morphons, Ozymandias and Aspasia followed behind the devout followers of the Great Mother and arrived in front of a massive crimson rift at the center of the Pantheon.
The Great Wheel's tendrils vibrated with power as his deep voice echoed out.

|The Crucibles of the Beyonder are a work of art none of us can replicate, with each one leading you into an Isolated Megalos Domain intricately designed by the Great Beyonder. Passing the challenges of the Crucible fully grants one the Full Transcendent Megalos Ability, and passing it a third or halfway will grant a partial Transcendent Megalos Ability. For some, they do not get far as they gain nothing, and one can even have their existence extinguished within the Crucible if they are too weak! O Instrument...do you wish to proceed in at this moment, or shall you wait for the passage of time as you acclimate to who you are? I know you were just born.|
Even those who had lived for many cycles didn't manage to clear the Crucible depending on their power.
Someone that was just born...how exactly would their challenge go? How low were their chances?!
And yet...as all eldritch eyes came to land on Ozymandias, he voiced out with immense calmness and confidence.
|I will enter now.|
WAA!
Unfathomable confidence radiated outwards!
And the ardor in the eyes of some of the Outerversal Morphons only increased.
This was truly the Instrument.
He had to be.
The massive Great Wheel buzzed as one could almost sense the smile on its tentacles.

|Very well. The Great Beyonder was an eccentric being as all challenges made within The Crucible are shown to those outside of it- almost as if to spur those watching to attempt it as well. We will be watching with anticipation out here, O Instrument.|

Around the massive crimson rift, twisting Pillars rose up and twisted back into the red earth, with massive obsidian obelisks and structures circling around it as if felt like an eldritch city was enacted around the crimson rift.

A city for Morphons to make merry and observe any attempts at the Crucible of the Beyonder, with endless stretches of structures continuing on from here and across the rest of the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra.
At this moment, millions of Morphons had turned their eyes to this place, and many more would undoubtedly make their way over.
Little Aspasia clasped her hands as Ozymandias moved forward.
|We wish you glory and a swift return, O Dream of the Beyonder.|
The distinction of the Dream of the Beyonder that Ozymandias gained after meeting the Great Mother.
Aspasia uttered it at this moment, and it rang out in this space of the Pantheon of Umbra, whispers of it beginning to spread!
And valiantly.
Without an ounce of a doubt!
Ozymandias, the Dream of the Beyonder, went towards the massive Rift of the Crucible as he disappeared!
WAP!
Existence in the surroundings buzzed.
The blaring rift pulsed and radiated waves of wonder, far brighter than when anyone else had entered it before.
Was this not a further affirmation of his identity?!
Above the massive rift, a light shot out to form a massive illusory screen that showed the outline of the Dream of the Beyonder.
On the sides of the rift, more lights shot out as other illusory screens showing different perspectives also appeared- it was a show more expressive than any other challenges of this Crucible.
|Let us observe and revel in the possibilities of what may be!|
The intent of a Great One reverberated out.
OOOOH! Outerversal Morphons cheered as in the eldritch city filled with obsidian structures down below, festivities began to pick up.
Drinks began to be prepared.
Foods prepared from the supple meat of Outerversal Eldritch Beasts began to be prepared!
And all eyes within Umbra began to focus on one place.
A flash of obsidian radiance.
By the time Ozymandias could see again, he found himself standing on a crimson crystalline earth.
All around him, dense clouds of black mist covered everything, only lighting up a cylindrical path ahead of him.
At the end of this path, there was a humanoid eldritch horror whose skin glistened with a mixture of gold and obsidian light.
He only had eyes on his humanoid head that flashed with golden brilliance, and a stellar golden horn rising from his head that was actually the same size as him!
A terrifying intent emanated from this being- and the surroundings masked with clouds of black mist that bloomed before Ozymandias.
|You have entered the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos.|
|If successful in getting past all Markers of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos, the full Transcendent Megalos Ability- the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos will be granted.|
|With it, one can Dream of the Megalos Beyond.|
|A single Dream can last an instant, but span a whole cycle. The gains and power obtained in any Amarantos Dream of the Megalos are retrieved and assimilated in your existence.|

|While others strive for power and connections, all one has to do is Dream and it can all be attained. At the highest level of proficiency of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos, even the Transcendence of Existence is feasible with but a dream.|
Terrifying weavings of intent came down.
The possible gains to be made here were astonishing as it was a technique left behind by the Great Beyonder!
Something that very few Outerversal Morphons even held the full ability of- with the number of Entities holding it fully being countable in one hand.
All were Great Ones.
Within a mere Dream, even Transcendence was possible!
But to get this Ability...one had to pass through the entire Crucible.
And just the first test alone gave Ozymandias a tremendous sense of pressure as in the distance, the entity with a curved golden horn the same size as his body rose.
It was obviously a fight.
But out of all three weavings of power, Ozymandias could only use Outerversal Authority as the Existential Extremity Authority of Noah Osmont nor His Authority of Ingeniare could be utilized.
The Authority of the Administrator of the Atlas of Existence could be pulled out and used to reinforce Outerversal Authority, but at this moment, Ozymandias had to fight like an Outerversal Morphon.

And since he was just born, he had no skills or abilities to speak of as he had to bring his own based on his previous weavings of existence, and the fact that his current body was that of an entity that had Transcended Existence to reach the Expanse!
With all of these factors put together...could he not clear the immeasurably hard Crucible that less than 10 Morphons cleared- a Crucible based on one's own strength?
|I guard the first Gateway of Dreams.|
WAA!
In the distance, the titanic figure of the humanoid morphon whose body shone with crystalline black and gold luster released his intent.
|I have cultivated the Transcendent Megalos Ability of the Existence Defying Physiology of the Megalos to the First Epoch. No Outerversal Authority at the Fourth Echelon or below can harm me.|
The intent was domineering.
The power seemed unsurpassable!

sentences.text: This was because an Outerversal Morphon who was just born, or even a Great One could all challenge the Crucible.
Its challenge...was tailored to the challenger as the level of difficulty would change drastically depending on who was challenging it.
As for the rewards...they were the unfathomable Transcendent Megalos Abilities that made the Great Beyonder so powerful.
Those who managed to clear even a portion of the Crucibles would gain small sections of these Transcendent Megalos Abilities as even these alone were enough to make them renowned Morphons.

|The Crucible of the Beyonder in our Pantheon of Umbra is also known as the Crucible of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos- aptly named for the Transcendent Megalos Ability one can gain if they successfully clear the Crucible.|
The Amarantos Dream of the Megalos!
This was the Transcendent Megalos Ability one could inherit from clearing the same named crucible.

Led by a procession of terrifying Outerversal Morphons, Ozymandias and Aspasia followed behind the devout followers of the Great Mother and arrived in front of a massive crimson rift at the center of the Pantheon.
The Great Wheel's tendrils vibrated with power as his deep voice echoed out.
|The Crucibles of the Beyonder are a work of art none of us can replicate, with each one leading you into an Isolated Megalos Domain intricately designed by the Great Beyonder.
Passing the challenges of the Crucible fully grants one the Full Transcendent Megalos Ability, and passing it a third or halfway will grant a partial Transcendent Megalos Ability.
For some, they do not get far as they gain nothing, and one can even have their existence extinguished within the Crucible if they are too weak!
O Instrument...do you wish to proceed in at this moment, or shall you wait for the passage of time as you acclimate to who you are?
I know you were just born.|
Even those who had lived for many cycles didn't manage to clear the Crucible depending on their power.
Someone that was just born...how exactly would their challenge go?
How low were their chances?!
And yet...as all eldritch eyes came to land on Ozymandias, he voiced out with immense calmness and confidence.
|I will enter now.|
WAA!
Unfathomable confidence radiated outwards!
And the ardor in the eyes of some of the Outerversal Morphons only increased.
This was truly the Instrument.
He had to be.
The massive Great Wheel buzzed as one could almost sense the smile on its tentacles.
|Very well.
The Great Beyonder was an eccentric being as all challenges made within The Crucible are shown to those outside of it- almost as if to spur those watching to attempt it as well.
We will be watching with anticipation out here, O Instrument.|

Around the massive crimson rift, twisting Pillars rose up and twisted back into the red earth, with massive obsidian obelisks and structures circling around it as if felt like an eldritch city was enacted around the crimson rift.

A city for Morphons to make merry and observe any attempts at the Crucible of the Beyonder, with endless stretches of structures continuing on from here and across the rest of the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra.
At this moment, millions of Morphons had turned their eyes to this place, and many more would undoubtedly make their way over.
Little Aspasia clasped her hands as Ozymandias moved forward.
|We wish you glory and a swift return, O Dream of the Beyonder.|
The distinction of the Dream of the Beyonder that Ozymandias gained after meeting the Great Mother.
Aspasia uttered it at this moment, and it rang out in this space of the Pantheon of Umbra, whispers of it beginning to spread!
And valiantly.
Without an ounce of a doubt!
Ozymandias, the Dream of the Beyonder, went towards the massive Rift of the Crucible as he disappeared!
WAP!
Existence in the surroundings buzzed.
The blaring rift pulsed and radiated waves of wonder, far brighter than when anyone else had entered it before.
Was this not a further affirmation of his identity?!
Above the massive rift, a light shot out to form a massive illusory screen that showed the outline of the Dream of the Beyonder.
On the sides of the rift, more lights shot out as other illusory screens showing different perspectives also appeared- it was a show more expressive than any other challenges of this Crucible.
|Let us observe and revel in the possibilities of what may be!|
The intent of a Great One reverberated out.
OOOOH!
Outerversal Morphons cheered as in the eldritch city filled with obsidian structures down below, festivities began to pick up.

chapters.title: Chapter 3273 Appalling! I
paragraphs: The Outerversal Physiology and Megalos Regnum of Ozymandias had only just reached the Third Echelon.

On the illusory screens where the Great Wheel and hundreds of thousands of his followers and those standing against him, the words of the Guard who had attained the First Epoch of the Existence Defying Physiology of the Megalos rang out for all of them to hear!
Even just attaining proficiency of the First Epoch, No Outerversal Authority at the Fourth Echelon or below could harm this creature.
The Crucibles of the Beyonder were unique in that sometimes, the challenges within would have weavings of the rewards of other Crucibles.

The Existence Defying Physiology of the Megalos was another Transcendent Megalos Ability that could be gained within another Pantheon far from the Pantheon of Umbra, and yet the challenges within the Crucible here had entities who cultivated such a technique as the ones to overcome.
The difficulty was that much greater.
But when Outerversal Morphon heard to intent of the Guard, they couldn't help but draw sharp breaths.

A newly born Morphon had to face someone who had cultivated the First Epoch of the terrifying Existence Defying Physiology of the Megalos as the first challenge? What the hell would even come after this?!
But there wasn't even any time to wonder.

The One Who guarded the First Gateway of Dreams moved to instantly appear in front of the Dream of the Beyonder with appalling speed, his obsidian gold hand formed into a fist that thundered down the head of Ozymandias!
Aspasia unconsciously let out her intent as she realized that in all her calculations, she truly had not considered the scope of power that the Instrument could unleash.
He wouldn't...falter here and lose face under the gaze of all these Outerversal Morphons, right?
He needed to keep his momentum and only build from it as he couldn't fall!
'O Great Mother, do not allow him to fall...'
She made a silent prayer as on the illusory screen, the extremely fast fist of the Guard already reached the stellar obsidian head of the Instrument.
And...
BZZZT!
As if an immovable force had met an unstoppable object.
A paradox of a clash boomed between the two sides as the figure of the Guard was pushed back as if he had smashed into an elastic material!
Within the Crucible.

Ozymandias watched with a sense of shock and alarm as just this single Guard who was utilizing a Transcendent Megalos Ability...nearly reached 50% of the threshold of his defenses that he had as a Transcendent Existence.
One of the bodies of Savitar, a Great One, was able to bypass his higher Existence entirely and wound him slightly with his body in the Megalos Ynnere.
While this Guard wasn't able to bypass them at all, the power expressed was truly shocking as... was it all attributed to the Transcendent Megalos Ability?

It made him even more expectant of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos and its grand promises- while he was also reminded of when he used to Dream many months ago. But he put all thoughts aside for now.
He had to take care of the enemy before him.
After being smashed away, the Guard was unfazed as he continued to come.
Hands. Legs. His golden horn!
He seemed to be a pure sheer physical force of nature as he constantly turned into a
streak of obsidian gold light that smashed around Ozymandias.
The only caveat was how the Guard wasn't able to get through!
The Outerversal Morphons watching were shocked as whispers spread.

Just recently born without his Physiology cultivated and nurtured by the Megalos Beyond, and yet...he is comparable if not exceeding the defenses granted by the First Echelon of the Existence Defying Physiology of the Megalos!
Some faces showed their surprise and belief. Others were stern while they only observed with heavy expressions.
And Ozymandias himself...had finished theorizing on how he could attack as an Outerversal Morphon!
He felt the many lines of connections he had stolen from Savitar and other connections he held that allowed him to course with potent Outerversal Authority.
He felt the massive connection with the Infinite Omniverse that was doing a feedback of granting him waves of Psioneutrino Particles that seemed to hold even purer waves of Dark Matter.
And his weavings commanded out.
Start the weavings of a database of Outerversal Skills.
Outerversal Skills to match his fearsome form of an Outerversal Morphon.
A way to express his Outerversal Authority as an attack!
Instantly, his mind felt like an open field ready for any design as when it came to capabilities filled with eldritch horror...Ozymandias already had an idea of how he wanted to express his power.
The first Outerversal Skill shall be based on the Outerversal Organ- the Heart.|
HUUM!
Ozymandias placed his hand on his chest as in the next moment, a fissure bloomed on it as something flashed out.
A deeply obsidian heart.

A terrifying source of Outerversal Authority as at this moment, its veins and arteries that looked like they were cut out wildly began to extend and form into pulsing obsidian tentacles- tentacles that enlarged and radiated a potent glow of Outerversal Authority! The parameters of the Outerversal Skill, Heart of a Morphon, has been designed. What power could Ozymandias tap into when he could currently be considered weak as
a Morphon?

If he didn't want to risk utilizing the Authority of the Administrator of the Atlas of Existence under the eyes of terrifying Entities like the Great Wheel, there was one truly pure source of power that was actually part of his strength as an Outerversal Morphon.
His strongest connection.
His strongest supporter.
A small portion of the breadth, weight, and sheer complexity of the weavings of the Infinite Omniverse flows across vast distances to be expressed through your Outerversal
Organ.
15% of the breadth, weight, and sheer complexity of the weavings of the Infinite Omniverse flow through your Heart.]
THUMP!
The Outerversal Heart he held in his hands beat loudly as its vessels constricted with
power.
The tentacles blooming from its veins and arteries smashed out with horrific speed and
force at this moment!
BOOM!
In the small clouded channel.
The rapidly moving Guard, whose body shone with an indestructible brilliance, was
smashed backward for the first time.
On its crystalline golden obsidian chest, a faint white marking could be seen.
Even it seemed astonished as its eyes gazed forth at the enemy holding an inky black heart that at this moment seemed to gain an unfathomably heavy weight!

chapters.title: Chapter 3274 Appalling! II
paragraphs: The Challenge of the Crucibles was hard, but they reflected the challenger.
Since Ozymandias was in the Third Echelon of his Outerversal Physiology and Megalos Regnum, the enemy he was given was someone interminably powerful in the Fourth Echelon of Outerversal Physiology.
Frankly, even other Outerversal Morphons at the Fourth Echelon would not find it easy to beat it as it practiced the Transcendent Megalos Ability- Existence Defying Physiology of the Megalos!
This was the hard challenge that very few could overcome.
If an Outerversal Morphon with the Seventh Echelon of Outerversal Physiology entered, their first challenge would be a Guard equivalent to the Eighth Echelon.
Unless one had unique innate capabilities or other oddities, they wouldn't be able to cross the gulf of power!
And Ozymandias...held a truly ridiculous oddity.
The complexity, weight, and breadth of an Infinite Omniverse flowing through his Outerversal Heart!
Even a percentage of it as his body couldn't currently withstand the full weight of the Infinite Omniverse coursing through him.
10% of the breadth, weight, and sheer complexity of the weavings of the Infinite Omniverse now flow through your Heart.
WUU!
The amount of power flowing through was doubled, the Outerversal Heart of Ozymandias creaking as this was almost the maximum that Ozymandias could currently support without too heavy a strain!

One must remember that the Infinite Omniverse had already undergone Existential Terraforming and subsequently undergone further expansion and elevation with Psioneutrino Particles that rapidly and exponentially increased the sheer size and complexity of its Havens, and it now even assimilated a Dark Matter Core from a whole Omniverse.
Its complexity a day ago was incomparable to its complexity now.
At 5%, a white mark was made on the unbreakable body of the Guard. At 10%...
HUUM!

Deep obsidian radiance erupted with Ozymandias at the center, the tentacles of his heart shooting out with a heavy beat, their speed far exceeding even the guard as they thrashed towards him all around.
DUM! DUM! DUM! CRACK!
Like the beating of drums.
They were utterly majestic and heavy as soon after, cracks formed on the crystalline golden obsidian body of the Guard, and once a single crack occurred...more followed. DUM!
A final beat echoed out.
The tentacles of the Outerversal Organ retracted as the black mist cleared.
Those watching were flabbergasted as they had watched the first challenge of this Crucible many times.

They knew that to clear it...an Outerversal Morphon had to show their power and prestige by at least breaching the defenses of the first Guard of the Amarantos Dream. By causing at least a crack on its body.
But what they saw now...was the body of the Guard of the Amarantos Dream lying shattered in many pieces!
Behind it, the First Gateway of Dreams glowed with an incandescent white light to show that the first challenge had been cleared.

There was an eerie silence in this region of the Pantheon of Umbra at this scene, the Outerversal Morphons observing with awe and other complex feelings as Ozymandias cooly floated forward, the tendrils of his heart pulling him along as they gathered the broken pieces of the Guard of the Amarantos Dream and walked through the gateway silently.

The Second Gateway of Dreams is filled with heavy weavings of Megalos Regnum that make it hard to even take a step, and one will face many more Guards of the Amarantos Dream. Passing it would grant one a portion of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos... will the Regnum of the Dream of the Beyonder be as astonishing as his Physiology?|
An intent echoed out.
Little Aspasia looked around at the intents of amazement and doubt as she clasped her hands on her chest and spoke resonantly.
Naturally.
WU!
A single word of decisiveness!
It was followed by the scene on the illusory screens changing and showing a luxurious mountain surrounded by obscuring mist.
At the foot of this mountain, Ozymandias stood with an obsidian heart in his hands, nine massive tentacles weavings from this heart as he gazed above towards the peak of this
mountain where an obsidian gateway lay!
But from the bottom of the mountain to the top...
WAA!
The figure of multiple Guards of the Amarantos Dream appeared.
Their golden horns rose towards the misty skies as there were at least 50 of them, and the misty atmosphere of the mountain...seemed to be pressing down with a heavy
weight!
As if an unfathomable weaving of gravitational forces were pressing down on everything and making it hard to even take a step.
Megalos Regnum.
An unseen form of power across the Megalos Beyond.
Determined by the amount of influence and change one could affect across the Megalos
Beyond!
The Instrument was just born, so surely, his Regnum had to be low.
It would be hard for him to even take a step towards the peak of the mountain that was guarded by over 50 Guards of the Amarantos Dream, right?
As the Outerversal Morphons watched with anticipation to see how heavy or light the first grueling steps towards the mountain peak would be...
Their tentacles buzzed as Ozymandias...did not walk up the mountain.
He rose.
He floated.
He flew!
As if the oppressive pressure dancing and cascading down from all around absolutely did
not exist for him!
And truly, from the perspective of Ozymandias who was given the pressure of a Megalos Regnum a level above him, it didn't matter.
How high was the Dignity of his other existence within the Infinite Omniverse?
How high was the Dignity and Honor of an Existence that had arrived in the Expanse and
was doping himself with Hearthraes at this very moment, with his existence becoming in tune with both the Megalos Ynnere and Megalos Beyond?!
Could a mere pressure a level above what his Outerversal Physiology expressed even
affect him?!
The answer was clear!
He flew up towards the peak of the misty mountain, the Guards of the Amarantos
Dream shocked at the scene as they bellowed out and charged towards him en masse!

They were utterly majestic and heavy as soon after, cracks formed on the crystalline golden obsidian body of the Guard, and once a single crack occurred...more followed.
DUM!
A final beat echoed out.
The tentacles of the Outerversal Organ retracted as the black mist cleared.
Those watching were flabbergasted as they had watched the first challenge of this Crucible many times.
They knew that to clear it...an Outerversal Morphon had to show their power and prestige by at least breaching the defenses of the first Guard of the Amarantos Dream.
By causing at least a crack on its body.
But what they saw now...was the body of the Guard of the Amarantos Dream lying shattered in many pieces!
Behind it, the First Gateway of Dreams glowed with an incandescent white light to show that the first challenge had been cleared.

There was an eerie silence in this region of the Pantheon of Umbra at this scene, the Outerversal Morphons observing with awe and other complex feelings as Ozymandias cooly floated forward, the tendrils of his heart pulling him along as they gathered the broken pieces of the Guard of the Amarantos Dream and walked through the gateway silently.
The Second Gateway of Dreams is filled with heavy weavings of Megalos Regnum that make it hard to even take a step, and one will face many more Guards of the Amarantos Dream.
Passing it would grant one a portion of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos... will the Regnum of the Dream of the Beyonder be as astonishing as his Physiology?|
An intent echoed out.
Little Aspasia looked around at the intents of amazement and doubt as she clasped her hands on her chest and spoke resonantly.
Naturally.
WU!
A single word of decisiveness!
It was followed by the scene on the illusory screens changing and showing a luxurious mountain surrounded by obscuring mist.
At the foot of this mountain, Ozymandias stood with an obsidian heart in his hands, nine massive tentacles weavings from this heart as he gazed above towards the peak of this
mountain where an obsidian gateway lay!
But from the bottom of the mountain to the top...
WAA!
The figure of multiple Guards of the Amarantos Dream appeared.
Their golden horns rose towards the misty skies as there were at least 50 of them, and the misty atmosphere of the mountain...seemed to be pressing down with a heavy
weight!
As if an unfathomable weaving of gravitational forces were pressing down on everything and making it hard to even take a step.
Megalos Regnum.
An unseen form of power across the Megalos Beyond.
Determined by the amount of influence and change one could affect across the Megalos
Beyond!
The Instrument was just born, so surely, his Regnum had to be low.
It would be hard for him to even take a step towards the peak of the mountain that was guarded by over 50 Guards of the Amarantos Dream, right?
As the Outerversal Morphons watched with anticipation to see how heavy or light the first grueling steps towards the mountain peak would be...
Their tentacles buzzed as Ozymandias...did not walk up the mountain.
He rose.
He floated.
He flew!
As if the oppressive pressure dancing and cascading down from all around absolutely did
not exist for him!
And truly, from the perspective of Ozymandias who was given the pressure of a Megalos Regnum a level above him, it didn't matter.
How high was the Dignity of his other existence within the Infinite Omniverse?
How high was the Dignity and Honor of an Existence that had arrived in the Expanse and
was doping himself with Hearthraes at this very moment, with his existence becoming in tune with both the Megalos Ynnere and Megalos Beyond?!
Could a mere pressure a level above what his Outerversal Physiology expressed even
affect him?!
The answer was clear!
He flew up towards the peak of the misty mountain, the Guards of the Amarantos
Dream shocked at the scene as they bellowed out and charged towards him en masse!

chapters.title: Chapter 3275 Always a Dreamer! I
paragraphs: Weavings of shock spread out on clusters of hundreds of thousands of Eldritch Horrors watching the events within the Crucible of the Beyonder.
Undoubtedly, there were many here who were more powerful as Outerversal Morphons.
But their surprise came from the sheer dominance shown within the challenges of The Crucible that should be a level above any entity challenging it!
So how was he outclassing it all so seamlessly?
Near the terrifying Great Wheel, Little Aspasia grasped her hands with a look of reverence as her intent echoed out.
|Believe in the Dream of the Beyonder! Believe in the Instrument that shall usher in glory for all of Megalos Beyond...!|
Her gaze was reverent.
Her intent spread to others as they couldn't help but watch the illusory screens of the Crucible with rapt attention.
At this same time, a few light years away from this location.
In another area of the Pantheon of Umbra, the figure of Savitar had its eyes gazing all the way from this far distance, and yet he could see everything with clarity as he scoffed.
|The Instrument that shall usher in glory? What a load of shit...|
His eyes contained particularly great distaste as at this moment, space fluctuated behind him to cause the appearance of a Morphon shrouded in black smoke.
They were shrouded so heavily and fully that the figure within couldn't even be seen.
Savitar became stern at the appearance of such a figure as the purple flames in his skull blazed heavily.
|Rare to see you in these parts, O Great Ponderer.|
The Great Ponderor.
Nietzsche!
This being shrouded in mystery even caused Savitar to feel uneasy.
Very rarely did he make a move.
But when he did, all things he wanted fell into place!
|Haha, Old Friend Savitar, what puts you in such a foul mood. Surely this so-called Instrument can't be the cause?|
The black mass, with an indescribable form, released their intent as Savitar scoffed and said nothing.
How could he state that one of his weaker bodies in the Megalos Ynnere was just killed in one of the most ridiculous ways possible?
He kept it to himself as uniquely, he didn't even know the threatening being who appeared right beside him was one of the major causes for why he lost one of his bodies!
|Well, whatever has you sour, I came with an opportunity today. The location of an Omniverse within Megalos Ynnere.|
|Oh?|
The attention of Savitar was aroused.
His flames kindled on his sockets as the Great Ponderor continued.

|A newly discovered Omniverse by the Peons of the Commonwealth. They're wrapping up their little day of discovery as the wills of the Pillars of the Commonwealth are about to leave it. Likely a few weak Protectors will be left behind.|
The flames of Savitar rose higher as he replied.
|If the Commonwealth already has their presence there, I won't even be given time to form a Dark Matter Core...|
|Is that all you need? There would be many juicy Delegatus there for you to grab.|
The Words of the Great Ponderor caused Savitar to pause.
Right.
He had just lost a few million Delegatus with the death of one of his main bodies.
He could recoup his losses here, and make an exit before the truly powerful Peons of the Commonwealth arrive.
But as always...his flames burned suspiciously towards the Great Ponderor.
|And what do you get out of this information? You could do the same for yourself and harvest this Omniverse for its life.|
Yes.
The Great Ponderor never did anything without meaning.
What did they want out of this?

|Haha, naturally, I gain something. By the time the Peons of the Commonwealth react and send more of their nearby forces, they will take those of nearby Omniverses. And once they do...I plan to attack an Omniverse with a particularly delicious Peon I've had my eye on. That I can't share with you...but yes, I will benefit too.|
The Words of the Great Ponderor were straightforward as Savitar nodded.
He had to quell some of his rage and recoup his losses!
|Very well.|
The One Who Walks agreed as the shrouded figure of the Great Ponderor buzzed with brilliance.
Unknown to Savitar, his target lay within Omniverse X-999.
Protector Noah Osmont!

At the thought of this being, the Great Ponderor recalled how not too long ago, he had displayed how he had attained the state of One With Existence to the Equestris Protectors where his Delegatus was hidden.
And here, he received reports that shockingly, the newly born Instrument had attained the State of One With Megalos.
Two different pieces of information.
They only fluttered across his mind briefly before they passed.
There was no possible trigger to someone cause the Great Ponderor to even associate these two events!
His focus at this moment was the Protector that had stolen his hard work.
The one he currently hunted as after Savitar made a move against Omniverse X-999, he would come to understand more about Noah Osmont.
And as always.
Only after he fully understood his enemy would he make a move.
Only then!
And by the time he made a move, his enemy would already be defeated!
For he...was Nietzsche!
His existence buzzed as he also observed the so called Instrument in the distance.
He also had to make plans on how he could benefit from this.
Based on the momentum the Instrument carried, should he be a supporter...or a Heretical Morphon?

His weavings flashed with brilliance as they observed the Instrument shoot up the mountain, the unbreakable Guards of the Amarantos Dream surging towards him like Pillars of obsidian gold radiance, and yet his heart smashed out its tentacles with heavy waves of force that smashed them away as they sunk into the earth of the mountain!
When they rose from their craters, their bodies already held fractures.
When they sought to stop him again by throwing their bodies and long golden horns towards him...
BOOM!
They were smashed for a second time with even greater ferocity as when they smashed onto the mountain again, their bodies were already in crystalline pieces!
His relentless advancement could not be stopped as he neared the peak of the mountain.
The moment he passed it, regardless of whether he passed the remaining challenges of this Crucible...he would gain a portion of the Transcendent Megalos Ability, Amarantos Dream of the Megalos!

chapters.title: Chapter 3276 Always a Dreamer! II
paragraphs: A mere portion!
And this alone was capable of bringing to fruition a powerful Outerversal Morphon.
The Great Ponderor himself didn't have the full Amarantos Dream of the Megalos, but he knew how stupendous it had been for him during his rise to power.
Now...it wasn't as terrifying as someone on his stage truly needed the full technique.
If the Instrument could obtain it...would he be able to transmit it to others?
The Great Ponderor...pondered.
BOOM! BOOM!

The tentacles of his heart seemed slimy and filled with obsidian stellar blood, and yet they smashed onto the hardened crystalline bodies of Guards who practiced the Existence Defying Physiology of the Megalos and splintered them to pieces!
The complexity of an entire Omniverse- even if it was a percentage of it, was this overpowering.
BOOM!
Another Guard of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos was smashed into a crater on the misty mountain as Ozymandias came to land on the peak.
The Obsidian portal on the peak of the mountain turned white as akin to simply passing by, Ozymandias went through!
Space twisted with radiance.
He barely blinked, and he appeared in a different place.
There were no enemies.
He stood upon a crystalline earth that extended out endlessly, with a single white portal shimmering gently ahead of him.
Above him, the whole skies were replaced with a single scroll.
A scroll that seemed to be filled with interminable complex weavings of existence- the words [AMARANTOS] burning with a gorgeous obsidian hue on it!
It should have been a partial reward for having arrived where he had arrived.
But it was grander than that.
In front of Ozymandias and those watching outside of the Crucible...intents made themselves clear before him.
|The Crucible of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos has deemed it unnecessary to continue challenging you after the dominating weavings displayed.|
|The Full Transcendent Megalos Ability, Amarantos Dream of the Megalos, can now be inherited.|
The eyes of Ozymandias pulsed.
The hand grasping his heart...lowered itself as his chest opened, his heart flowing back in as its tentacles reconnected to his body!
He was speechless.
He had overpowered the initial stages of the Crucible so much that it didn't pose him the remaining challenges.
The Crucible itself gave up!
From the dazzling scroll covering the skies above, a blinding golden light shot down and bathed Ozymandias with glory!
Within the Megalos Pantheon of Umbra.
The Tentacles of the Great Wheel vibrated.
His forces and other Outerversal Morphons were flabbergasted.
What was this?
The Crucible deemed it unnecessary to even continue the challenge?
When the hell had this happened before?!
Yes, he showed such dominance in the first and second challenges, but...really?!
|Hidden mechanisms that were never discovered were shown here today...so the Crucible can also be cleared this way!|
An intent echoed out amidst the shock as the Outerversal Morphons clamored.
|Unfathomable!|
|Unbelievable!|
|Unfair!|
Different cries rose out, but the results were undeniable.
Little Aspasia spread her hands out as she echoed out with sharp eyes and a glare.
|Behold...the grandeur of the Dream of the Beyonder!|
The Dream of the Beyonder.
The Sign.
The Instrument!

He made himself clear and present under many eyes today with a shocking show of power, all eldritch eyes watching as he inherited the full Transcendent Megalos Ability, Amarantos Dream of the Megalos!

In that space where the skies were filled with a single massive scroll, a pillar of obsidian light gushed down onto the visage of Ozymandias endlessly as it seemed to be transcribing tremendously complex weavings into his existence.
Ozymandias found that the rays of obsidian light were formed from extremely pure dark matter- its concentration and purity being something that he reached a millionth of right now!
A millionth!
That was how pure these waves of Dark Matter were as they converged into a single point in his existence- this point beginning the outline of a rune.
A rune deeply obsidian in radiance as it read...AMARANTOS!
BOOOM!
Alongside it, the weavings of a complex technique began to burn themselves into his mind.
|The Inheritance of the full Transcendent Megalos Ability, Amarantos Dream of the Megalos, is in process.|
One had to gain this Inheritance to even be capable of utilizing this technique.

Once the terrifying rune of AMARANTOS began to form, one had to utilize swathes of their Outerversal Authority to power it up, and they could begin traversing on the tremendous path of dreaming of the Megalos Beyond!
As the rune formed in Ozymandias.
|The full Transcendent Megalos Ability...Only three Great Ones have attained it!|
Outside.
The intents of Outerversal Morphons raged with abundance as they discussed some lesser known secrets.

|The weavings of the Great Ones have stated that for all of them...the first Dream was a special one. Only an instant was guaranteed to pass for the Megalos Beyond, and yet their dream across the Megalos Beyond...could span entire cycles if they were lucky!|
WAA!
Amarantos Dream of the Megalos was another terrifying capability.
|What will the Dream of the Beyonder...dream of?|
If he truly wasn't the Instrument as many of them now believed.
What would this being Dream? And how shocking would his gains be when he still had very little proficiency in this Transcendent Megalos Ability?
The Morphons and many other eyes watching wondered.
But in that unique space...Ozymandias found himself deeply attracted to the rune of AMARANTOS.
Not because of its shocking power, but purely due to its complexity.
Within this complexity...he saw some similarities.
The subject field of all of this was Dreams.
And he...had always been a Dreamer.
He had dreamt of Dimensions.
He had dreamt of himself spread out for light years.
In the Amarantos rune, he saw similarities of this dream as instantly...
HUUM!
From his connection to the Infinite Omniverse, the already changing Dream Aletheian Haven that was uniquely shining with obsidian sandy gold radiance pulsed.
It was already influenced by Dark Matter through the Psioneutrino Particles.
And now, it felt the pull of something very similar to it carrying even purer weavings of Dark Matter.
BOOM!

The entire Dream Aletheian Haven and its Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority erupted into a grandiose pillar of sandy obsidian gold light that surged across the Infinite Omniverse and towards Ozymandias!
Across the Megalos Ynnere and into the Megalos Beyond.
It arrived with fervor into Ozymandias who was already bearing 10% of the complexity of the Infinite Omniverse- and it pierced into the obsidian rune of AMARANTOS.
A rune that began to flicker with a golden brilliance as with such a massive influx of authority, Ozymandias didn't even need to unleash any of his own.
All he had to do was to...
|Dream.|
WAA!
Yes.
He could dream.
But his Dream...would be unfathomably vast.
The massive rune began to flicker as the words of Ozymandias echoed out within him.
|Dream of the Megalos Beyond.|
|Dream...of the Megalos Ynnere.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3277 An Endless Dream! I
paragraphs: Dream!

The very weavings of Ozymandias echoed such a command as within him, the forming rune of AMARANTOS burned with a fearsome obsidian gold light as from the Infinite Omniverse, the weavings of the Dream Aletheian Haven tunneled into it endlessly.

The Transcendent Megalos Ability, Amarantos Dream of the Megalos, was something unfathomable that allowed one to experience weavings of existence that were Dreams...and yet the gains of these dreams could be retrieved and assimilated into one's existence.
The time of the Dream varied as a single dream could last seconds, days, or years, and it could be equivalent to seconds, years, or even entire cycles.
It was all unknown.
But from the few who had attained this technique, it was known that the first Dream would only ever take an instant, no matter how much time passed within the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos.
At this moment, Ozymandias started his first Amarantos Dream of the Megalos as the forming rune of AMARANTOS exploded out to cover him with a storm of sandy gold brilliance.
And thus...an instant began to tick.
BOOM!
His eyes snapped open.
His form was that of an obsidian worm that rose in a dark earth, his segments wiggling around to observe his surroundings as he was just born.
And yet he knew who he was.
He was Ozymandias, and this was but a Dream!
He didn't have his power.
No state of Transcendence.
No state of Existence.
No Infinite Mana.
No connection to the Infinite Omniverse!
He rose up to look around him and found a few other worms like him waking, their bodies as Morphons looking feeble and sumptuous.
And so...
SUU!
His body zapped towards the nearby wriggling Morphons as he began to devour them one by one, his Outerversal Physiology and Regnum beginning to rise maddeningly.
In this Dream, he didn't feel any connection to the Infinite Omniverse or anything else as he could only depend on himself.
After devouring all the newly born Morphons near him, he bid his time and recalled the sensation of Alieia, of the Innate nature of Morphons spreading their weavings to connect to others.
He didn't go too far as he began to fish for connections in the dark earth he was on.
A month passed before he was able to find his first Delegatus- a weak flower tentacle that grew from the dark earth he was on.
With a single Delegatus bound, he was able to feel as if his vision had greatly expanded, his will spreading out towards nearby Flower Tentacles as his Delegatus began to increase rapidly!
His Megalos Regnum slowly strengthened. His Outerversal Physiology began to ebb forward steadily.
Slowly, years passed in this glorious dream.
The small body of a worm was no more, and a renowned Outerversal Morphon had begun to rise in the land where the dark earth was contained in- a small portion of the Megalos Pantheon of Gama!
Under him, his Delegatus extended not just within the Megalos Beyond, but even within the Megalos Ynnere.
His body was now a massive segmented worm with thousands of tentacles pulsing eerily around him, and the Morphons under him reached thousands!

He obtained a great deal of knowledge regarding Outerversal Morphons, and also about the Crucible that stood within the Megalos Pantheon of Gama- the Crucible of the Existence Defying Physiology of the Megalos.
He didn't have anything relating to Noah Osmont or Ozymandias, but he had the Will.
He had the memories.
He held the Dignity!
A hundred years passed.
His power grew to attain the Fifth Echelon of Outerversal Physiology as at such a time, he delved into the Crucible within the Pantheon of Gama.
Given the power he had cultivated all these years along with astounding techniques he designed from previous weavings of existence, he challenged the Crucible!
But it was truly too arduous without the power he commanded outside of this Dream, and he was only able to complete half of the crucible.
Thus, he was awarded with half of the Existence Defying Physiology of the Megalos.
But even this half, when it began to be cultivated...required tremendous amounts of Nectar of Existence among other resources!
But the results...allowed his power to scale tremendously.
He began to gain some true renown on the Megalos Pantheon of Gama, his power at unprecedented levels as hundreds of years passed!
He became known as the Worm of the Deep!
On the 2,500th year.
His power reached a point where all of a sudden...his weavings buzzed as they felt unfathomably sleepy.
Unfathomably so.
And endless slumber overcame him as he fell asleep and began to dream.
|GAH!|
Inside of an Omniverse.

A golden furred Simian arose from a verdant pool filled with terrifying waves of existence, 9 Apogee Autarchs and an Omniversal Entity looking at him at the center of the pool as they breathed a sigh of relief!
|You survived the ambush of the Morphons, Protector Alexei...you had us worried for a second!|
Protector Alexei opened his eyes wide and stared at his hands.
The golden fur on them.
His reflection in the verdant waters that looked like a Simian.
It was not who he truly was. Because he knew...that he was in a Dream!
But this Dream had gone from the Megalos Beyond and stretched into the Megalos Ynnere.
At this moment, he closed his eyes as he felt at the Base of his Existence, there was a massive Wheel turning.
A system of existence based on the Wheel of Existence- one seeking to emulate its wonders and be close to it!
Inside of him burned an astonishing bloodline and System of Existence as he rose from the verdant pool while smiling devilishly.
"I was truly worried for myself too, my Brother!"
He spoke jovially towards the Omniversal Stage Entity as the endless dream continued!
As a Protector of the Commonwealth- one so close to the Omniversal Stage, he was privy to many secrets.
And he became so unfathomably in tune with the System of Existence of the Royal Simians.
The Existence of the followers of the System of Existence of Kuklos held a refinement and elevation of existence at every turn of the Wheel.
This...he attained seamlessly in this Dream!

chapters.title: Chapter 3278 An Endless Dream! II
paragraphs: As Protector Alexei, hundreds of years passed as he battled against the forces of Outerversal Morphons and Worms of Existence.
In one Omniverse, he faced the dredges of an ancient Outerversal Morphon who had spread out his influence over dozens of Omniverses.
In another, he was exposed to the terrifying Worms of Existence stemming from the Megalos Nihilos!
Every time he massacred them, the Wheel in his existence turned ever faster.
He could almost feel the forging of his Fabled Omniverse get closer and closer.
In this Dream, over these hundreds of years that passed, he never looked for Omniverse X-999.
This was because of a critical piece of information he had received early on.
On a certain day hundreds of years ago, his Brother on the Omniversal Stage had told him something.
|The Omniverses our Commonwealth has discovered? Hmm, the most recent one is Omniverse X-577. Why?|
Yes.
Within this Dream, it was unknown exactly how many years ago it was before Omniverse X-999 was ever discovered.
In addition to this, another terrifying piece of information was uncovered during another discussion with the Brother of Protector Alexei.
He had just returned from a campaign, and his expression was a cold one.
Seeing the gaze of the golden-furred Protector Alexei, the Brother had sighed and spoken.
|As you get stronger, it will not just be Outerversal Morphons you will have to fight off. Eventually, our own people will fall under your scrutiny.|

|Today, I tracked down Protector Voidsurge who had recently made tremendous advancements in a short period of time. He wouldn't let me Scour the Weavings of his Existence as ultimately, he exploded out with Outerversal Authority...and the illusion of a massive, tenebrous, tentacled Wheel. It was not the Wheel of Existence we all follow, but the Wheel of Enticement! The Great Wheel! The Wheel of the Distorter!|
A terrifying hidden issue was revealed within the bounds of the Commonwealth with those who sought the glory of the Wheel of Existence.
Some were led astray as when they sought the Wheel, they found something else entirely.
This...was something to be mindful of.
Life continued.
Until, on a certain day, Protector Alexei led an incursion against a Half-Tainted Omniverse that had a new player who had never appeared before.
An Outerversal Morphon that looked like a massive snail.

When Protector Alexei and this Morphon came face to face, terrifying weavings of existence flourished as a great battle ensued- and in this battle, his Fabled Omniverse actually began to form as he condensed all of his existence into a fine point!
But before the transformation could be completed.
In the middle of battle.
Protector Alexei began to feel a heavy pull of sleep.
And darkness overcame him entirely.
And he continued to Dream!
PAH!
His consciousness arose once more.
He found himself staring at endless obsidian radiance all around, with his surroundings filled with auras of terrifying creatures
Another dream.
In this dream...Ozymandias was something else entirely.
|O Great Deceiver, are you sure of this? The Instrument has garnered a great deal of power. Multiple Great Ones stand to support him...with the Great Mother being the one who is the most fanatical.|
Near him, an entity that looked like a star formed from Tentacles spoke towards a terrifying Outerversal Morphon that had the head of a bull and the body of a human.
A Great One. The Great Deceiver!
At the intent shown his way, this entity harrumphed as he replied.

|The Great Beyonder has far exceeded all of us as his means are unfathomable. He left this astonishing Legacy not just for the Instrument. Attaining it...will also aid us in our Incursion across the Expanse. We need more to become One With Megalos. More to Transcend their old shells and become something else. So yes...I am sure!|
The area they were in was hazy.
But he stood behind this terrifying Great One as he looked at himself at this moment.
An Outerversal Morphon who also held the head of a bull and the body of a Human.
Someone known as Outerversal Morphon Lexo!
An attendant of this Great Deceiver.
He held terrifying waves of Megalos Regnum, and the connection he had under him...spanned hundreds of millions.
'Fantastic...'
His thoughts were vibrant as he prepared for a long dream.
In front of him, the Great Deceiver turned his will unto him as he spoke out.
|Lexo, contact the Great Ponderor and-....huh?|
The Great One stopped in the midst of his words.

His crimson eyes blinked before a second later, they burned with flames as pillars of crimson stellar light actually erupted from them- these pillars scorching everything on their path as they went to ground Morphon Lexo into nothingness!
|Fucking hell! A Dreamer! A Dreamer actually stood beside me this whole time? Who? WHO?!|
The shouts were filled with rage and waves of wrath, the third Dream being stopped extremely short as this time, the pull of a deep slumber was not felt.
Ozymandias opened his eyes once more, but he found himself in an infinitely vast stellar obsidian space.
And in front of him...three blinding singularities could be seen.
|Due to the erasure of your Existence, the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos has been brought to an end.|
|Your proficiency in the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos currently stands in the First Echelon, with your Proficiency at 66%.|
|Based on this, the weavings of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos you can obtain are extremely limited.|
|All memories of the Dreams are retained.|
|The Weavings of a single Dream can be retrieved fully, and half the weavings of another Dream can be retrieved.|
|The Three Dreams of the Megalos capable of being chosen are as follows|

[The Worm of the Deep- Outerversal Physiology Echelon V, Megalos Regnum Echelon IV. 155,000,000 Pure Delegatus Channels. Half of the Existence Defying Physiology of the Megalos Transcendent Megalos Ability.]
[Protector Alexei- System of Existence of Kuklos Echelon 4. Musings of the formation of a Fabled Omniverse.]
[Outerversal Morphon Lexo- Outerversal Physiology Echelon V, Megalos Regnum Echelon V. 277,000,000 Pure Delegatus Channels.]

chapters.title: Chapter 3279 The Wheel Turns! I
paragraphs: The first Amarantos Dream of the Megalos had ended, and due to the low proficiency of this Dream, many things were limited for Ozymandias!
In that endless dream, he could be anything within the Megalos Ynnere and Megalos Beyond.
He could start at a grand position, and live for a varied number of years depending on the proficiency of this Transcendent Megalos Ability.

After some hundreds of years passed, a certain Dream he had would forcefully come to an end before he was ushered into another, and if he died...then the entire Amarantos Dream of the Megalos would end.
And he faced further limitations with what he could bring back as at this time, he was at a crossroads.
A choice had to be made, but it wasn't an entirely hard one.
Quickly, the thoughts of Ozymandias went through as he looked at the three blinking singularities in front of him.
[The full weavings of the The Worm of the Deep have been retrieved]

[From the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos, the following weavings will be granted: Outerversal Physiology Echelon V, Megalos Regnum Echelon IV. 155,000,000 Pure Delegatus Channels. Half of the Existence Defying Physiology of the Megalos Transcendent Megalos Ability.] [Half of the weavings of Protector Alexei have been retrieved.]
[From the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos, the following weaving will be granted: System of Existence of Kuklos Echelon 4.]
[The Dream of Outerversal Morphon Lexo has been forever lost.] ...!
The choice was made!
He was only in the Third Echelon for both Outerversal Physiology and Megalos Regnum since his age was truly too pitifully low as an Outerversal Morphon, and yet...
HUUM!
In that unique space, his eyes opened wide as he awoke from a dream.
The complexity of his weavings burned as he felt like he had truly lived all those thousands of years.
The memories of the golden furred simian and the secrets of the Protectors floated in his mind.
The memories of the Pantheon of Gama and the Worm of the Deep flowed across his mind freely!
And in addition to all of this, the radiant rune of AMARANTOS in his existence began to spin and pulse as it released a cluster of weavings of existence.
Weavings of Outerversal Physiology Echelon V and Megalos Regnum Echelon IV!
Weavings of 155,000,000 Pure Delegatus Channels- and even Half of the Existence Defying Physiology of the Megalos Transcendent Megalos Ability!
All of it was topped off with his Fourth Mundi of Power in the Atlas of Existence connected to him and another part of him in the Megalos Ynnere beginning to buzz with radiance.
It had detected the weavings of another sufficiently different System of Existence!
Thus, the complex boons of the System of Existence of Kuklos flowed through.
WU! WU!
The massive rune within him spun terrifically as it let everything out, and at the end of it all...it became entirely still and dimmed.
Around it, swirling waves of golden obsidian sandy light flowed from the Dream Aletheian Haven, but it didn't react in any way as if it needed time.
Another Amarantos Dream of the Megalos would not be available to undertake right away or too soon, Ozymandias forced to wait for an indeterminate amount of time!
And so he would wait.
But as he did so...his Physiology began to churn, and the aura around him became extremely potent and concentrated.
He was...taking all the gains that would elevate him towards the Fifth Echelons of Outerversal Physiology and Megalos Regnum!
At the same time, near the dim rune of AMARANTOS, another rune began to form.
Deeply obsidian.
Crystalline in nature as if it could never be broken.
It read...DEFY!
The Transcendent Megalos Ability, Existence Defying Physiology of the Megalos.
But it seemed that it was only half completed.
Yet even this, Ozymandias would take!
A span of an instant had passed, and the Instrument woke up from his dream.
'What did he gain?'
The Great Wheel had its trillions of tentacles pulse as it thought with a smile.
The Great Wheel.
The one that was termed the Great Deceiver by the Commonwealth in one of the dreams of Ozymandias!
The one that instead of the Wheel of Existence itself, Protectors and powerful figures seeking the Wheel found themselves deceived and bound to him.
He watched with interested eyes as the aura of Ozymandias began to rise maddeningly at this moment.
Above his body, the faint outline of millions of thin golden lines appeared, all of them shooting out and extending in different directions!
|Ah!|
Intents of shock began to echo out in the surroundings.
|A single Dream that passed in an instant! And yet...he gained tens of millions of pure channels of Delegatus!|
How hard did one have to work to gain Delegatus?

A grueling search and fishing day to day for either the Megalos Beyond or Megalos Ynnere, with very few ever capable of extending their reach to the Megalos Nihilos as they simply held no compatibility.
But an Entity who had the Transcendent Megalos Ability of Amarantos Dream of the Megalos? He dreamt once and attained such shocking results!
This was why the abilities of the Great Beyonder were simply too insane.
Amarantos Dream of the Megalos was termed to be one of the top most Transcendent Megalos Abilities purely with how tremendous the gains could be made from it were.
|His Physiology...his Majesty...it is crossing the echelons seamlessly!|

The voice of Aspasia rang out as her eyes shifted around while portraying as much reverence as possible, keeping her promise to the Great Mother of elevating the aura and standing of the Instrument as much as possible.
He had to have as many supporters as possible!
|A single dream of his brought this...would he dream of becoming a Great One in a single Dream and attain such a state right after? This...!|
An unknown voice echoed out.
But the moment it did...
|The Signs!|
Another came down.
|The Signs!|
Another voice chimed in!
The words that the Great Beyonder left behind were filled with mysteries and many did not fully understand them since they were uttered cycles ago.
But there was one sentence that, at this moment, seemed to make things very clear.
|Born in one instant, a Great One in another instant.|
